Headlines: Fashion retailer H&M says data protection breaches unacceptable
Description: Fashion retailer H&M  said on Saturday that data security breaches found at its German unit were unacceptable and it was cooperating with the local data protection supervisory authority in its investigation into the matter.

Headlines: Financier doubts add to Boeing's MAX headaches
Description: To restore faith in the 737 MAX, Boeing needs to prove its flagship jet is not just airworthy but also a safe investment.

Headlines: FAA tells U.S. airlines it could approve MAX return to service before mid-year -sources
Description: Federal Aviation Administrator Steve Dickson called senior U.S. airline officials on Friday and told them the agency could approve the grounded Boeing 737 MAX's return to service before mid-year - a faster time frame than the planemaker suggested this week, people briefed on the calls said.

Headlines: U.S. senator slams Tesla's 'misleading' name for Autopilot driver assistance system
Description: A U.S. senator on Friday urged Tesla Inc  to rebrand its driver assistance system Autopilot, saying it has "an inherently misleading name" and is subject to potentially dangerous misuse.

Headlines: Explainer: Bezos allegations put phone hacking technology in the spotlight
Description: Allegations that Amazon.com boss and Washington Post owner Jeff Bezos had his phone hacked by Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman have put a spotlight on the security of smartphones and the secretive tools used to hack them.

Headlines: Owners of solar company that caused loss for Buffett plead guilty over Ponzi scheme
Description: The husband-and-wife owners of DC Solar, a California solar company that caused Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway Inc  to take a $377 million charge last year, pleaded guilty on Friday to involvement in an estimated $912 million Ponzi scheme.

Headlines: Starbucks shuts shops, suspends delivery in China's Hubei amid virus outbreak
Description: Starbucks has closed all shops and suspended delivery services in China's Hubei province for the week-long Lunar New Year holiday, where a coronavirus outbreak originated from its capital Wuhan has caused 41 deaths in China.

Headlines: Trump speaks with British PM Johnson about telecoms security: White House
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday discussed the security of telecommunications networks with British Prime Minister Boris Johnson, the White House said, as Britain nears a decision on Huawei's role in the country's future 5G network.

Headlines: Fiat Chrysler asks U.S. court to toss out GM racketeering claims: filing
Description: Fiat Chrysler Automobiles NV  on Friday urged a federal judge to throw out a General Motors Co's  lawsuit accusing Fiat Chrysler of racketeering and bribing officials of the United Auto Workers union to put GM at a multibillion dollar labor cost disadvantage.

Headlines: New U.S. curb on Huawei in limbo amid pushback from Pentagon: sources
Description: The U.S. Commerce Department has withdrawn a rule aimed at further reducing sales to China's Huawei Technologies amid concerns from the Defense Department the move would harm U.S. businesses, people familiar with the matter said.

Headlines: Wall Street Week Ahead: Hopes are high for tech stock 'Cadillacs'; so are their prices
Description: Wall Street is betting that the most popular U.S. technology and internet stocks can keep outshining the broader equities market but their latest rally leaves little room for error this earnings season.

Headlines: Former top U.S. general Dunford joining Lockheed Martin's board
Description: The former top U.S. military official, General Joseph Dunford, has been elected to the board of Lockheed Martin Corp , the Pentagon's largest weapons supplier, the company said on Friday.

Headlines: U.S. Justice Dept. plans to hold meeting to discuss tech industry liability: sources
Description: The U.S. Justice Department is planning to hold a conference to discuss the future of a federal law which largely exempts online platforms from legal liability for the material their users post, sources familiar with the plans said on Friday.

Headlines: Remaining hurdles for scandal-hit Wells Fargo
Description: Wells Fargo & Co and its officials have racked up well over $4 billion (3 billion pounds) in penalties since a sales practices scandal erupted in 2016, and continues to face headwinds.

Headlines: U.S. bank regulator sharpens teeth on Wells Fargo, surprising critics
Description: Long accused of being too soft, a U.S. bank regulator has surprised its critics with tough treatment of scandal-ridden lender Wells Fargo, culminating on Thursday in more than$58 million in fines against eight former executives at the bank.

Headlines: Bayer faces fourth U.S. Roundup cancer trial in Monsanto's hometown
Description: Bayer AG is set to face a fourth U.S. jury trial over allegations that its Roundup weed killer causes cancer, with four cancer patients in the hometown of its agricultural subsidiary Monsanto scheduled to begin making their case on Friday.

Headlines: The S&P 500 has worst day since October as virus fears mount
Description: Wall Street fell in a broad sell-off on Friday, as investors fled equities on growing concerns over the scope of the coronavirus outbreak, capping the S&P 500's worst week in six months.

Headlines: Habit Burger Grill plans to offer Impossible plant-based patty
Description: The Habit Restaurants Inc , known as the Habit Burger Grill, plans to put a plant-based meat patty from Impossible Foods Inc on its menu in the second half of this year as a limited-time offering.

Headlines: Impossible or Beyond: U.S. restaurants find partners to go vegan
Description: The world's largest burger chain McDonald's Corp  said this month that it would expand its test of a plant-based meat product with Beyond Meat  patties in Canada, and other chains also are looking to serve vegan customers.

Headlines: Boeing delays 777X first flight again due to bad weather
Description: Boeing has postponed again the first flight of its 777X long-haul jetliner that was scheduled to take place on Friday due to inclement weather.

Headlines: Brent logs worst weekly loss in a year as China virus fears swell
Description: Crude prices sank more than 2% on Friday and Brent logged its biggest weekly decline in more than a year as concerns that a coronavirus will spread farther in China, the world's second-largest oil consumer, curbing travel and oil demand.

Headlines: China virus fears spook U.S. shares, oil prices
Description: U.S. shares and crude prices fell sharply on Friday as investors moved into safe-haven assets amid concerns that a spreading virus from China would curb travel and hurt economic demand.

Headlines: Dollar dips vs yen as investors reach for safe havens on virus scare
Description: The U.S. dollar slipped against the safe-haven Japanese yen on Friday as investors fretted over concerns that a spreading virus from China would curb travel and hurt economic demand.

Headlines: Boeing weighing new 787 Dreamliner production cut: sources
Description: Boeing Co is weighing another production cut of its 787 Dreamliner, but may not have to take that step depending on the size and timing of orders from China stemming from a recent U.S. trade agreement, people briefed on the matter said Friday.

Headlines: Four-comma club: Predicting the next company to join trillion-dollar value elite
Description: The trillion-dollar market cap club expanded last week to a third U.S. company, with Google parent Alphabet Inc  topping the lofty valuation mark. Adding the next member, however, is likely to take a while.

Headlines: Nestle teams up with Canadian plant-based ingredient makers
Description: Food company Nestle SA  said on Friday it has teamed up with small Canadian plant-based food ingredient makers Burcon  and Merit Functional Foods, the second such supply agreement this month that targets Canadian crops.

Headlines: Intel's blockbuster results lift shares to dotcom peak, fire up sector
Description: Intel Corp's  shares hit their highest in nearly two decades on Friday after cloud computing demand fired up the chipmaker's data center business and allayed concerns of market share loss to rival AMD, lifting stocks across the sector.

Headlines: Bombardier scrambles to craft rail merger with Alstom, Hitachi: sources
Description: Bombardier  has approached France's Alstom  and Japan's Hitachi  to find a merger partner for its rail business as it struggles to contain costs that have eaten into margins, sources told Reuters.

Headlines: Brazil investors pour record $5.4 billion into domestic equity funds: BAML
Description: Brazilian investors are pouring a record amount of cash into local equity funds, while foreign investors notched up their sixth straight week of buying, Bank of America Merrill Lynch said on Friday.

Headlines: Ericsson hit by higher 5G costs and weaker U.S. market
Description: Sweden's Ericsson  warned it faced higher costs this year as it rolls out new 5G networks and was also hit by a temporary slowdown in its U.S. market, sending its shares 7% lower on Friday.    After a number of lean years, Ericsson has been boosted by the roll-out of 5G, particularly in the United States, and analysts hope it can benefit from a U.S. campaign to shut out Chinese rival Huawei [HWT.UL] from supplying 5G equipment.

Headlines: U.S. Treasury Secretary Mnuchin expects next China trade talks in 'near future'
Description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin said on Friday that he expects to begin negotiations with China on a so-called Phase 2 trade deal soon, with Washington and Beijing on the same page.

Headlines: BlackRock, Franklin Templeton eye partnership with Banco do Brasil's asset management unit: report
Description: Asset managers BlackRock Inc., Franklin Templeton and Principal Financial Group are vying for a partnership with state-controlled lender Banco do Brasil's asset management unit, a Brazilian newspaper reported on Friday.

Headlines: Italy watchdog threatens Facebook with another fine over improper use of data
Description: Italy's competition watchdog said on Friday it has launched proceedings against Facebook for non-compliance with a request to correct improper commercial practices in the group's treatment of user data.

Headlines: Bytedance's TikTok hires Microsoft IP chief as general counsel
Description: Popular mobile video app TikTok said on Friday it has hired attorney Erich Andersen from Microsoft to serve as the company's global general counsel, reporting to president Alex Zhu.

Headlines: JPMorgan hires senior tech executive from Goldman Sachs: memo
Description: JPMorgan Chase & Co  has hired senior banking technology executive Gavin Leo-Rhynie as head of engineering and architecture for the corporate and investment bank (CIB), according to a memo seen by Reuters.

Headlines: Lebanon and Japan have 40 days to agree on Ghosn's fate: sources
Description: Lebanon and Japan have about 40 days to decide whether ousted Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn will be extradited to Japan or stand trial in Lebanon, a judicial source and a source close to Ghosn said on Thursday, following his escape from Japan last month.

Headlines: Exclusive: U.S. pushing India to buy $5-6 billion more farm goods to seal trade deal - sources

Headlines: Westpac economists now see RBA delaying rate cut to April
Description: Analysts at Westpac Banking Corp  now expect the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) will cut interest rates in April, rather than February, following a second month of surprisingly upbeat jobs data.

Headlines: Boeing reschedules 777X plane's first test flight for Friday
Description: Boeing Co  said its 777X aircraft's first test flight would take place on Friday after bad weather delayed its scheduled takeoff on Thursday.

Headlines: U.S. bank regulator charges ex-Wells Fargo executives for role in sales scandal
Description: Wells Fargo & Co's U.S. regulator on Thursday announced it had banned former Chief Executive John Stumpf from the banking industry and charged him and seven other former executives combined more than $58 million in civil penalties for their roles in the bank's multi-year sales practices scandal.

Headlines: French investigators to move ahead with Ghosn prosecution over palace party
Description: French prosecutors investigating a party that former Renault-Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn threw for his wife at the sumptuous Versailles palace will in the next few weeks ask judges to examine the case, bringing a prosecution a step closer.

Description: Mexico is playing a risky game of hide and seek with the oil market.

Description: The chief executive of Volkswagen  said Luca de Meo, who stepped down as chief executive of the German carmaker's Spanish Seat brand this month, was probably in talks with French carmaker Renault .

Headlines: South Korean restaurant owners voice concerns over $4 billion Delivery Hero deal
Description: South Korean restaurant owners expressed concern on Monday over food delivery giant Delivery Hero's  proposed $4 billion acquisition of its local rival, saying the move could undermine competition and lead to higher fees.

Headlines: Fugitive financier Jho Low denies being 'mastermind' behind 1MDB
Description: Fugitive Malaysian financier Low Taek Jho has said he only acted as an intermediary for deals involving 1MDB, denying in an interview published on Monday that he had set the stage for the theft of billions of dollars from the Malaysian state fund.

Headlines: Amazon is generating lots of free-cash flow, time to get on board: Barron's
Description: Amazon.com Inc is generating lots of free cash flow, which it often uses to invest in growing its business, making the e-commerce retailer a good investment, weekly newspaper Barron's said on Jan. 3.

Headlines: Boeing, FAA reviewing wiring issue on grounded 737 MAX
Description: Boeing Co  and the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) confirmed on Sunday they are reviewing a wiring issue that could potentially cause a short circuit on the grounded 737 MAX.

Headlines: Japan orders tighter immigration procedures after Ghosn flees country
Description: Japan on Sunday said it would tighten immigration measures after former Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn fled the country while on bail, its first official response to an astonishing escape that has transformed the executive into an international fugitive.

Headlines: Chinese delegation plans to travel to Washington to sign trade deal: SCMP
Description: A Chinese trade delegation is planning to travel to Washington on Jan. 13 for the signing of the U.S.-China Phase 1 trade deal, the South China Morning Post reported on Sunday citing a source briefed on the matter.

Headlines: Gulf markets plunge on U.S.-Iran tensions, Aramco at lowest since IPO
Description: Kuwaiti and Saudi stocks led Gulf stocks sharply lower in late afternoon trade on Sunday in the wake of a U.S. drone strike in Baghdad that killed Iran's military commander.

Headlines: Daimler, Volvo mull combustion engine cooperation: report
Description: Luxury German carmaker Daimler  and Volvo Cars, owned by China's Geely, are considering cooperating to cut the costs of developing combustion engines, a magazine reported on Sunday, citing unnamed company sources.

Headlines: Saudi Aramco shares hit lowest since IPO, down 1.7%
Description: Shares of Saudi Aramco were down 1.7% in late afternoon trade on Sunday, hitting 34.55 riyals ($9.21) per share, its lowest level since it started trading last month after a record initial public offering (IPO).

Headlines: Daimler recalls 744,000 U.S. Mercedes-Benz vehicles for faulty sunroofs
Description: German automaker Daimler AG  said on Saturday it will recall 744,000 Mercedes-Benz vehicles in the United States from the 2001 through 2011 model years because the sunroof glass panel could detach and pose a hazard.

Headlines: Ghosn fled Japan after security firm hired by Nissan stopped surveillance
Description: Ousted Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn left his Tokyo residence after a private security firm hired by Nissan Motor Co stopped monitoring him, three sources familiar with the matter told Reuters on Saturday.

Headlines: Manager at Turkish jet operator told authorities he helped Ghosn escape because of threats: newspaper
Description: A manager at Turkish jet operator MNG Jet has told authorities that he assisted unwittingly in the escape of ex-Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn from Japan because he had been threatened by a former acquaintance, Hurriyet newspaper reported on Saturday.

Headlines: Ghosn used our jets illegally in escape from Japan, Turkish company says
Description: A Turkish private jet operator said on Friday that ex-Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn used two of its planes illegally in his escape from Japan, with an employee falsifying lease records to exclude his name from the documents.

Headlines: Amazon considers opening stores in Germany: report
Description: Amazon.com  is considering opening stores in Germany, its second biggest market after the United States, the ecommerce company's head in the country was quoted as saying on Saturday.

Headlines: Fed policymakers broadly see eye to eye on 2020 outlook
Description: Federal Reserve policymakers who last year were frequently at odds over where to set U.S. borrowing costs opened 2020 telegraphing confidence in the state of the economy and signaling broad agreement that monetary policy is right where it should be.

Headlines: Fed may need new approach to boost inflation, Daly says
Description: The Federal Reserve could find itself fighting too-low inflation for years to come, San Francisco Federal Reserve President Mary Daly said on Friday, and may need a new policy framework to lift inflation back up to the Fed's 2% goal.

Headlines: Fed's Mester, who warned of inflation risks, says current policy 'well calibrated'
Description: Cleveland Federal Reserve Bank President Loretta Mester, among the Fed policymakers most concerned that easy monetary policy would risk excessive inflation, said on Friday she has put those fears to rest for now and is willing to leave rates at their current level absent some substantial change in the economy.

Headlines: Exclusive: Weakened by sanctions, Venezuela's PDVSA cedes oilfield operations to foreign firms
Description: Venezuelan state company PDVSA is letting some joint venture partners take over the day-to-day operation of oilfields as its own capacity dwindles due to sanctions and a lack of cash and staff, according to a former oil minister, an opposition lawmaker and industry sources.

Headlines: Take Five: Crude awakening
Description: Geopolitics is back in the driving seat. The U.S. killing of a top Iranian commander has doused the nascent New Year rally and delivered a $3 boost for oil prices on fears that any violent retaliation from Tehran would disrupt energy supplies.

Headlines: Police body camera maker Axon sues U.S. FTC over antitrust litigation
Description: Axon Enterprise Inc  on Friday sued the U.S. Federal Trade Commission in a bid to have antitrust proceedings over an acquisition heard in a federal court and not in an internal FTC process, claiming that the FTC's ability to both prosecute and judge cases deprives companies of their constitutional rights.

Headlines: S&P 500 snaps win streak as Middle East tensions push down Wall Street
Description: Wall Street's major indexes fell from record highs on Friday after a U.S. air strike in Iraq ratcheted up tensions in the Middle East and a bigger-than-expected contraction in the U.S. manufacturing sector raised concerns of slowing economic growth.

Headlines: Exxon signals fourth quarter weakness in chemicals and refining, offset by asset sale
Description: Exxon Mobil Corp's  fourth quarter operating results will decline from a year ago due to weakness in chemicals and refining, according to a regulatory filing and analyst comments on Friday.

Headlines: FTC challenges police body camera maker Axon's acquisition of rival Vievu
Description: The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) on Friday challenged police body camera maker Axon Enterprise Inc's  completed acquisition of rival Vievu, saying it allowed the company to impose substantial price increases.

Headlines: Oil, safe havens surge after U.S. strikes kill Iran commander
Description: Oil prices surged as much as $3 a barrel as gold, the yen and safe-haven bonds all rallied on Friday after the U.S. killing of Iran's top military commander in an air strike in Iraq ratcheted up tensions between Washington and Tehran.

Headlines: Novartis, Merck and Allergan join those raising U.S. drug prices for 2020
Description: Novartis AG, Merck & Co Inc and Allergan Plc were among companies that raised U.S. prices on more than 100 prescription medicines on Friday, bringing the tally to 445 drugs that will cost more in 2020, according to data analyzed by healthcare research firm 3 Axis Advisors.

Headlines: FCC says it will accept comments until February 3 on Huawei, ZTE security risks
Description: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) said on Friday it will accept public comments until Feb. 3 on its determination that China's Huawei Technologies Co Ltd and ZTE Corp pose national security risks.

Headlines: Turkish court formally arrests five suspects over Ghosn's transit: Anadolu
Description: A Turkish court ruled on Friday to formally arrest five suspects who were detained as part of an investigation into ex-Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn's transit through Turkey after fleeing Japan, state-owned Anadolu news agency reported.

Headlines: Oil prices jump after U.S. air strike kills top Iranian commander
Description: Oil prices jumped to the highest level in more than three months on Friday after the United States killed a top Iranian military commander in Iraq, sparking fears that escalating conflict in the region could disrupt global oil supplies.

Headlines: Story on Ghosn's exit from Japan is withdrawn
Description: This story, first published at 1243 GMT, has been withdrawn pending more reporting.

Headlines: Soleimani strike lifts safe-haven yen; grim U.S. data hits dollar
Description: Investors rushed into safe-haven assets on Friday after U.S. air strikes in Iraq killed a senior Iranian military official, sending the Japanese yen to a three-month high, while the U.S. dollar index was knocked by the weakest domestic factory activity in a decade.

Headlines: Musk defies skeptics, meets Tesla delivery goal; shares hit record
Description: Tesla Inc  beat Wall Street estimates for annual vehicle deliveries and met the low-end of its own target, sending shares to a record high in a vindication for Chief Executive Elon Musk after a few turbulent years.

Headlines: Tesla rally leaves short sellers down $3 billion since 2018
Description: Tesla Inc's  short sellers have suffered $3 billion in losses since the end of 2018, including a $500 million hit on Friday after the electric carmaker's quarterly deliveries beat investors' expectations and drove its stock to a record high.

Headlines: Discounts fuel U.S. pick-up truck sales in a slowing market
Description: U.S. automakers on Friday reported another year of stable sales of pick-up trucks, as discounts during the crucial holiday season and lower interest rates on vehicle loans attracted buyers while demand for passenger cars retreated further.

Headlines: U.S. factory sector in deepest slump in more than 10 years
Description: The U.S. manufacturing sector fell into its deepest slump in more than a decade in December as the U.S.-China trade war kept a lid on factory output, orders and employment, although the long-awaited Phase 1 deal between Washington and Beijing could limit further downside.

Headlines: Fed's Barkin says it's time to let rate cuts work through economy
Description: Richmond Federal Reserve bank president Thomas Barkin said on Friday it would take a "substantial" change in the economic outlook for him to support a rate change.

Headlines: Turkish operator says Ghosn used its jets illegally in escape from Japan
Description: Turkish private aircraft operator MNG Jet said on Friday that its planes were used illegally in the escape from Japan of ex-Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn, adding it had filed a criminal complaint.

Headlines: Credit Suisse announces $1 billion 2020 share buyback program
Description: Credit Suisse  said on Friday it expects to buy back at least 1 billion Swiss francs ($1.03 billion) worth of shares until the end of 2020, subject to market and economic conditions, after completing a similar program last year.

Headlines: Sunrise's CEO Swantee, Chairman Kurer quit after failed Liberty Global deal
Description: Sunrise Communications  chief executive Olaf Swantee has quit and Chairman Peter Kurer said he will not run for re-election after a shareholder uprising blocked the group's $6.3 billion bid for Liberty Global's  Swiss cable unit.

Headlines: M&S names former Tesco executive as interim finance chief
Description: British retailer Marks & Spencer  on Friday named former Tesco  executive David Surdeau as its interim chief financial officer, temporarily filling a void left by the departure of Humphrey Singer.

Headlines: Louis Vuitton to close Hong Kong shop as protests bite: report
Description: Louis Vuitton, the world's biggest luxury goods brand by sales, is preparing to shut one of its shops in Hong Kong where protests have hit demand as high rental costs bite, the South China Morning Post newspaper reported on Friday.

Headlines: After Tesla's record year in Norway, rivals gear up for 2020
Description: New electric car sales in Norway rose by a third last year amid soaring demand for Tesla Inc's  vehicles, but the pioneering U.S. company will face a more competitive market in 2020 as rivals prepare to launch new electric models.

Headlines: U.S. farmers see another bleak year despite Phase 1 trade deal
Description: Across snow-covered North Dakota, U.S. farmers are stuck with fields full of weather-damaged corn - a crop they planted after the U.S.-China trade war killed their soybean market. Many don't know yet what crops they'll plant next season among a host of dicey options.

Headlines: Ryanair CEO says group may not get 737 MAX until October: report
Description: Ryanair  may only receive its first delivery of the grounded 737 MAX aircraft from Boeing  in October, chief executive Michael O'Leary said in an interview with German magazine Wirtschaftswoche.

Headlines: Exclusive: China to keep same inflation target in 2020 despite food price spike - sources
Description: China has decided to keep its inflation target unchanged this year at around 3%, sources say, suggesting policymakers will continue to roll out more economic support measures while avoiding aggressive stimulus.

Headlines: HSBC to stop weekend, overnight services at some Hong Kong ATMs after branches vandalized
Description: HSBC   will suspend overnight services at 19 ATM clusters in Hong Kong on weekends and public holidays, the bank said on Friday, two days after its branches and ATMs were targeted during anti-government protests.

Headlines: Tesla cuts price for China-made Model 3 vehicles before delivery

Headlines: U.S. oil deals hit five-year high in 2019 on Occidental's blockbuster Anadarko buy

Headlines: Global stocks hit record as rally enters new year, dollar rebounds
Description: Global stock markets jumped on the first day of trading in 2020 as a shot of Chinese stimulus and economic data drove a gauge of world equity performance to the latest in a series of record highs, while the dollar snapped a four-day losing streak.

Headlines: Wall Street starts 2020 with new records on China stimulus, trade hopes
Description: Wall Street's major indexes notched record highs to open the new year on Thursday, as fresh economic stimulus from China added to optimism fueled by easing trade tensions and an improving global outlook.

Description: Lebanon received an Interpol arrest warrant on Thursday for former Nissan chairman Carlos Ghosn, while Turkey launched an investigation into his daring escape from Japan via Istanbul.

Description: The family of former Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn played no role in his escape from Japan, Ghosn said in a statement on Thursday, days after his abrupt arrival in Beirut from Tokyo, where he faces trial for alleged financial misconduct.

Headlines: Lebanon played no official role in Ghosn exit: minister to MTV
Description: Lebanon played no official role in ousted Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn's departure from Japan, caretaker defense minister Elias Bout Saab told Lebanese broadcaster MTV on Thursday.

Headlines: HSBC kicks off year with Hong Kong branches closed, vandalized
Description: HSBC   is being drawn into Hong Kong's political turmoil with protesters attacking some of its branches and graffiti daubed on the famous pair of lions that guard its city-center headquarters.

Headlines: Oil edges up on Mideast tensions, trade optimism
Description: Oil inched up on Thursday on rising tensions in the Middle East and signs of improving Washington-Beijing trade relations, but a strong U.S. dollar limited price gains.

Headlines: Uber Eats goes local to find its niche in South African food fight
Description: A stone's throw from Nelson Mandela's former home in South Africa's Soweto township, Dumile Badela's restaurant is now more hectic and lucrative than ever, thanks to Uber Eats, his hungriest customer yet.

Headlines: Dollar recovers from six-month low after year-end sell-off
Description: The dollar recovered from a six-month low to rise 0.46% on Thursday, the year's first trading day, after a downbeat December that left the index virtually flat at the end of 2019 .

Headlines: Tesla says will start delivering China-made Model 3s to public on Jan. 7
Description: Tesla Inc will deliver its first China-made Model 3 sedans to the public on Jan. 7 at an event at its Shanghai plant, a representative for the firm told Reuters on Thursday.

Headlines: Exclusive: China halts British stock link over political tensions - sources
Description: China has temporarily blocked planned cross-border listings between the Shanghai and London stock exchanges because of political tensions with Britain, five sources told Reuters.

Headlines: Ghosn met Lebanese president after fleeing Japan: sources
Description: Fugitive former Nissan chairman Carlos Ghosn met Lebanon's president after fleeing from Japan, where he was smuggled out of house arrest by a private security company, two sources close to Ghosn said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Volkswagen starts settlement talks with German consumer groups over diesel scandal
Description: Volkswagen  on Thursday said it was in talks to discuss a settlement with German vehicle owners who are suing the carmaker over excessive pollution caused by VW's diesel cars.

Headlines: U.S. jobless claims edge lower but trend points to uptick in filings
Description: The number of Americans filing claims for jobless benefits edged lower last week, a positive signal for the U.S. labor market amid recent signs that new claims may be trending slightly higher.

Headlines: Asian shares outperform global peers in December, but yearly gains lag
Description: Asian shares gained for the fourth successive month in December as appetite for regional shares improved after the U.S. and China agreed on a preliminary deal to end their 17-month long trade war.

Headlines: Lebanon receives Interpol arrest warrant for Ghosn - Lebanese judicial source
Description: Lebanon received an Interpol arrest warrant on Thursday for ousted Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn, a Lebanese judicial source told Reuters.

Headlines: Futures rise on China stimulus, trade optimism
Description: U.S. stock index futures rose on the first trading day of the new decade on Thursday, as fresh stimulus from Beijing to prop up its slowing economy added to the optimism fueled by easing trade tensions and an improving global outlook.

Headlines: U.S. shale producers to tap brakes in 2020 after years of rapid growth
Description: Vastly slower U.S. oil growth this year and the prospect of a plateau for the world's top oil producer have signaled a new and  unfamiliar era of self-restraint for the go-go shale industry.

Headlines: Germany's Bosch to offer lower-cost sensors for self-driving cars
Description: German automotive supplier Robert Bosch said Thursday it has developed a sensor that lets cars "see" a three-dimensional view of the road, aiming to lower the cost of technology that could speed the development of self-driving vehicles.

Headlines: Turkey detains pilots over Ghosn's escape through Istanbul
Description: Turkish police detained seven people, including four pilots, on Thursday in an investigation into how ousted Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn transited through Istanbul en route to Lebanon after fleeing Japan, a police spokeswoman told Reuters.

Headlines: Turkish police detain four pilots over Ghosn's escape: NTV
Description: Turkish police have detained seven people, including four pilots, over the transit of ousted Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn through Turkey after fleeing Japan on his way to Lebanon, broadcaster NTV said on Thursday.

Headlines: Hyundai, Kia sales drop to seven-year low on China weakness, forecast better 2020
Description: South Korea's Hyundai Motor  and affiliate Kia Motors  turned in their lowest sales in seven years in 2019 as business in China slumped, missing their target for a fifth straight time, but forecast better numbers for 2020.

Headlines: Xiaomi to invest $7 billion in 5G, AI and IoT over next five years
Description: Chinese smartphone maker Xiaomi Corp will invest more than 50 billion yuan ($7.18 billion) in artificial intelligence and fifth generation internet technologies over the next five years, as competition in the sector grows.

Headlines: Australia-listed Sezzle fails to win California lending license, shares dive
Description: California rejected Sezzle Inc's  request for a lending license, dealing the recently listed buy-now-pay-later firm a big blow weeks after bigger rival Afterpay  got a go ahead, sending Sezzle's shares down by more than a fifth.

Headlines: Major commercial plane crash deaths worldwide fell by more than 50% in 2019: group
Description: The number of people killed in large commercial airplane crashes fell by more than 50% in 2019 despite a high-profile Boeing 737 MAX crash in Ethiopia in March, a Dutch consulting firm said on Wednesday.

Headlines: More drugmakers hike U.S. prices as new year begins
Description: Drugmakers including Bristol-Myers Squibb Co , Gilead Sciences Inc , and Biogen Inc  hiked U.S. list prices on more than 50 drugs on Wednesday, bringing total New Year's Day drug price increases to more than 250, according to data analyzed by healthcare research firm 3 Axis Advisors.

Headlines: Nissan ex-boss Carlos Ghosn to hold press conference on Jan. 8: lawyer
Description: Nissan ex-boss Carlos Ghosn will hold a news conference in Beirut on Jan. 8, a lawyer for Ghosn said on Wednesday, two days after abruptly arriving from Japan, where he was under house arrest and accused of financial misconduct.

Headlines: Exclusive: Airbus beats goal with 863 jet deliveries in 2019, ousts Boeing from top spot
Description: Airbus has become the world's largest planemaker for the first time since 2011 after delivering a forecast-beating 863 aircraft in 2019, seizing the crown from embattled U.S. rival Boeing , airport and tracking sources said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Strike not extended at Lufthansa's Germanwings for now
Description: The trade union representing cabin crew at Lufthansa's  budget airline Germanwings decided on Wednesday not to continue their strike for the time being after three days of stoppages led to dozens of flights being canceled.

Headlines: Britain's Lloyds Banking Group suffers hours-long online outage
Description: Britain's Lloyds Banking Group  suffered an outage on Wednesday that left customers of its Lloyds, Halifax and Bank of Scotland operations unable to access accounts online for several hours.

Headlines: Surveillance in a leafy enclave, Ghosn's Tokyo life was under strict monitoring
Description: The imposing home where Carlos Ghosn lived for the last seven months and probably launched a daring escape to avoid Japanese prosecutors is nestled in a leafy enclave of Tokyo where most people pay little attention to Westerners or luxury cars.

Headlines: Ghosn flight prompts talk of more curbs in Japan's strict justice system
Description: Carlos Ghosn's daring flight from Japan, where he was awaiting trial on charges of financial wrongdoing, has revived global criticism of the nation's "hostage justice," but in Japan is prompting talk of reversing more lenient curbs on defendants.

Headlines: Surveillance in a leafy enclave, Ghosn's Tokyo life was under strict monitoring

Description: Samsung Electronics  partly halted some semiconductor production at its Hwaseong chip complex in South Korea after about a minute-long blackout on Tuesday afternoon, the company said on Wednesday.

Headlines: U.S. auto safety agency to investigate fatal Tesla crash in California
Description: The fatal Dec. 29 crash of a Tesla Inc vehicle in Southern California will be investigated by the U.S. government's auto safety regulator, the agency said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Tesla must face lawsuit claiming racism at California factory
Description: A federal judge rejected Tesla Inc's effort to dismiss claims by two former workers that the California electric car factory where they worked was a hotbed of racial hostility, clearing the way for a possible trial.

Headlines: Turkish Airlines says reaches compensation deal over Boeing 737 MAX
Description: Turkish Airlines has agreed a compensation deal with planemaker Boeing Co over the grounding of the Boeing 737 MAX following two fatal crashes, the carrier said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Global stocks end 2019 near record highs, dollar slides
Description: The dollar slid to a six-month low on Tuesday as progress on U.S.-China trade tensions led investors to higher-risk assets, while a year-end rally that lifted global equity markets to record highs stayed alive on the last trading day of 2019.

Headlines: Exclusive: Drugmakers from Pfizer to GSK to hike U.S. prices on over 200 drugs
Description: Drugmakers including Pfizer Inc , GlaxoSmithKline PLC  and Sanofi SA  are planning to hike U.S. list prices on more than 200 drugs in the United States on Wednesday, according to drugmakers and data analyzed by healthcare research firm 3 Axis Advisors.

Headlines: Uber, Postmates sue to block California gig worker law, claiming it's unconstitutional
Description: Ride-hailing company Uber Technologies Inc and courier services provider Postmates Inc asked a U.S. court to block a California labor law set to go into effect on Wednesday, arguing the bill violates the U.S. Constitution.

Headlines: Wall Street edges higher; S&P closes decade with nearly 190% gain
Description: Wall Street's major indexes edged higher on Tuesday on a renewed  rally fueled by trade optimism, capping off a decade of handsome returns in which the benchmark S&P 500 rose nearly 190%.

Headlines: Oil posts biggest yearly rise since 2016
Description: Oil prices fell 1% on Tuesday, the last trading day of the decade, but notched the biggest annual gain in three years, supported by a thaw in the prolonged U.S.-China trade war and ongoing supply cuts from major oil producers.

Headlines: U.S. holiday returns surge with booming e-commerce
Description: United Parcel Service Inc  on Thursday expects to ship 1.9 million gifts and other items back to U.S. retailers as e-commerce fuels an anticipated 26% year-over-year volume surge on "National Returns Day."

Headlines: Dollar index records smallest ever annual move in 2019
Description: The U.S. dollar index recorded its smallest-ever annual move in 2019, up just 0.24% for the year after a drop in December reversed early gains as trade hopes and investor confidence diminished demand for the safe-haven asset.

Headlines: Trump says U.S.-China trade deal will be signed on January 15
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that Phase 1 of trade deal with China would be signed on Jan. 15 at the White House, though considerable confusion remains about the details of the agreement.

Headlines: Hudson's Bay chairman considers sweetened bid for retailer

Headlines: Ghosn says he escaped 'injustice' in Japan; Lebanon calls arrival a private matter
Description: Ousted Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn said on Tuesday he had fled to Lebanon to escape a "rigged" justice system in Japan, raising questions about how one of the world's most-recognized executives had slipped away while on bail.

Headlines: Factbox: Carlos Ghosn joins list of execs fighting extradition
Description: Ousted Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn said on Tuesday he had fled to Lebanon to escape a "rigged" justice system in Japan, where he believed he would not get a fair trial.

Headlines: Google to end 'Double Irish, Dutch sandwich' tax scheme
Description: Google parent Alphabet  will no longer use an intellectual property licensing scheme, known as the "Double Irish, Dutch sandwich", which allowed it to delay paying U.S. taxes, 2018 tax filings show.

Headlines: Beirut says it doesn't know how Nissan ex-boss Ghosn made it to Lebanon
Description: The Lebanese government does not know how Nissan ex-boss Carlos Ghosn made it from Japan, where he was due to be tried for financial misconduct, to Lebanon, the foreign ministry said on Tuesday.

Headlines: France says it was not aware of Ghosn going to Lebanon
Description: France was not aware that ousted Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn was jumping bail in Japan to go to Lebanon, the Foreign Ministry said on Tuesday.

Description: Nissan ex-boss Carlos Ghosn entered Lebanon legally and will not face any legal consequences, Lebanon's General Directorate of General Security said on Tuesday, according to the state news agency NNA.

Description: A Tencent-led consortium is taking a 10% stake in Vivendi's Universal Music Group, valuing the music label that houses Lady Gaga and The Beatles at 30 billion euros ($34 billion) and giving the Chinese firm a global backstage pass.

Description: Singapore's state investor GIC is part of the consortium led by China's Tencent that's buying up to 20% of Vivendi's  Universal Music Group (UMG), according to a source familiar with the deal.

Headlines: Qatar's state investor also part of Tencent's Universal deal
Description: Qatar Investment Authority (QIA) is another member of the Tencent-led consortium buying a 10% stake in Vivendi's  Universal Music Group, a source familiar with the deal said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Nissan ex-boss Ghosn entered Lebanon on French passport - MTV

Description: The 2010s saw the U.S. economy achieve its longest-ever expansion, with notable milestones such as 110 months of uninterrupted job gains and an unemployment rate near a half-century low becoming easy bragging points for politicians and economists alike.

Description: Any companies that rush to finish building a Russian natural gas export pipeline to Germany that came under U.S. sanctions this month risk being penalized, senior U.S. officials said on Sunday.

Description: A second probe into staff surveillance at Credit Suisse  is set to clear Chief Executive Tidjane Thiam, Swiss newspaper SonntagsZeitung reported on Sunday.

Headlines: The best year financial markets have ever had?
Description: For all the angst about trade wars, geopolitics and a sputtering and overly indebted global economy, 2019 might just be the best year investors have ever had.

Headlines: Trump says trade deal with China to be signed 'very shortly'
Description: President Donald Trump on Saturday said the United States and China would "very shortly" sign their so-called Phase One trade pact.

Headlines: Manager of McDonald's franchise in Peru says faulty drinks machine caused deaths
Description: The general manager of the company that operates McDonald's restaurants in Peru told local television that the beverage machine at the restaurant where two employees were fatally electrocuted last weekend had experienced an electrical fault but it was not reported to the company's maintenance department.

Headlines: NASA, Boeing investigating why Starliner spacecraft missed orbit
Description: The Boeing Co Starliner spacecraft that failed to hit the right orbit to reach the International Space Station is healthy, in a stable orbit and expected to land in New Mexico on Sunday morning, NASA said.

Headlines: U.S. government says verdict in Bayer's Roundup case should be reversed
Description: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and the Justice Department said a federal appeals court should reverse a lower court verdict finding Bayer AG liable in the case of a California man who blamed its Roundup weed killer for his cancer.

Headlines: Britain gives U.S. investor go-ahead to buy Cobham for $5 billion
Description: Britain has approved the purchase of British defense company Cobham  by U.S. investor Advent International for $5 billion after the private equity group made commitments to address national security concerns.

Headlines: Nord Stream 2 to press on with Europe gas pipe, despite U.S. sanctions
Description: The group behind Nord Stream 2 said on Saturday it aimed to complete a pipeline to boost Russian gas supplies to Europe as soon as possible, after U.S. sanctions prompted a major contractor to suspend pipe-laying activities.

Headlines: Germany 'firmly rejects' U.S. sanctions on Nord Stream 2 firms
Description: Germany's finance minister and vice chancellor, Olaf Scholz, said Berlin "firmly rejects" U.S. legislation imposing sanctions on firms laying the Nord Stream 2 gas pipeline from Russia to Europe.

Headlines: Russia gas export pipeline in jeopardy as Trump signs sanctions bill
Description: Swiss-Dutch company Allseas said it had suspended work on building a major Russia-to-Germany natural gas pipeline in order to avoid U.S. sanctions contained in legislation signed by President Donald Trump on Friday.

Headlines: Russia to go ahead with gas pipe project despite U.S. sanctions
Description: Russia's Foreign Ministry said on Saturday that Moscow will press ahead with a major Russia-to-Germany natural gas pipeline, disregarding U.S. sanctions.

Headlines: Boeing's failed Starliner mission strains 'reliability' pitch
Description: Boeing Co's  stunted Friday debut of its astronaut capsule threatens to dent the U.S. aerospace incumbent's self-declared competitive advantage of mission reliability against the price and innovation strengths of "new space" players like Elon Musk's SpaceX.

Headlines: Russia must press on with Nord Stream 2 gas line to Europe: Russian senator
Description: Russia must keep to schedule on implementing the Nord Stream 2 gas pipeline link to Europe, a senior Russian senator told state news agency RIA on Saturday, after pipe-laying was suspended due to U.S. sanctions.

Headlines: Wall Street Week Ahead: History suggests rally may slow for U.S. stocks in 2020
Description: The outsized rally in the U.S. stock market this year may give way to a more muted performance in 2020 if history is any guide.

Headlines: Lone Star to buy BASF construction chemicals unit for $3.51 billion
Description: Private equity firm Lone Star has entered a deal to buy BASF's  construction chemicals business for 3.17 billion euros ($3.5 billion) on a cash and debt-free basis, the German chemicals company said on Saturday as it seeks to focus on more profitable operations.

Headlines: PG&E creditors offer California wildfire victims $13.5 billion in cash upfront
Description: PG&E Corp's  creditors have sweetened their offer to California wildfire victims, saying they are now prepared to pay $13.5 billion in cash upfront, according to a letter sent on Friday to state governor Gavin Newsom.

Headlines: Boeing's Starliner astronaut capsule fails key test to reach space station
Description: Boeing Co's  new astronaut capsule failed after liftoff on Friday to climb high enough in orbit to reach the International Space Station, cutting short a critical unmanned test mission in the embattled aerospace giant's race to send humans to the orbital outpost.

Headlines: SEC probes at least two trading firms over NYSE listings: source
Description: The U.S. securities regulator has asked at least two trading firms for information regarding a broad investigation into initial public offerings and direct listings going back five years on the New York Stock Exchange, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters on Friday.

Headlines: U.S. Steel delivers unwelcome Christmas surprise to Michigan town
Description: The mayor of a Michigan steel town was attending his grandchildren's Christmas play Thursday evening when he got an unwelcome voicemail from an official of the town's top employer: United States Steel Corp .

Headlines: Colombia orders Uber to cease ride-hailing, cites competition rules violation
Description: Colombia on Friday ordered Uber  to cease its ride-hailing operations in the Andean country, effective immediately, after a judge ruled the company violated competition rules.

Headlines: U.S. Justice Department and FCC fight state effort to block merger of Sprint, T-Mobile
Description: The U.S. Justice Department and Federal Communications Commission filed in court on Friday to support a merger of T-Mobile  and Sprint , the third- and fourth-largest wireless carriers.

Headlines: Testimony ends in T-Mobile-Sprint merger trial in New York
Description: Testimony ended on Friday in a lawsuit by a group of states led by New York and California seeking to block the merger of Sprint Corp and T-Mobile US Inc, moving the trial a step closer to having a U.S. judge rule on whether the deal violates federal antitrust laws.

Headlines: France fines Google 150 million euros for opaque advertising rules
Description: France's competition watchdog fined Google 150 million euros ($167 million) on Friday for abusing its power over the treatment of advertisers, saying it applied opaque rules and changed them at will.

Headlines: JPMorgan pressed by Senate Democrats on racial discrimination reports
Description: A group of five U.S. senators sent a letter on Thursday to JPMorgan Chase & Co., asking it to explain what it was doing to address what they described as "a troubling list of discriminatory practices" related to race.

Headlines: Alphabet grants Pichai largest ever stock award, again
Description: Alphabet Inc's  newly instated Chief Executive Officer Sundar Pichai would receive a hefty $240 million in performance-based stock awards over the next three years, the highest ever promised to any executive of the search giant.

Headlines: U.S. transport chief said economic issues not a factor in 737 MAX's safety review
Description: The economic impact of Boeing Co's  planned halt of 737 MAX production will not be considered by U.S. regulators in their ongoing review of when to end the grounding of a plane involved in two major fatal crashes, U.S. Transportation Secretary Elaine Chao said on Friday.

Headlines: S&P 500 posts biggest weekly percent gain since September amid data, trade optimism
Description: U.S. stocks hit record closing highs again on Friday and the S&P 500 registered its biggest weekly percentage gain since early September after data showed a rise in consumer spending and investors continued to be optimistic about developments in the U.S.-China trade dispute.

Headlines: Exclusive: U.S. talks with GM over deploying self-driving cars without steering wheels
Description: The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is holding talks with General Motors Co  on the automaker's petition to deploy a limited number of self-driving vehicles on American roads without steering wheels or other human controls, the head of the agency said on Friday.

Headlines: U.S. accuses FleetCor of charging hundreds of millions of dollars in hidden fees
Description: U.S. fuel card company FleetCor Technologies Inc  charged customers hundreds of millions of dollars in hidden fees after promising to help them spend less on fuel, the Federal Trade Commission said on Friday.

Headlines: Stocks extend record rally, sterling endures rough week
Description: A year-end rally in global equity markets extended gains on Friday, helped by data showing relatively strong U.S. growth, while sterling posted its worst week in more than two years on concerns over how Britain will leave the European Union.

Headlines: Oil prices down but log third weekly rise on trade hopes
Description: Oil prices fell on Friday, but both benchmarks logged a third straight weekly gain amid the easing of U.S.-Chinese trade tensions, which has boosted business confidence and the outlook for global economic growth.

Headlines: Amazon to raise U.S. fulfillment fees 3 percent for merchants next year
Description: Amazon.com Inc plans to raise the fees it charges merchants for warehousing and shipping their goods in the United States by an average 3% next year, the company said Friday, as it faces higher costs from infrastructure and programs such as one-day delivery.

Headlines: U.S. consumers put economy on moderate growth path in third quarter
Description: U.S. economic growth nudged up in the third quarter and the economy appears to have maintained the moderate pace of expansion as the year ended, supported by a strong labor market.

Headlines: Fiat Chrysler unions received assurances on jobs, investment after merger
Description: Unions at carmaker Fiat Chrysler  said management had given assurances at a meeting on Friday on jobs and a 5 billion euro ($5.54 billion) investment plan in Italy following the group's planned merger with French rival PSA .

Headlines: Tesla shares inch closer to Musk's $420 take-private offer
Description: Shares of Tesla Inc  hit a fresh record high for the third straight session on Friday, and were just $7 shy from the $420 per share price at which founder Elon Musk sought to take the electric carmaker private more than a year ago.

Headlines: Graphic: For veteran Netflix shareholders, it's been a very good decade
Description: For long-term shareholders of Netflix , the end of December marks an extremely rewarding decade.

Headlines: United cancels 737 MAX flights into June as Spirit AeroSystems to freeze parts production
Description: United Airlines Co is extending its cancellations of Boeing 737 MAX flights until June 4 as Boeing's top supplier, Spirit AeroSystems Inc,  said it would stop making fuselages for the grounded jets.

Headlines: United Airlines pulls Boeing 737 MAX jets until early June

Description: Fiat Chrysler  will stick to its 5 billion euro ($5.5 billion) 2020 investment plan for Italy, union officials said on Friday, adding that the group had confirmed a pledge to get all employees off furlough arrangements and back to work by 2022.

Headlines: Novartis wins Medicaid approval for new sickle cell drug in key U.S. states

Headlines: ViacomCBS to take 49% stake in film studio Miramax for $375 million
Description: Media company ViacomCBS Inc  said on Friday it would take a 49% stake in film studio Miramax, owned by Qatar's BeIN Media Group, for $375 million.

Headlines: Aramco, Alibaba rescue sluggish 2019 global ECM market
Description: Giant listings by Saudi Aramco  and Alibaba  rescued a sluggish year for equity capital markets (ECM) in 2019 after a string of shelved initial public offerings (IPOs) and share price slumps.

The fear is a bigger crunch may erupt in the $2.2 trillion U.S. repo market towards year-end, a period when banks lend less and trading volumes fall.

Description: The Irish High Court will rule on Monday Dec. 23 on whether Ryanair  can prevent its operations chief Peter Bellew from joining arch-rival easyJet  until 2021, a court official said on Friday.

Headlines: China says case of detained Canadians turned over to prosecutors
Description: China's foreign ministry said on Friday that an investigation into two Canadians detained on state security charges since December last year had ended, and the case had been turned over to prosecutors.

Headlines: Turkish Airlines prepping case against Boeing over 737 MAX: news agency

Description: Wall Street's major indexes resumed their rally with fresh records on Thursday as U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin said an initial U.S.-China trade deal would be signed in early January.

Description: Nike Inc's  quarterly revenue and profit blew past Wall Street expectations on Thursday on strong sales in China, but lower-than-expected growth in North America, its biggest market, overshadowed the beat.

Headlines: Boeing astronaut capsule faces key test on trip to space station
Description: Boeing Co  is set to launch its new astronaut capsule on Friday on its first unmanned journey to the International Space Station, a milestone test for the U.S. aerospace firm that is vying with SpaceX to revive NASA's human spaceflight capabilities.

Description: A U.S. congressional committee will ask Wells Fargo & Co’s  board of directors to testify about the bank's sales scandal next year, a senior Democrat told Reuters on Thursday.

Description: Brazil's planemaker Embraer S.A. said it is studying the development of a new light military transport plane together with the Brazilian Air Force, the company said in a statement on Thursday.

Description: Amazon.com Inc said on Thursday it was on track to deliver 3.5 billion customer packages globally this year through its in-house delivery network.

Description: Agreements that let Facebook and other firms send European citizens' data to the United States and other countries are valid, a key EU court adviser said on Thursday, although he left room for such transfers to be blocked if European data protection standards are not met in countries receiving the information.

Headlines: U.S. labor market on solid ground; mid-Atlantic factories sputter
Description: The number of Americans filing applications for unemployment benefits dropped from a more than two-year high last week, pointing to sustained labor market strength that should continue to underpin consumer spending and the economy.

Headlines: SEC proposes allowing more investors access to private companies
Description: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday proposed changes to its decades-old definition of a professional investor in order to allow more Americans to buy shares in private companies.

Headlines: U.S.-China to sign 'Phase one' trade pact in early January: Mnuchin

Headlines: GM issues two recalls for more than 900,000 new vehicles
Description: General Motors Co  said on Thursday it is issuing recalls for more than 900,000 vehicles worldwide in two separate campaigns to address brake software issues and fire risks.

Headlines: Trump called Boeing CEO to inquire about 737 MAX production halt: sources
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump called Boeing  Chief Executive Dennis Muilenburg this week to ask about the status of 737 MAX production, two people briefed on the matter confirmed.

Headlines: Adidas and Beyonce to launch gender-neutral collection

Description: Accenture Plc  beat Wall Street estimates for first-quarter earnings on Thursday, as investments in its fast-growing digital and cloud services businesses continue to pay off.

Description: Fiat Chrysler and Peugeot maker PSA face the challenge of winning over regulators and delivering on a pledge to slash costs without closing factories after sealing a binding deal to create the world's fourth biggest carmaker.

Headlines: Italian PM welcomes Fiat Chrysler merger with PSA, says jobs crucial
Description: Italian Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte welcomed the planned merger of Fiat Chrysler with its French rival PSA in an newspaper interview on Thursday, but said protecting jobs would be a top priority.

Description: U.S. automaker Ford Motor Co.  said on Monday it expects its full year 2019 loss, before interest and taxes, from China to be nearly halved from the year ago.

Description: A deal to clinch a North American trade pact with Canada and Mexico was close but "not quite finished yet," Nancy Pelosi, the speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives, said on Monday.

Description: White House adviser Jared Kushner said on Monday there was progress on reaching a trade deal with Mexico and Canada, but he would not confirm reports he planned to travel to Mexico for talks.

Headlines: Honda's Hachigo seizes the wheel as quality crisis hits profits
Description: At a two-day gathering for Honda's suppliers in March, Chief Executive Takahiro Hachigo sounded the alarm.

Headlines: Australia cartel case against Citi, Deutsche delayed by late night witness statement

Headlines: Former Boeing employee who warned about 737 problems will testify at hearing

Headlines: Mexico asks Pelosi to act on trade deal, business groups wary
Description: Mexican President Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador on Monday urged U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi to decide on ratification of a North American trade pact, even as Mexican business groups fretted that proposed changes were weakening the deal.

Headlines: Canada's Freeland invited to Mexico talks as USMCA deal looms
Description: Mexico's government has invited Canadian Deputy Prime Minister Chrystia Freeland to talks in Mexico along with U.S. officials, a senior Mexican official said on Monday, as a final agreement on a new North American trade deal appeared to draw nearer.

Description: Johnson & Johnson  Chief Executive Officer Alex Gorsky has declined to appear at a U.S. congressional hearing set for Tuesday on the safety of the company's Baby Powder and other talc-based cosmetics.

Description: General Motors Co  confirmed on Monday it agreed to loan $40 million to an electric vehicle start-up to facilitate the acquisition of its shuttered Lordstown Assembly plant in Ohio.

Description: U.S. Trade Representative Robert Lighthizer and White House adviser Jared Kushner will head to Mexico on Tuesday to work on final details of the U.S.-Mexico-Canada (USMCA) trade pact, which has yet to be ratified by the U.S. Congress, an administration official said.

Headlines: Oil slips as weak China exports highlight trade war impact
Description: Oil prices fell on Monday after data showed Chinese exports declined for a fourth straight month, sending jitters through a market already concerned about damage to global demand by the trade war between Washington and Beijing.

Headlines: Wall St. falls as Apple, health shares drag, tariff deadline looms
Description: U.S. stocks pulled back on Monday from near-record levels, as Apple and healthcare shares fell and investors braced for a busy week of political and economic news, including a potential turning point in the U.S.-China trade dispute.

Headlines: Sprint tells of business struggles in first day of T-Mobile merger trial
Description: Executives from Sprint Corp testified on Monday that the U.S. wireless carrier has struggled to improve its network, hindering its growth and underscoring the need to merge with larger rival T-Mobile US Inc.

Headlines: Uber nears deal for self-driving car simulation startup: The Information
Description: Uber Technologies Inc  is in advanced negotiations to acquire Foresight, a startup that develops simulation software, The Information reported on Monday citing a source familiar with the matter.

Headlines: Global stocks, gold little changed as trade war spurs concerns
Description: Global equity markets traded flat on Monday on hopes officials would delay more U.S. tariffs set to take effect on Chinese goods this coming Sunday, while gold held firm as investors hedged against a possible escalation in the trade war.

Headlines: Australia's Westpac faces investor rage after exploitation payment scandal
Description: Australia's Westpac Banking Corp  faces a showdown with investors at its annual meeting this week, seeking to hold back an avalanche of outrage over a money laundering scandal that includes accusations of enabling child exploitation payments.

Headlines: Amazon lawsuit blames Trump for loss of Pentagon cloud contract
Description: Amazon.com Inc on Monday accused U.S. President Donald Trump of exerting "improper pressure" and bias that led the Department of Defense to award a lucrative $10 billion cloud contract to rival Microsoft Corp.

Headlines: Volkswagen charged with violating vehicle emission standards in Canada
Description: German automaker Volkswagen AG  on Monday was charged with importing nearly 128,000 vehicles into Canada contravening the country's environmental legislation, a Canadian government agency said.

Headlines: Nokia halts legal action against Daimler with mediation offer in patent row
Description: Finnish telecoms equipment maker Nokia has suspended legal action against German carmaker Daimler in the hope that mediation will resolve their dispute over technology licensing fees.

Headlines: Morgan Stanley cutting jobs due to uncertain global environment -source
Description: Morgan Stanley  is cutting about 2% of its workforce globally due to an uncertain global economic outlook, according to a source familiar with the matter.

Headlines: France's Sanofi to buy biotech firm Synthorx for $2.5 billion
Description: France's Sanofi  on Monday agreed to buy California-headquartered biotechnology firm Synthorx  in a cash deal worth about $2.5 billion as it steps up a push in the lucrative field of cancer drugs under its new chief executive.

Headlines: ViacomCBS plans sale of CBS headquarters in New York
Description: ViacomCBS  is planning to sell the CBS headquarters in New York, known as Black Rock, as it seeks to cut costs from the combined company, Chief Executive Officer Bob Bakish told reporters Monday.

Headlines: Brazil's weak currency, cheaper credit add to Amazon threats
Description: Brazil's record-low interest rates and exchange rate threaten to accelerate Amazon deforestation, which has already risen sharply under Brazil's farm-friendly President Jair Bolsonaro, economists tell Reuters.

Headlines: Tiger Global cuts Juul's valuation by half to $19 billion: WSJ
Description: Private equity firm Tiger Global Management has cut its valuation of e-cigaratte maker Juul Labs Inc by half to $19 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.

Headlines: Reinvesting Aramco IPO money will aid government revenues: minister
Description: Saudi Arabia's finance minister on Monday said that reinvesting money from the initial public offering (IPO) of oil group Saudi Aramco would help to create more revenue channels for the government.

Headlines: Just Eat takeover battle hots up with fresh $6.5 billion Prosus bid
Description: Prosus  raised its unsolicited cash offer for British food delivery service Just Eat  to $6.5 billion on Monday, ratcheting up the pressure on rival bidder Takeaway  in their bitter takeover battle.

Headlines: Canada to present fiscal update before Christmas: finance minister
Description: Canada's new minority Liberal government will present a fiscal update before the Christmas break, although no date has been set, Finance Minister Bill Morneau said on Monday.

Headlines: Walmart Chile pulls court requests for police protection, but warns looting continues
Description: Walmart in Chile on Monday pulled requests it filed earlier with Chilean courts demanding police protection for its supermarkets, but said looting of its stores continued and that the situation following weeks of unrest remained "complex."

Headlines: U.S. consumer inflation expectations rebound from five-year low: NY Fed
Description: U.S. consumers' inflation expectations rose slightly in November, bringing the outlook for near and medium-term inflation up from a five-year low in a New York Federal Reserve survey, potentially offering relief to policymakers worried about sagging inflation.

Headlines: Xerox expects revenue growth of up to $1.5 billion with HP takeover
Description: Xerox Holdings Corp  expects its proposed acquisition of personal computer company HP Inc  to result in sales growth of as much as $1.5 billion for the combined company, according to a presentation by the printer maker.

Headlines: Exclusive: Hyundai's $1.8 billion shipbuilding deal with Daewoo faces full EU probe - sources
Description: World No. 1 shipbuilding group Hyundai Heavy Industries Holdings Co Ltd's  $1.8 billion merger with rival shipbuilder Daewoo  will face a full-scale investigation in Europe due to serious EU antitrust concerns, two people familiar with the matter said on Monday.

Headlines: Intel creates chip to control quantum computers
Description: Quantum computers aim to carry out tasks in just a few minutes that would take today's best conventional computers thousands of years. But in nearly every photograph of the devices, there's a tangle of wires in the background connected to equipment that controls the quantum computer.

Headlines: Bankrupt PG&E to take $4.9 billion more charge on wildfire victim claims

Headlines: Flying cars could lure investors away from ground-based services: survey
Description: Electric air taxis — known colloquially, if somewhat misleadingly, as "flying cars" — could draw millions of investor dollars away from ground-based transportation start-up firms in 2020, according to a study released on Monday.

Headlines: Britain's Tesco considers Asia exit

Headlines: Tesco shares jump on possible sale of Asian business
Description: Shares in Tesco  rose more than 5% on Monday after Britain's biggest retailer said it might sell its Asian businesses, in Thailand and Malaysia, which analysts valued at up to $9 billion.

Headlines: House Democrats, USTR nearing deal to pass modified USMCA agreement: WSJ
