Headlines: Nike's Parker hands over CEO role to former eBay chief
Description: Nike Inc's  long-time chief executive officer, Mark Parker, will step down next year and be replaced by board member and former eBay CEO John Donahoe, who will be tasked with strengthening the sportswear maker's online strategy.

Headlines: Gulfstream expects more queries during certification after Boeing MAX crashes
Description: Gulfstream Aerospace Corp President Mark Burns said on Tuesday he expected regulators to ask for more details on software when the company certifies its new G700 long-range corporate jet, following two crashes involving the Boeing 737 MAX.

Headlines: Exclusive: Blackstone, CVC seek to take Paysafe public - sources
Description: Private equity firms Blackstone Group Inc  and CVC Capital Partners Ltd are seeking to hire underwriters for an initial public offering (IPO) of Paysafe Group Ltd that could value the payments processing firm at more than $10 billion, including debt, according to people familiar with the matter.

Headlines: U.S. charges six investment bankers over insider trading scheme
Description: U.S. prosecutors said on Tuesday they had charged six members of an insider trading ring who worked for firms including Goldman Sachs Group , Moelis and Centerview Partners and allegedly booked tens of millions of dollars in illicit profits.

Headlines: Oil prices rise as OPEC mulls deeper output cuts
Description: Oil prices rose on Tuesday after China signaled progress in trade talks with the United States and OPEC and its allies mulled deeper production cuts, but gains were capped by forecasts of a buildup in U.S. crude stockpiles.

Headlines: Pound, stocks slip as lawmakers reject Brexit law timetable
Description: The pound weakened and stocks on world markets declined on Tuesday after British lawmakers rejected the government's proposed timetable for passing legislation to ratify its deal to exit the European Union.

Headlines: U.S. business borrowing for equipment rises 18% in September: ELFA
Description: U.S. companies' borrowing to spend on capital investments rose 18% in September from a year earlier, the Equipment Leasing and Finance Association (ELFA) said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Gulfstream unveils new flagship G700 business jet in challenge to rival Bombardier
Description: U.S. planemaker Gulfstream on Monday unveiled its widely-expected G700 long-range jet, in a challenge to Bombardier Inc's  flagship Global 7500 aircraft.

Headlines: Air New Zealand to start non-stop Auckland to New York route in 2020
Description: Air New Zealand Ltd  said on Wednesday it will launch a non-stop flight service between Auckland and New York in October 2020, in a bid to take advantage of strong visitor growth from North America.

Headlines: Bank of Canada rate cut bets sink as investors eye post-election spending
Description: Investors are ditching bets that the Bank of Canada will cut interest rates over the coming months as the domestic economy shows resilience and the federal election result adds to prospects of growth-boosting fiscal spending next year.

Headlines: Fiat Chrysler to build new car battery hub in Turin
Description: Fiat Chrysler  will build a new battery assembly complex in its Mirafiori plant in Turin, with an initial investment of 50 million euros ($56 million), the carmaker said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Zuckerberg to tell Congress Facebook is 'not the ideal messenger' for Libra currency
Description: Facebook Chief Executive Mark Zuckerberg plans to acknowledge before Congress that Facebook is not the "ideal messenger" for its Libra cryptocurrency project, given ongoing criticism of the company.

Headlines: Spanish court to probe Russian tycoon's bid for DIA supermarket chain: document
Description: Spain's High Court will investigate allegations that Russian tycoon Mikhail Fridman acted to depress the share price of DIA  when trying to take control of the supermarket chain, a court document seen by Reuters showed.

Headlines: Boeing texts reveal flawed simulator, not smoking gun: ex-colleagues
Description: Four days after leaked internal pilot messages set off a media firestorm for Boeing Co , former colleagues have defended a former pilot who voiced concerns about unreported 737 MAX software problems two years before fatal crashes.

Headlines: Five U.S. officials including Kushner, Mnuchin to attend Saudi financial conference: sources
Description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin and presidential adviser Jared Kushner will lead Washington's delegation to an annual  financial conference in Saudi Arabia, government sources said on Tuesday.

Headlines: UTC says Boeing 737 MAX production could remain at current levels
Description: United Technologies  believes Boeing will still make 737 MAX planes at its current rate for the rest of 2019, Chief Financial Officer Akhil Johri said on Tuesday, allaying some fears of a complete halt in production.

Headlines: UPS COO's retirement eclipses e-commerce gains
Description: United Parcel Service Inc's  e-commerce fueled quarterly profit beat on Tuesday was overshadowed by news that Jim Barber, widely viewed as the world's biggest parcel delivery firm's next leader, would retire at year-end.

Headlines: McDonald's misses profit target as competition delivers breakfast, plant burgers
Description: McDonald's Corp  missed Wall Street estimates for profit for the first time in two years on Tuesday as more investment to spruce up U.S. restaurants and speed up service weighed on the world's biggest fast food chain, sending its shares down 4%.

Headlines: U.S. crude stocks expected to rise for sixth consecutive week: Reuters poll
Description: U.S. crude stockpiles likely rose for the sixth straight week, while refined products stockpiles likely fell last week, an extended Reuters poll showed on Tuesday.

Headlines: S&P cuts Boeing outlook to 'negative' on fresh 737 MAX concerns
Description: S&P Global Ratings lowered its outlook for Boeing Co  to "negative" from "stable" on Tuesday, after reports that the planemaker may have misled the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration about problems with the anti-stall software on its grounded 737 MAX jet.

Headlines: How a major U.S. farm lender left a trail of defaults, lawsuits
Description: After completing a credit review in a half-hour phone call, a BMO Harris Bank underwriter cleared $12 million in loans for Ohio corn and soybean producer Greg Kruger in 2013.

Headlines: Investor revolt torpedoes Swiss Sunrise's $6.4 billion Liberty Global deal
Description: Sunrise Communications Group  bowed to investor pressure on Tuesday and scrapped its 6.3 billion Swiss franc ($6.39 billion) acquisition of Liberty Global's  Swiss cable business UPC.

Headlines: Lockheed Martin profit climbs, expects lower cash flow in 2020; shares dip
Description: Lockheed Martin Corp  raised its estimate for 2019 earnings on Tuesday as quarterly profit climbed 9.2% amid improved sales of its F-35 fighter jets, but it forecast a lower cash flow for next year and shares dipped in afternoon trading.

Headlines: Bank of America expands zero-commission stock trading
Description: Bank Of America said on Monday it would expand its zero-dollar online trading to all customers of its Preferred Rewards program and cut commissions for others, following similar moves by several online brokers.

Headlines: U.S. companies facing worker shortage race to automate
Description: U.S. companies are responding to the lowest unemployment rate in almost 50 years by increasing their focus on automation in order to maintain healthy margins as labor costs tick higher, a Reuters analysis of corporate earnings transcripts shows.

Headlines: Explainer: As Draghi era ends at ECB, cheap money concerns nag
Description: Mario Draghi hands over power at the European Central Bank to Christine Lagarde amid fierce debate over the ultra-loose money policies he spearheaded to aid a eurozone recovery from the financial crisis.

Headlines: Centene posts narrow profit beat, signals early close of WellCare deal
Description: Centene Corp  said on Tuesday its deal for WellCare Health Plans  could close sooner than previously expected and posted a profit that edged past Street estimates, reassuring investors of strength in its core Medicaid business.

Headlines: Hasbro shares plunge as toymaker battles tariff costs
Description: Hasbro Inc  fell well below Wall Street estimates for quarterly profit on Tuesday, as the toy maker wrestled with higher shipping and warehousing costs due to U.S. tariffs on Chinese imports, sending its shares down about 18%.

Headlines: U.S. existing home sales drop more than expected in September
Description: U.S. home sales fell more than expected in September as the market continues to struggle with a dearth of properties for sale, especially for cheaper homes.

Headlines: Harley-Davidson beats forecasts as international sales rebound
Description: Harley-Davidson Inc  beat expectations for profit on Tuesday and stuck to its full-year shipment forecast, allaying fears of another major hit from European import tariffs and a further slump in sales in its main U.S. market.

Headlines: Turkey's Halkbank could face fine for failing to appear in U.S. court: prosecutor
Description: A U.S. prosecutor on Tuesday called Turkey's Halkbank  a "fugitive" after it failed to make an initial court appearance in a criminal case accusing it of conspiring to violate U.S. sanctions against Iran.

Headlines: OPEC, allies to mull deeper oil cut amid worries over demand growth
Description: OPEC and its allies will consider whether to deepen cuts to crude supply when they next meet in December due to worries about weak demand growth in 2020, sources from the oil-producing club said.

Headlines: Infosys loses $6.6 billion in market cap after whistleblower complaints
Description: India's No.2 software services exporter, Infosys Ltd , is probing whistleblower complaints that its top two executives engaged in "unethical practices" to boost short-term revenue and profit, sending its shares down 16% on Tuesday.

Headlines: VW speeds up production of next generation Golf
Description: Volkswagen  will start deliveries of its new Golf hatchback in December after shaving an hour off the time needed to build its flagship model, the board member responsible for production at the VW brand said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Fintech Revolut to launch in the U.S. by year-end with Mastercard deal
Description: Digital banking app Revolut is set to begin issuing its cards in the United States by the end of this year via a partnership with payments company Mastercard Inc MA.N, the two companies said on Tuesday.

Headlines: P&G raises full-year forecast after beauty, healthcare brands drive profit beat
Description: Procter & Gamble Co  on Tuesday raised its full-year sales and profit forecasts after a better-than-expected first quarter, as it sold more toothpaste and expensive face cream.

Headlines: Huawei to develop radars for self-driving cars, top executive says
Description: Huawei Technologies Co Ltd will utilize its 5G technologies to develop radar for self-driving cars, its deputy chairman told a conference, as the Chinese manufacturer looks to play a bigger role in the auto industry.

Headlines: UBS tightens investment banking belt as earnings slide continues
Description: Swiss bank UBS  is axing high-paying investment banking staff after a disappointing performance at the division prompted a 16% slide in third-quarter net profit and put the group's 2019 profit goals further out of reach.

Headlines: Diaper rush: conquering a $9 billion market no one wants to talk about
Description: The time may not be far off when more adults need diapers than babies as the population grows older, potentially a huge opportunity for manufacturers of incontinence products - if they can lift the stigma that has long constrained sales.

Headlines: South Africa's Eskom takes Deloitte to court alleging improper contracts
Description: South Africa's Eskom is taking legal action to recover 207 million rand ($14 million) linked to contracts it alleges were improperly awarded to Deloitte Consulting in 2016, the cash-strapped state power firm said late on Monday.

Headlines: Trade tensions, jibes at U.S. overshadow Chinese cyber conference
Description: At one of the world's showpiece tech conferences in China, jibes at the United States for its 'bully behavior' lent a Cold War tone to proceedings as trade tension once again reared its ugly head in an event that drew a dearth of top U.S. executives.

Headlines: Chinese vice foreign minister says progress made in trade talks with U.S.
Description: China and the United States have achieved some progress in their trade talks, Vice Foreign Minister Le Yucheng said on Tuesday, and any problem could be resolved as long as both sides respected each other.

Headlines: Senior Chinese diplomat reiterates that U.S. forced trade war on China
Description: The United States has forced an unwanted trade war on China and Beijing must take the necessary countermeasures to protect its interests, senior Chinese diplomat Wang Yi said on Tuesday.

Headlines: China will keep door open to foreign investment, global industry despite trade tensions
Description: China will take steps to safeguard its interests, but won't close its door to foreign investment and the global industry despite trade frictions with the United States, a Chinese official said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Renault chairman vows to get Nissan alliance back on track next year
Description: Renault Chairman Jean-Dominique Senard is determined to get the carmaker's alliance with Japan's Nissan  back on track next year, he said on Tuesday, adding other matters such as a potential tie-up with Fiat Chrysler were less of a priority.

Headlines: Goldman Sachs lowers forecast 2020 U.S. shale oil output growth
Description: Goldman Sachs wound back its forecast for growth in U.S. shale output in 2020, and slightly reduced its outlook for 2020 global oil demand growth.

Headlines: AMS posts third-quarter revenue jump, sees strong demand from Apple, others
Description: Apple  supplier AMS  beat expectations with a 41% jump in third-quarter revenue on Tuesday and forecast further strong demand for its optical sensors from smartphone makers as it takes aim at a takeover of German lighting maker Osram .

Headlines: Arla's CFO steps down to take up position at Ahold Delhaize
Description: Arla Foods, one of the world's largest dairy firms, said on Tuesday that Chief Financial Officer Natalie Knight will leave the company at the end of February because she is moving to Belgian food retailer Ahold Delhaize .

Headlines: UBS, authorities eye client overcharges in Singapore and Hong Kong
Description: UBS  is working with relevant authorities to address inappropriate spreads it may have charged wealthy clients whose money was booked in Hong Kong and Singapore in debt securities transactions, it said in its third-quarter report on Tuesday.

Headlines: Walmart chief seeks stable business environment from India's Modi: ET
Description: Walmart Inc's  chief executive has written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi seeking certainty and predictability in India's business environment, the Economic Times newspaper reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.

Headlines: Bombardier unveils revamped small business jet to compete with Embraer
Description: Bombardier  on Monday unveiled its revamped Liberty Learjet 75 corporate plane, betting that extra legroom and a lower price tag would help the Canadian company beat back competition from Embraer SA's  market leading model.

Headlines: Oil prices fall 1% as global demand concerns grow
Description: Oil prices fell nearly 1% on Monday after comments from a U.S. official fed concerns surrounding the U.S.-China trade war, adding to worries that a slowing global economy would reduce demand for oil.

Headlines: Global stocks climb on hopes for progress in trade; Canadian dollar gains
Description: World stock indexes rose on Monday as signs of work to resolve the U.S.-China trade war bolstered investor hopes, while the Canadian dollar strengthened in the hours before results of the election for prime minister.

Headlines: SoftBank's WeWork takeover would lead to Adam Neumann's exit: sources
Description: SoftBank Group  offered nearly $10 billion on Monday to WeWork and its shareholders under a takeover plan that would keep the U.S. office-space sharing start-up afloat and lead to the exit of its Chairman Adam Neumann, sources said.

Headlines: U.S. allows Chevron to drill for oil in Venezuela for three more months
Description: The U.S. Treasury Department on Monday renewed a license allowing Chevron, the last U.S. operating energy company in Venezuela, to continue drilling in the country for another three months through Jan. 22.

Headlines: Drug firms avert landmark opioid trial as talks on $48-billion settlement set to resume
Description: Four large drug companies could resume talks on Tuesday to try to reach a $48 billion settlement of all opioid litigation against them, after agreeing with two Ohio counties to a $260 million deal to avert the first federal trial over their role in the U.S. opioid epidemic.

Headlines: Trade hopes move S&P 500 close to new record high
Description: The benchmark S&P 500 stock index rose within striking distance of a record high on Monday as further signs of progress toward resolution of the U.S.-China trade war boosted shares in sectors sensitive to trade and the global economy.

Headlines: Howard Hughes announces management reshuffle, to sell assets worth $2 billion
Description: Howard Hughes Corp , which counts activist investor William Ackman as chairman, said on Monday it would sell about $2 billion of non-core assets following a strategic review and announced a management reshuffle.

Headlines: October brings losses for short sellers in U.S. opioid-related shares
Description: October has been a rough month for short sellers betting against companies at the heart of the opioid crisis, although those traders still have paper profits of almost $600 million for the year, according to data from financial analytics firm S3 Partners.

Headlines: China asks WTO for $2.4 billion sanctions against U.S. in latest clash
Description: China is seeking $2.4 billion in retaliatory sanctions against the United States for failing to comply with a World Trade Organization ruling in a case that highlights White House complaints about the global trade body.

Headlines: San Jose to propose turning PG&E into giant customer-owned utility - WSJ
Description: San Jose, California's third-biggest city, is proposing to convert PG&E Corp  into the country's largest customer-owned utility, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday, citing the city's mayor.

Headlines: Facebook suspends Russian Instagram accounts targeting U.S. voters
Description: Facebook Inc said on Monday it has suspended a network of Instagram accounts operated from Russia that targeted Americans with divisive political messages ahead of next year's U.S. presidential election, with operators posing as people within the United States.

Headlines: Colorado abandons legal effort to stop Sprint, T-Mobile merger
Description: Colorado became on Monday the second state to drop out of an effort by state attorneys general led by New York and California to stop T-Mobile US Inc's $26 billion merger with Sprint Corp.

Headlines: Boeing may face billions more in losses as MAX crisis deepens - analysts
Description: Boeing Co may have to book billions of dollars in additional charges related to its parked 737 MAX jets, brokerages said on Monday, citing fresh uncertainty over the time frame for lifting a safety ban imposed after deadly crashes.

Headlines: Factbox: Billion-dollar lawsuits accuse drugmakers, distributors of fueling U.S. opioid crisis
Description: On Monday, two Ohio counties reached a last-minute settlement with four companies they accused of fueling the nationwide opioid epidemic. The counties were seeking billions of dollars to cover the cost of addiction treatment programs, healthcare and other services.

Headlines: Factbox: The U.S. opioid epidemic by the numbers
Description: Opioid deaths in the United States have soared over the last two decades, driving a wave of litigation against drugmakers and distributors.

Headlines: Santander to sell Puerto Rico unit to FirstBank in $1.1 billion deal
Description: Banco Santander  said on Monday it had agreed to sell Santander Bancorp, the Spanish lender's retail and commercial banking franchise in Puerto Rico, to FirstBank Puerto Rico in a deal valued at $1.1 billion.

Headlines: Former Chevron exec seeks $500 million for post-sanctions Venezuela
Description: The former chief of Chevron Corp's Latin American operations is moving to raise $500 million from big financial firms to invest in Venezuela once U.S. sanctions are eventually lifted, confident that political change will come and that foreign investment will be needed to boost sagging oil output.

Headlines: UBS, Simmons Energy pare bankers as shale M&A slows: sources
Description: UBS Group AG and the energy arm of Piper Jaffray Companies have cut staff in their oil and gas investment banking teams, three people familiar with the matter said on Monday, as U.S. dealmaking continues to dry up.

Headlines: Companies slow to disclose financial costs of climate change: report
Description: U.S. and European companies in polluting industries rarely disclose the financial risks they face related to climate change even though a global task force called on them to do so two years ago, Moody's Investors Service said in a report on Monday.

Headlines: Exclusive: Europe regulator to clear Boeing 737 MAX in January at earliest
Description: European regulators expect to clear Boeing's grounded 737 MAX to return to service in January at the earliest, following flight trials by European test pilots scheduled for mid-December, Europe's top aviation safety official told Reuters.

Headlines: Trump praises U.S.-China trade talks as Beijing seeks billions in WTO case against U.S.
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Monday said efforts to end a U.S. trade war with China were going well as the world's two largest economies continued to battle over trade and politics across the world despite heralding a long-awaited truce this month.

Headlines: Trump's Vuitton visit stirs discord at the brand as designer hits out
Description: Louis Vuitton designer Nicolas Ghesquiere has hit out at Donald Trump after the U.S. president inaugurated one of the brand's factories last week, distancing himself from a visit that was attended by top executives from parent group LVMH.

Headlines: Embraer announces $1.4 billion order, launch customer for Praetors jets
Description: Embraer SA on Monday announced an order worth $1.4 billion from Flexjet, which becomes the new launch customer for the Brazilian company’s Praetor jets.

Headlines: Opioid talks with Teva, distributors could resume Tuesday: attorney
Description: Talks to reach a settlement of thousands of lawsuits stemming from the U.S. opioid addiction crisis could resume as soon as Tuesday, an attorney for local governments said on Monday.

Headlines: Fidelity drops Fisher's money management firm as withdrawals accelerate
Description: Fidelity Investments has dropped Fisher Investments as a money manager, a Fidelity spokesman said on Monday, the latest in an accelerating series of withdrawals from the firm over allegedly sexist comments by its leader, Kenneth Fisher.

Headlines: Peloton's stock takes a spill, even as IPO underwriters cheer it on
Description: Shares of Peloton Interactive  slumped 6% on Monday, even after a multitude of buy ratings from the stationary bike seller's IPO banks, underscoring Wall Street's growing exhaustion from money-losing startups.

Headlines: Apple starts selling locally assembled iPhone XR in India
Description: Apple Inc  has started selling its popular iPhone XR phones assembled in India, as it looks to expand its share in the world's second-largest smartphone market where it has struggled against cheaper products from rivals.

Headlines: Fallout from Trump's trade wars felt by economies around the world
Description: The collateral damage of the United States' trade wars is being felt from the fjords of Iceland to the auto factories of Japan.

Headlines: Italy's biggest bank wants to become less Italian
Description: The chief executive of UniCredit  has a plan to revive his company's ailing share price - make it less Italian.

Headlines: Coty looks to offload brands including Wella, Clairol; shares rise
Description: Coty Inc  is exploring the sale of its business unit that houses hair and nail care brands such as Wella, Clairol and OPI as part of its plan to whittle down its portfolio and cut debt, sending its shares up nearly 14% on Monday.

Headlines: Deutsche Bank plans job cuts of at least 10% in rates unit: Bloomberg
Description: Deutsche Bank AG  said it is considering substantial cuts to the unit that trades interest-rate securities, a division that survived a large-scale pullback as part of the lender's sweeping revamp in July, Bloomberg reported on Monday.

Headlines: Halliburton vows more cost cuts as shale demand dwindles, shares rise
Description: Halliburton Co on Monday promised more cost cuts after reporting a bigger-than-expected drop in quarterly revenue as the oilfield services looks to counter weak demand from North American shale producers, sending its shares up about 7%.

Headlines: India's Infosys U.S. listed shares plunge after whistleblower complaints
Description: U.S.-listed shares of Infosys Ltd   fell nearly 16% in premarket trading on Monday after the Indian software services exporter said it had received whistleblower complaints alleging "unethical practices" by the company's executives.

Headlines: Teva, three U.S. drug distributors reach opioid settlement - source
Description: Drug maker Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Inc  and the three biggest U.S. drug distributors reached a settlement on Monday to avoid a trial over their role in the opioid addiction crisis, a source said on Monday.

Headlines: Smith+Nephew CEO steps down over pay, ex-Roche Diagnostics chief to take over
Description: Smith+Nephew Plc  Chief Executive Namal Nawana is stepping down after just 17 months in the role after becoming dissatisfied with his salary at the medical device maker.

Headlines: Unizo keeps door open for Blackstone, Fortress talks
Description: Unizo Holdings  said Monday it would continue talks with Blackstone Group  and SoftBank-backed  Fortress Investment Group on a potential takeover, raising the possibility of a bid battle between the two global buyout firms.

Headlines: Gojek CEO quits to join Indonesian cabinet, replacements named
Description: Gojek CEO and co-founder Nadiem Makarim said on Monday he had resigned to join Indonesia's new cabinet, and the ride-hailing and payments company said two senior executives would jointly take over running operations of the $10 billion firm.

Headlines: Qantas, Virgin Australia get slots at Tokyo's Haneda airport
Description: Qantas Airways  and Virgin Australia Holdings Ltd  were awarded one slot each to operate flights at Tokyo's Haneda Airport, according to a draft decision by Australia's International Air Services Commission (IASC).

Headlines: Boeing expresses regret over ex-pilot's 737 MAX messages, faults simulator
Description: Boeing Co said on Sunday it understood the outcry over leaked messages from a former test pilot over erratic software behavior on its 737 MAX jet two years before recent crashes, and added it was still investigating what they meant.

Headlines: Japan's extended exports slump could push BOJ to ease next week
Description: Japan's exports contracted for a 10th straight month in September, adding to speculation the central bank could ease monetary policy as soon as next week to support an economy hit by a slowdown in global demand.

Headlines: China's central banker says yuan level 'appropriate', trade tensions risk to global economy
Description: China's top central banker said on Saturday that potential escalation of trade tensions and policy uncertainty were the major risk factors facing the world economy, and market forces were keeping China's yuan at an appropriate level.

Headlines: Wall Street Week Ahead: Tech haves and have-nots face third-quarter tests
Description: Technology companies, which make up the largest swath of the U.S. stock market, are expected to post a nearly 8% drop in third-quarter profits as reports roll in from many of the sector's biggest corporations.

Headlines: Thomson Reuters says engaged in CEO succession planning
Description: Thomson Reuters Corp  is engaged in succession planning for Chief Executive Jim Smith as "a matter of good governance," the business information company said on Sunday.

Headlines: Long-haul, fuel efficient jets underpin demand at Las Vegas air show
Description: New large corporate planes that can fly farther and an industry push toward sustainable aviation fuels are seen as bright spots as the world's biggest business jet makers assemble in Las Vegas to showcase their offerings at the sector's largest gathering.

Headlines: U.S. business investment downturn could pressure slowing economy
Description: (This September 26 story corrects to clarify historicals in paragraphs 10 and 17)

Headlines: Facebook open to currency-pegged stablecoins for Libra project
Description: Facebook Inc , facing growing skepticism about its digital currency project Libra, on Sunday said the initiative could use cryptocurrencies based on national currencies such as the dollar, instead of the synthetic one it initially proposed.

Headlines: Qantas tests world's longest commercial flight from New York to Sydney
Description: Australia's flag carrier Qantas  completed on Sunday a nonstop test flight from New York to Sydney, researching how the world's longest potential commercial airplane journey of nearly 20 hours would impact pilots, crew and passengers.

Headlines: Boeing board to meet in Texas as scrutiny intensifies: sources
Description: Boeing Co's  board of directors and top executives from its airplanes division and supply chain were due to meet on Sunday in San Antonio, Texas, two days after the U.S. planemaker was plunged into a fresh crisis over its banned 737 MAX jet.

Headlines: China's Xiaomi says plans to launch more than 10 5G phones next year
Description: Chinese smartphone maker Xiaomi Corp plans to launch more than 10 5G phones in 2020, CEO Lei Jun said on Sunday, speaking at the World Internet conference in the eastern Chinese town of Wuzhen.

Headlines: Turkey says nothing will come of Halkbank case if law in U.S. works
Description: Nothing will come of a case against Turkey's state-owned lender Halkbank "if the law in the United States works", Turkish Foreign Minister Mevlut Cavusoglu said on Sunday, adding that the case was politically motivated.

Headlines: BMW open for new partners in mobility services venture: FAS
Description: BMW  is keen to find additional partners for the mobility services venture it runs with rival carmaker Daimler , BMW's new chief executive told a Sunday newspaper.

Headlines: SoftBank seeks to avoid WeWork's liabilities with new investment: sources
Description: SoftBank Group Corp  is attempting to become the majority owner of WeWork without assuming the onerous lease obligations of the U.S. office-space sharing firm, according to people familiar with the matter.

Headlines: China's indebted HNA group names chairman's son as president: Caixin
Description: China's indebted HNA Group has appointed its chairman's son as president as part of business restructuring at the finance-to-aviation conglomerate, Chinese financial magazine Caixin reported on its website on Saturday.

Headlines: Exclusive: Huawei in early talks with U.S. firms to license 5G platform - Huawei executive
Description: Blacklisted Chinese telecoms equipment giant Huawei is in early-stage talks with some U.S. telecoms companies about licensing its 5G network technology to them, a Huawei executive told Reuters on Friday.

Headlines: U.S. oil major Chevron says hopeful about maintaining Venezuela presence
Description: U.S. oil major Chevron Corp  said late on Friday it is optimistic about maintaining a presence in Venezuela even amid U.S. sanctions on the country and state oil company PDVSA as part of Washington's effort to oust President Nicolas Maduro.

Headlines: Boeing pilots' messages on 737 MAX safety raise new questions
Description: A Boeing Co senior pilot said he might have unintentionally misled regulators, in a series of internal messages from 2016 that became public Friday, plunging the world's largest airplane maker into a fresh crisis.

Headlines: Boeing 737 MAX test pilot grappled with simulator flaws, too
Description: In newly released instant messages from 2016, a top Boeing Co 737 MAX test pilot tells a colleague that the jet's MCAS flight control system - the same one linked to two fatal crashes - was "running rampant in the (simulator) on me."

Headlines: Exclusive: Electric Hummer could be part of GM's move into EV trucks, SUVs - sources
Description: General Motors Co  plans to build a new family of premium electric pickup trucks and sport-utility vehicles at its Detroit-Hamtramck plant beginning in late 2021, possibly reviving the imposing Hummer brand on some of them, several people familiar with the plans said.

Headlines: Trump hopes U.S.-China trade deal will be signed by middle of November
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday said he thinks a trade deal between the United States and China will be signed by the time the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation meetings take place in Chile on Nov. 16 and 17.

Headlines: China says will work with the U.S. to address each other's core concerns
Description: Chinese Vice Premier Liu He said on Saturday that China will work with the United States to address each other's core concerns on the basis of equality and mutual respect, and that stopping the trade war would be good for both sides and the world.

Headlines: Mnuchin backs proposal to double IMF's crisis fund
Description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin on Friday said he welcomes a proposal to double the size of the International Monetary Fund's $250 billion crisis lending fund as part of a deal to maintain overall IMF resources.

Headlines: Opioid settlement talks fail, landmark trial expected Monday
Description: A landmark trial over the U.S. opioid epidemic is on track to begin on Monday after drug companies and local governments failed to agree on a settlement on Friday that had been expected to be valued at around $50 billion.

Headlines: FAA turns over emails from former Boeing 737 pilot
Description: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) on Friday turned over 10 pages of emails to Congress from a former chief technical pilot on the Boeing 737 MAX that disclosed new details of the company's efforts to win approval from regulators around the world and drew the ire of a top Democratic lawmaker.

Headlines: Oracle co-CEO Mark Hurd dies at 62
Description: Oracle Corp's  62-year-old co-chief Mark Hurd died on Friday morning, the company said, an unexpected development that raises pressure on co-CEO Safra Catz to lead the business software maker's ongoing transition to cloud computing.

Headlines: Senior U.S. lawmaker says Boeing must shake-up management after 737 MAX crashes
Description: The chairman of the U.S. House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee on Friday said Boeing Co must shake-up its management team and Congress must reform how new airplanes are certified following the disclosure of internal messages about the 737 MAX involved in two deadly crashes.

Headlines: J&J recalls 33,000 bottles of baby powder as FDA finds asbestos in sample
Description: Johnson & Johnson said on Friday it is recalling around 33,000 bottles of baby powder in the United States after U.S. health regulators found trace amounts of asbestos in samples taken from a bottle purchased online.

Headlines: Johnson & Johnson says baby powder investigation could take 30 days or more
Description: Johnson & Johnson said on Friday its investigation into asbestos contamination of its baby powder could take 30 days or more, after announcing it planned to recall about 33,000 bottles of the product in the United States.

Headlines: FDA alerts consumers of J&J baby powder recall, says it stands by tests
Description: The U.S. Food & Drug Administration said on Friday that it found that a sample from one lot of Johnson & Johnson's baby powder contained chrysotile fibers, a type of asbestos, confirming test results the company disclosed earlier on Friday.

Headlines: Exclusive: Lampert helps bankroll Sears as woes persist after bankruptcy - sources
Description: U.S. retailer Sears has borrowed about $150 million from lenders, including its billionaire owner Eddie Lampert, as it racks up losses less than a year after it emerged from bankruptcy protection, people familiar with the matter said.

Headlines: Judge's unorthodox approach has huge opioid settlement within reach
Description: From the start of the sprawling U.S. litigation seeking to hold drugmakers and distributors liable for the country's opioid epidemic, Judge Dan Polster has made one thing clear: he never wanted a trial.

Headlines: News Corp to supply headlines for Facebook's upcoming news tab
Description: Facebook Inc's  upcoming news tab will feature headlines from the Wall Street Journal and some other News Corp  media properties when it launches in fall of 2019, the social network said on Friday.

Headlines: Boeing, J&J, dismal China data drag Wall Street lower
Description: Wall Street fell on Friday as negative headlines about Johnson & Johnson and Boeing, along with bleak economic data from China, soured investor risk appetite and offset generally positive corporate earnings.

Headlines: Dollar weakens on Brexit, shares sapped by weaker China growth
Description: The dollar posted its worst week in almost four months on Friday, pummeled by sterling and euro rallies driven by a deal on Britain's departure from the European Union, while China's weakest growth in nearly three decades weighed on equities.

Headlines: GM temporarily halts Chevy Blazer production because of parts shortage
Description: General Motors Co  on Friday said it temporarily halted production of its Chevy Blazer SUV in Mexico because of a parts shortage due to a month-old strike by 48,000 U.S. hourly GM employees.

Headlines: Oil falls as China economic concerns outweigh rising refinery runs
Description: Oil prices edged lower on Friday, as concerns about China's economy outweighed bullish signals from its refining sector, but losses were limited on hopes for progress toward a U.S.-China trade agreement.

Headlines: General Motors strike to slash U.S. October payrolls: JPMorgan
Description: A month-long strike at General Motors  could cut U.S. job growth by as much as 75,000 in October, JPMorgan economist Daniel Silver said on Friday, an unwelcome development amid financial market fears of a recession.

Headlines: Pentagon says decision on full-rate F-35 jet production possibly delayed until 2021
Description: The Pentagon's decision to move into a full-rate production contract for the F-35 jet, made by Lockheed Martin , could be delayed until 2021 because of issues integrating the jet with its testing and training simulators, an official said on Friday.

Headlines: Tesla's Nuerburgring run revs up debate over speed records
Description: Tesla Inc's  attempts to humble Porsche with a new lap record on Germany's legendary Nordschleife racetrack have reignited a controversy about the value of lap times, as the circuit steps in to quash claims of cheating.

Headlines: Global trade uncertainty a reason to ratify USMCA: Mexican minister
Description: Mexican Finance Minister Arturo Herrera said on Friday the current global uncertainty over trade is another reason to ratify the agreement negotiated last year between his country, the United States and Canada.

Headlines: In oil-rich region, Venezuelans fear catastrophe if Trump forces Chevron to leave
Description: With the $2 he earns in wages each week working as a cargo driver for Venezuelan state oil company PDVSA, 56-year-old Freddy Brito cannot even afford to buy one kilogram (2.2 lb) of cheese.

Headlines: Schlumberger takes $12 billion charge as CEO charts new course
Description: Schlumberger NV's  new chief executive wielded an axe to the company's asset-heavy businesses, taking a $12.7 billion charge in the face of weaker shale drilling and sliding profits.

Headlines: Apple's Cook meets China regulator after pulling Hong Kong app
Description: Apple Inc Chief Executive Tim Cook met the chief of China's market regulator in Beijing on Thursday, the Chinese agency said, a week after the U.S. firm was thrust into political tensions between the mainland and protesters in Hong Kong.

Headlines: Exclusive: Aramco makes relatively little from foreign refining - documents
Description: Documents from Saudi Aramco show that the world's largest oil firm earns only a limited proportion of its profit from foreign refining ventures, an area in which the company plans huge investment.

Headlines: Kansas City Southern profit beats, signals strength in fourth quarter
Description: Railroad operator Kansas City Southern  on Friday reported a better-than-expected quarterly profit, helped by an increase in refined fuel shipments to Mexico and ongoing cost cuts.

Headlines: American Express profit beats estimates as consumers shrug off slowdown fears
Description: Credit card issuer American Express Co  reported a higher-than-expected quarterly profit that highlighted the health of the U.S. consumer even as fears mount that a manufacturing-led weakness could spread to the broader economy.

Description: A profit warning sent Renault's  shares as much as 15% lower on Friday, capping a turbulent year for the French carmaker since the arrest of long-time boss Carlos Ghosn and adding to signs of a sharp global auto industry slowdown.

Headlines: Take Five: Super Saturday, Super Mario
Description: Britain may be about to draw a line under almost 3-1/2 years of political chaos, economic uncertainty and tortuous discussions with the European Union over the terms of its exit from the bloc. If the UK parliament gives its nod to the divorce deal Prime Minister Johnson has secured -- unlikely but possible -- we might well see sterling rally more than 5%; shares in domestic-focused British companies might rocket to record highs.

Headlines: Walmart's Asda agrees $4.9 billion Rothesay Life pension deal
Description: Walmart's  Asda has agreed a 3.8 billion pounds ($4.9 billion) 'buy in' with Rothesay Life to secure the benefits for 12,300 members of one of its pension schemes, in a deal that simplifies its balance sheet ahead of a possible standalone listing.

Headlines: Zero-sugar sodas, smaller soft drink cans drive Coca-Cola revenue beat
Description: Coca-Cola Co  beat Wall Street estimates for quarterly revenue on Friday as customers took to smaller-sized cans of its sodas, including Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, prompting the beverage maker to give an upbeat forecast for 2019.

Headlines: How a small aluminum maker won U.S. trade protection
Description: When Donald Trump won the White House, the sprawling aluminum smelter that hugs the Ohio River here was operating at less than half its capacity, and most of its skeleton crew of 270 remaining workers were fearful about their future.

Headlines: Nissan on gradual recovery path, incoming CEO Uchida tells staff
Description: Nissan Motor Co's incoming chief executive Makoto Uchida told employees on Friday that his mission is to "restore business performance and regain trust in Nissan".

Headlines: EU will hit U.S. in time with tariffs over Boeing: Malmstrom
Description: The European Union will impose its own tariffs "in due course" in its WTO dispute over aircraft subsidies after the United States hit EU imports with increased duties related to illegal subsidies for Airbus, EU trade chief Cecilia Malmstrom said on Friday.

Headlines: China's GDP growth grinds to near 30-year low as tariffs hit production
Description: China's third-quarter economic growth slowed more than expected and to its weakest pace in almost three decades as the bruising U.S. trade war hit factory production, boosting the case for Beijing to roll out fresh support.

Headlines: Holiday Inn-owner IHG hit by weak China, Hong Kong bookings
Description: Holiday Inn-owner InterContinental Hotels Group  blamed lower business bookings in China and Hong Kong protests for a 0.8% fall in third-quarter revenue per room on Friday, the latest company to be pinched by weaker global travel.

Headlines: Blackstone's financing for Merlin deal unsettles bond market
Description: (This October 17 story refiles to change Thursday to Wednesday in fifth paragraph)

Description: Swedish truckmaker AB Volvo  reported a sharp decline in third-quarter orders and forecast a demand slump on both sides of the North Atlantic next year, taking the shine off forecast-beating earnings.

Description: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd  has shelved plans for its first U.S. dollar debt deal in 23 years, the airline said on Friday, after sources told Reuters that global investors had baulked at the pricing due to civil unrest in Hong Kong.

Description: Credit Suisse  will start charging wealthy clients with large cash deposits in Swiss francs, the latest Swiss bank to pass on negative interest rates to customers.

Description: Saudi Aramco has delayed the planned launch of its initial public offering in hopes that pending third-quarter results will bolster investor confidence in the world's largest oil firm, two sources familiar with the matter said on Thursday.

Headlines: Going Dutch? Low interest rates rattle 'world's best' pension system
Description: When Frans Kolkman hung up his police badge in 2017, he was looking forward to a comfortable retirement. Two years later he's among millions of Dutch pensioners facing a cut and fearing there may be worse to come.

Headlines: Factbox: Dutch pension pots stand out among global retirement funds
Description: The world's rich nations face a double-whammy, with ageing populations meaning more retirees -- just as low and negative interest rates make it harder for pension funds to secure the investment returns needed to fill up their coffers.

Headlines: Instant View: China third-quarter GDP grows 6.0% year-on-year, misses expectations

Headlines: Six warning lights flashing for China’s slowing economy
Description: China’s $13 trillion economy is slowing and indicators showing that range from freight shipments to factory power generation and from employment to expenditures on entertainment.

Description: Delivery delays to Boeing's  777X jetliner are holding back Emirates' growth and could partially affect the Gulf carrier's broader fleet requirements, airline President Tim Clark said on Thursday.

Description: A gap is emerging in the U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) industry as big players such as Exxon Mobil Corp  and Cheniere Energy Inc  race ahead to build export terminals with fewer long-term contracts, while smaller developers struggle to find financing for their first plants.

Description: It is clear that France is preparing to build new nuclear power plants, Jean-Bernard Levy, Chief Executive of state-controlled utility EDF , said in an interview with Le Monde newspaper on Thursday.

Description: Lawyers representing families of passengers killed in a Boeing 737 MAX crash in Ethiopia in March are set to issue subpoenas to Southwest Airlines  and American Airlines , according to documents seen by Reuters.

Description: Fitbit Inc  is developing a method to detect irregular heart rhythm in time through a partnership with Bristol-Myers Squibb-Pfizer Alliance, as the wearable device maker looks to match a feature available on rival Apple Inc's  Watch.

Description: Ford Motor Co  said on Thursday it was teaming up with Volkswagen AG  and Amazon.com  to give its future electric car customers a range of charging options from highways to homes.

Description: Tesla Inc  will start installing its Powerwall home power storage batteries in Japan next spring, the U.S. electric car and battery maker said on Tuesday, marking the product's debut in Asia.

Description: Uber Technologies Inc and Lyft Inc declined to appear on Wednesday at a U.S. House of Representatives hearing on issues relating to the ride-hailing industry, a congressional committee said.

Headlines: H&M shares surge after first quarterly profit rise in two years
Description: Sweden's H&M  posted its first rise in quarterly pretax profit in more than two years on Thursday as the world's second-biggest fashion retailer said its drive to meet rapid changes in the market were on track.

Headlines: Advertising blitz, sugar-free Gatorade drive PepsiCo profit beat
Description: PepsiCo Inc  benefited from an ad blitz in the third quarter, beating profit and sales estimates, as more health-conscious consumers bought its low-calorie beverages and snacks in North America.

Headlines: Uber makes JFK airport helicopter taxis available to all users
Description: Ride-hailing company Uber Technologies Inc  is taking to the air in New York City where users with a little cash to spare will soon be able to book helicopter flights to John F. Kennedy International airport through their apps.

Headlines: BlackRock program to test tools to boost saving by individuals
Description: BlackRock Inc  has teamed up with Mastercard Inc , United Parcel Service Inc  and Etsy Inc  among other organizations, to build and test tools to help individuals start saving for emergencies.

Headlines: Embraer delays timeline for close of Boeing deal to early 2020
Description: Brazilian planemaker Embraer  has delayed its expected timeline for the closing of a major deal with Boeing  to early 2020, according to a securities filing on Thursday.

Headlines: U.S. widens trade war with tariffs on European planes, cheese, whisky to punish subsidies
Description: The United States on Wednesday said it would slap 10% tariffs on European-made Airbus  planes and 25% duties on French wine, Scotch and Irish whiskies, and cheese from across the continent as punishment for illegal EU aircraft subsidies.

Headlines: U.S. hits Scotch whisky, Italian cheese, French wine with 25% tariffs
Description: The Trump administration slapped 25% tariffs on French wine, Italian cheese and single-malt Scotch whisky -- but spared Italian wine, pasta and olive oil -- in retaliation for European Union subsidies on large aircraft.

Headlines: Airbus plant in Alabama spared fallout from U.S. tariffs
Description: Alabama aerospace workers won an unexpected reprieve from escalating trade tensions on Wednesday when the United States spared an Airbus plant in the state from the impact of tariffs against the European planemaker - at least for now.

Headlines: Britain disappointed at U.S. tariff plans: PM Johnson spokesman
Description: Britain is disappointed by U.S. government's plans to slap tariffs on European-made Airbus  planes and duties on Scotch whiskies, Prime Minister Boris Johnson's spokesman said.

Headlines: Scotland says U.S. tariff move shows UK's Brexit pipe dream
Description: The Scottish government said on Thursday that the imposition of U.S. tariffs on various goods including Scottish whisky indicated that the United Kingdom could not offset the damage from Brexit by striking a trade deal with U.S. President Donald Trump.

Headlines: Factbox: Planes, cheese, whisky and wine on U.S. tariff target list
Description: The World Trade Organization opened the door on Wednesday for the United States to impose tariffs on $7.5 billion European goods over subsidies for Airbus .

Headlines: Court strikes down ruling forcing Volkswagen to pay Czech customers damages: report
Description: The Prague City Court ruled on Thursday to invalidate an order for Volkswagen  to pay Czech customers more than 500 million crowns ($21.27 million) in damages for the Dieselgate affair, news website www.idnes.cz reported.

Headlines: U.S. skies still bright for Main Street banks even as Wall Street frets
Description: The view from Wall Street may be all trade wars, tariffs and uncertainty these days, but ask a Main Street banker and things  are pretty darn good.

Headlines: U.S. tariffs to hit 500 million euros of Italian food exports: farmers group
Description: U.S. tariffs on European Union products will hit around 500 million euros ($547.40 million) of Italian agricultural products per year, farmers' association Coldiretti said on Thursday.

Headlines: UK says seeking confirmation from WTO it has complied with rulings
Description: Britain said on Thursday it was seeking confirmation from the World Trade Organization that it had complied fully with its rulings and should not be facing tariffs.

Headlines: Trump on WTO case: 'This case going on for years, a nice victory!'
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday hailed a "nice victory" after the World Trade Organization gave Washington a green light to impose tariffs on $7.5 billion worth of EU goods annually as punishment for illegal aircraft subsidies.

Headlines: Tokio Marine to buy U.S. insurer Pure Group for about $3 billion
Description: Tokio Marine Holdings Inc  will buy insurer Pure Group for about $3.1 billion, it said on Thursday, marking its fourth sizable acquisition in the United States in a little over a decade.

Headlines: Axon boosts encryption, weighs blockchain to tackle body-cam 'deepfakes'
Description: Axon Enterprise Inc, the leading maker of U.S. police body cameras, began shipping new devices last week with security upgrades it says could aid in thwarting and discrediting "deepfake" videos.

Headlines: U.S. tariffs on EU products to affect $1 billion euros of Spanish exports: farmers' association
Description: U.S. tariffs on European Union products would affect around 1 billion euros ($1.10 billion) of Spanish agricultural products per year, Spanish agricultural association COAG said on Thursday.

Headlines: U.S. committee seeks to interview Boeing engineer on safety of 737 MAX
Description: A U.S. panel has asked Boeing Co  to make an engineer available for an interview after reports that the worker filed an internal ethics complaint on 737 MAX's safety and that the planemaker convinced the regulator to relax safety standards.

Headlines: Scotch Whisky Association says tariffs will hurt Scotland, urges restraint
Description: A move by the United States to slap a 25% tariff on single malt Scotch whisky will damage the industry and hurt jobs and investment in Scotland, the sector's trade association said on Thursday, as it urged restraint on all sides.

Headlines: Ted Baker shares battered after CEO flags dire UK retail climate
Description: Shares in Ted Baker  shed more than a third of their value on Thursday, after the British fashion retailer's second profit warning in four months on the back of what new boss Lindsay Page called the worst business conditions in decades.

Headlines: European luxury, drink stocks lifted by U.S. tariffs relief
Description: European luxury goods and drinks company shares rose on Thursday after new U.S. tariffs in retaliation over EU aircraft subsidies excluded cognac, champagne and leather goods.

Headlines: France and EU ready to respond with sanctions in U.S. trade dispute: French minister
Description: France and the European Union (EU) are ready to respond "with sanctions" if the United States were to reject the hand extended by Europe in the Airbus  trade dispute, said French Finance Minister Bruno Le Maire said on Thursday.

Headlines: Uber launches app aimed at connecting workers with businesses
Description: Ride-hailing firm Uber Technologies Inc  said it launched an app called Uber Works to connect temporary workers looking to work shifts with businesses trying to plug gaps in their rosters.

Headlines: WTO meeting to adopt Airbus subsidies decision set for October 14
Description: The World Trade Organization (WTO) will hold a special meeting of its Dispute Settlement Body at the request of the United States on Oct. 14 to adopt its arbitration decision in the Airbus  subsidies case, a WTO spokesman said on Thursday.

Headlines: Italy prosecutors open Netflix tax evasion investigation: source
Description: Italian prosecutors have opened an investigation into alleged tax evasion targeting U.S. streaming service Netflix, a source with direct knowledge of the matter said on Thursday.

Headlines: As protests rack Hong Kong, China watchdog has Cathay staff 'walking on eggshells'
Description: Staff at Cathay Pacific Airways , Hong Kong's flagship airline, are on edge.

Headlines: Turkey fines Facebook $282,000 over privacy breach
Description: Turkish authorities have fined Facebook Inc  1.6 million lira ($282,000) for violation of data protection laws which affected nearly 300,000 people, the Personal Data Protection Board (KVKK) said on Thursday.

Headlines: Stocks on tenterhooks as U.S. recession signs build
Description: A wake-up call from the U.S. heartland has spooked Wall Street by raising fears of a recession that will push equities into a correction.

Headlines: UK to fly back another 5,000 people on Thursday after Thomas Cook collapse
Description: The British Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) said 25 flights are scheduled to fly on Thursday to return another 5,000 people to the country in the tenth day of the repatriation operation following the collapse of travel group Thomas Cook.

Headlines: Chevron's shale allies are its secret weapon in Exxon race
Description: U.S. oil company Chevron Corp  is turning to joint ventures and drilling alliances in its bid to dominate the Permian Basin after abandoning a takeover that would have made it the leading producer in the world's biggest shale field.

Headlines: Walmart to test programs for U.S. workers to cut its healthcare costs
Description: Walmart Inc  said on Thursday it will begin several healthcare pilot programs for its U.S. employees starting Jan. 1 as it looks for ways to cut healthcare costs - one of the largest expenses for the retailer after wages.

Headlines: Exclusive: Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs poised to lead Airbnb's listing - sources
Description: Short-term home rental company Airbnb Inc is set to hire Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs Group Inc as joint lead advisers on its planned stock market flotation next year, people familiar with the matter said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Amazon.com brings Alexa to Brazil, kicks off pre-orders for devices
Description: Amazon.com Inc will launch its virtual assistant Alexa in Brazil starting this month, with plans for three different devices with the software installed, as it rapidly expands operations in Latin America's largest economy.

Headlines: Any errors in arrest of Huawei CFO were technical, Canadian government tells court
Description: Any errors in the arrest of Huawei Technologies Co Ltd's Chief Financial Officer Meng Wanzhou in Canada last December were technical in nature and do not meet the requirements to suspend her extradition proceedings to the United States, government lawyers said in court on Wednesday.

Headlines: Troubles with Tesla's automated parking feature summon safety regulators
Description: U.S. regulators are looking into parking lot crashes involving Tesla Inc  cars driving themselves to their owners using the company's Smart Summon feature, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Tesla deliveries miss Wall Street estimates; shares fall 6%
Description: Electric car company Tesla Inc said on Wednesday its deliveries rose less than 2% in the third quarter, missing Wall Street estimates and sending its shares down nearly 6% in trading after the bell.

Headlines: Investors keep their faith in Hong Kong markets despite protests
Description: As anti-government protesters fought pitched battles with police in Hong Kong streets last week, a group of bankers in another part of the city were busy taking in billions for the public float of the Asia unit of the world's largest brewer.

Headlines: GoPro cuts second-half outlook citing Hero8 shipment issues
Description: GoPro Inc  on Wednesday cut its revenue and profit forecasts for the rest of the year, hit by a delay in production of its latest Hero8 Black cameras, triggering a 19% drop in its shares.

Headlines: Brazil telecom carrier Oi may consider selling mobile operation: executive
Description: Brazilian telecom carrier Oi SA  may consider selling its mobile operation if it gets attractive offers, Chief Operating Officer Rodrigo Abreu told Reuters on Wednesday, following reports of interest from its largest rivals.

Headlines: Kroger to layoff several store employees
Description: Kroger Co  is looking to lay off several store employees holding middle management roles, amidst the supermarket chain's push to improve delivery and in-store technology to attract shoppers.

Headlines: U.S. to hit EU with tariffs of 10% on aircraft, 25% on other goods: official
Description: The United States will impose 10% tariffs on aircraft and 25% on other industrial and agricultural products from the European Union as part of a World Trade Organization penalty award in a long-running aircraft subsidy case, an official with the U.S. Trade Representative's office said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Wall Street tumbles as trade war threatens U.S. economy
Description: Wall Street's main indexes suffered their sharpest one-day declines in nearly six weeks on Wednesday after employment and manufacturing data suggested that the U.S.-China trade war is taking an increasing toll on the U.S. economy.

Headlines: U.S. orders speedy checks for cracks on 165 Boeing 737 NG planes
Description: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration said on Wednesday that aircraft operators must inspect 165 Boeing 737 NG airliners for structural cracks within seven days after the issue was found on a small number of planes.

Headlines: Global stocks fall to lowest in month on U.S. growth worries
Description: World equity benchmarks hit their lowest levels in a month on Wednesday as signs of a slowdown in U.S. economic growth and weak earnings in Europe fanned fears that the U.S.-China trade war could push the global economy into a recession.

Headlines: Short sellers circle cannabis stocks as profits dwindle
Description: Wall Street's love of cannabis appears to be going up in smoke as vaping-related ailments and missed revenue projections are prompting short sellers to raise their bets against the industry, fund managers and analysts said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Delta says new U.S. tariffs on Airbus will hurt profits, inflict 'serious harm'
Description: Delta Air Lines Inc  warned on Wednesday that new U.S. tariffs on Airbus  planes "will inflict serious harm on U.S. airlines" and shrink the company's profits.

Headlines: Oil slides 2% as U.S. inventories build, weak economic data weighs
Description: Oil prices fell more than 2% on Wednesday after official data showed a rise in U.S. crude inventories, adding to worries about an oversupplied market as weak economic readings in the United States depressed global financial markets.

Headlines: Pompeo says U.S. tariffs after WTO ruling could include cheese, wine

Headlines: Florida joins Justice Department settlement with Sprint, T-Mobile
Description: Florida has signed on to a consent agreement that the Justice Department reached with Sprint Corp and T-Mobile US Inc to allow the companies to merge, according to a court filing on Wednesday.

Headlines: U.S. set to quickly widen trade war with EU tariffs after WTO ruling: sources
Description: The United States' top trade body is likely to release a list of European goods subject to new tariffs Wednesday afternoon, after the World Trade Organization's landmark ruling on illegal aircraft subsidies, industry sources said.

Headlines: Analysts cut estimates for Exxon's third-quarter profit on weaker oil prices
Description: Analysts on Wednesday trimmed their profit estimates for Exxon Mobil Corp  after the largest publicly traded oil producer pointed to weaker third-quarter results in a regulatory filing due to weaker oil prices and chemicals margins.

Headlines: Pick-up trucks remain mainstay for Detroit Three in third quarter
Description: The Big Three U.S. automakers on Wednesday reported a rise in sales of pick-up trucks for the third quarter as lower interest rates boosted demand in an otherwise sluggish auto market.

Headlines: Slowing U.S. private hiring adds to gloom over economy
Description: Hiring by U.S. private employers slowed further in September, suggesting that trade tensions, which have pressured manufacturing, could be spilling over to the labor market.

Headlines: ASOS shakes up board to revive fortunes
Description: Online fashion retailer ASOS Plc on Wednesday revamped its board by naming several new directors, including Ocado Solutions Chief Executive Officer Luke Jensen, as it looks to bounce back from a string of profit warnings.

Headlines: London forex trader sues Citigroup over 'malicious' forex prosecution
Description: A London-based former Citigroup  trader is suing the U.S. bank for more than $112 million, alleging it made materially false and malicious statements to U.S. prosecutors that led to his trial in New York on foreign exchange-rigging charges.

Headlines: Johnson & Johnson settles Ohio lawsuits to avoid federal trial
Description: Johnson & Johnson said on Tuesday it will pay $20.4 million to settle claims by two Ohio counties, allowing the U.S. healthcare giant to avoid an upcoming federal trial seeking to hold the industry responsible for the nation's opioid epidemic.

Headlines: Job done - Tesco boss to quit next year
Description: Tesco  boss Dave Lewis, credited with saving Britain's biggest retailer from collapse in 2014, will step down next summer after declaring its turnaround complete, handing over to a relative unknown catapulted into one of the sector's top jobs.

Headlines: German businesses urge EU to protect them after latest WTO decision
Description: Germany's DIHK chambers of commerce on Wednesday urged the European Union to act strongly in order to protect their interests in a tariff row between the EU and the United States, reacting to the World Trade Organization's (WTO) latest decision.

Headlines: Britain says tariffs are no answer to Airbus dispute after WTO ruling
Description: Britain said tariffs were in no-one's interest and should not be applied to the UK after a ruling by the World Trade Organization on Wednesday that the United States could target $7.5 billion of imports from the European Union over illegal subsidies for planemaker Airbus.

Headlines: Website that allowed Huawei phones to install Google apps taken down
Description: A China-based website that allowed for manual installation of Google's Android apps on Huawei's newly launched Mate 30 devices went offline on Wednesday after a security researcher highlighted the "backdoor" to sidestep a U.S. ban.

Headlines: France ready to hit back if U.S. sanctions EU imports: minister
Description: France is ready to retaliate if the United States goes ahead with trade sanctions on EU imports, its finance minister said on Wednesday after Washington won WTO backing for the measures.

Headlines: WTO decision will weigh on Airbus, Germany's Merkel says
Description: A decision by the World Trade Organisation (WTO) allowing the United States to target goods imported from the European Union over illegal subsidies to Airbus  will weigh on the planemaker, German Chancellor Angela Merkel said on Wednesday.

Description: Airbus  on Wednesday urged talks to reduce trade tensions after the World Trade Organization gave the United States approval to impose tariffs on $7.5 billion worth of European goods over illegal EU subsidies handed to Airbus.

Description: The United States will learn on Wednesday the annual value of European Union goods it is allowed to target with tariffs as part of a 15-year-old dispute at the World Trade Organization over illegal subsidies to the world's largest planemakers.

Headlines: Timeline: Highlights of the 15-year Airbus, Boeing trade war
Description: The World Trade Organization is poised on Wednesday to open the door to hefty U.S. tariffs on European goods over illegal subsidies for Airbus, pushing a 15-year-old row over support for plane giants to the center of fraught global trade relations.

Headlines: WTO awards U.S. right to hit 7.5 billion of EU goods over Airbus subsidies
Description: The World Trade Organization ruled on Wednesday that the United States could target $7.5 billion of imports from the European Union over illegal subsidies for planemaker Airbus.

Headlines: EU says U.S. tariffs linked to Airbus would be counterproductive
Description: The European Commission said on Wednesday that a U.S. move to impose trade sanctions on EU imports would be short-sighted and counterproductive and risked causing damage on both sides of the Atlantic.

Headlines: Renault chairman auditions narrowed field of Nissan CEO candidates
Description: The Nissan Motor Co  CEO race has narrowed to a contest between three Renault-Nissan veterans, with Renault's chairman conducting interviews ahead of a Renault-Nissan alliance meeting scheduled for Wednesday, people familiar with the matter said.

Headlines: Citi says prospects for a Brexit deal look weak so brace for delay
Description: U.S. investment bank Citi said the Brexit proposals of British Prime Minister Boris Johnson appeared to fall foul of European Union red lines so an extension and election were likely.

Headlines: U.S. SEC proposes exchanges seek public consultation on data fee changes
Description: The U.S. securities regulator on Tuesday proposed a change to the way exchange operators alter their fees, in a move aimed at improving transparency but which could make it harder for operators to compete on price to propel revenue growth.

Headlines: London court allows mass claim against Google over iPhone data
Description: London's Court of Appeal gave the go-ahead for action against Google  over claims it collected data from more than 4 million iPhone users, overturning a ruling in 2018 that in effect blocked any route to legal redress.

Headlines: CIS-based firm Freedom Holding plans NASDAQ listing
Description: Freedom Holding Corp, a U.S. holding companies with subsidiaries that provide services to financial markets in Eastern Europe and Central Asia, has gained approval to list on New York's NASDAQ Capital Markets exchange, it said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Samsung ends mobile phone production in China
Description: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd  has ended mobile telephone production in China, it said on Wednesday, hurt by intensifying competition from domestic rivals in the world's biggest smartphone market.

Headlines: WeWork Japan gets new CEO, days after We Company founder quits
Description: WeWork Japan on Wednesday named a new head of local operations, just days after the co-founder of the We Company stepped down following a botched attempt to gain a stock market listing.

Headlines: Paddy Power and Poker Stars owners to create online gambling leader
Description: The owner of Paddy Power Betfair has agreed to buy the company behind Poker Stars in a $6 billion share deal to create the world's largest online betting and gambling company by revenue,  seeking to take advantage of the opening up of U.S. markets.

Headlines: Tesla's China production to start, eyes on mass production timing: sources
Description: Tesla Inc's  China factory aims to start production this month but it is unclear when it will meet year-end production targets due to uncertainties around orders, labor and suppliers, sources with knowledge of the matter said.

Headlines: Softbank names Ralf Wenzel to oversee joint ventures in Latin America
Description: Japan's Softbank Group Corp  named entrepreneur Ralf Wenzel as chief executive at its Latin American Tech Hub, with the goal of creating joint ventures among Softbank-backed companies in an effort to expand in the region.

Headlines: Volkswagen registers unit in Turkey ahead of production decision
Description: Volkswagen  has established a subsidiary in Turkey's western Manisa province, the country's Trade Registry Gazette showed on Wednesday, as the company nears a final decision on the location for its new production plant.

Headlines: Veteran investor Gilbert to leave Standard Life Aberdeen
Description: Veteran investor Martin Gilbert will leave Standard Life Aberdeen  next year, ending a career spanning more than three decades at the helm of one of Britain's most successful asset managers.

Headlines: Credit Suisse says risk calculation, hedging change to reap $250 million
Description: Credit Suisse  on Wednesday said it expects an estimated $250 million boost in annual profit from higher net interest income it expects to reap by calculating risk-weighted assets in dollars rather than Swiss francs.

Headlines: UK to fly back another 7,100 people on Wed after Thomas Cook collapse
Description: UK's Civil Aviation Authority said 44 flights are scheduled to fly on Wednesday to bring back 7,100 people back to the country, following the collapse of travel firm Thomas Cook.

Headlines: Goldman Sachs reshuffles Asia M&A leadership as John Kim joins Carlyle - memo

Headlines: Juul hires Altria executive to handle regulation amid vaping crisis
Description: Juul Labs Inc on Tuesday hired the head of regulatory affairs at its part-owner Altria Group Inc to take on a similar role at the e-cigarette maker, amid a regulatory backlash against the growth of teen vaping in the United States.

Headlines: Too big to lend? JPMorgan cash hit Fed limits, roiling U.S. repos
Description: JPMorgan Chase & Co  has become so big that some rival banks and analysts say changes to its $2.7 trillion balance sheet were a factor in a spike last month in the U.S. "repo" market, which is crucial to many borrowers.

Headlines: Weak oil prices hit Exxon's third-quarter earnings: filing
Description: Exxon Mobil Corp's  operating profits fell last quarter for the fourth consecutive period, according to a regulatory filing on Tuesday that showed all three of its major businesses slumping from a year ago.

Headlines: Visa, Mastercard reconsider backing Facebook's Libra: WSJ
Description: Visa , Mastercard Inc  and other key financial partners may reconsider their involvement in Facebook Inc's  cryptocurrency, Libra, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.

Headlines: UAW rejects new GM offer as strike forces 6,000 Mexico layoffs

Headlines: WeWork weighs pullback in China as part of cost cuts: WSJ
Description: WeWork's parent The We Company's new management team is considering curbing its expansion plans in China as part of the company's new emphasis on controlling costs, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

Headlines: Fitch downgrades WeWork after aborted IPO leaves financing hole
Description: Global credit rating agency Fitch Ratings on Tuesday downgraded WeWork's credit rating by two notches to "CCC+", putting the Softbank-backed office-sharing firm deep into junk territory a day after it abandoned an initial public offering.

Headlines: U.S. manufacturing dives to 10-year low as trade tensions weigh
Description: U.S. manufacturing activity tumbled to a more than 10-year low in September as lingering trade tensions weighed on exports, further heightening financial market fears of a sharp slowdown in economic growth in the third quarter.

Headlines: Wall Street tumbles as factory activity hits 10-year low
Description: The S&P 500 and Dow suffered their worst tumbles in over a month on Tuesday after data showed U.S. factory activity shrank in September to its weakest in over a decade, ratcheting up fears that the U.S.-China trade war is hobbling the world's largest economy.

Headlines: Deere to lay off 163 U.S. workers as trade war dents equipment demand
Description: Deere & Co  on Tuesday announced indefinite layoffs for 163 U.S. manufacturing workers at plants in Illinois and Iowa that make agricultural, forestry and construction equipment, citing decreased customer demand.

Headlines: Oil prices slip as U.S. economic data weakens demand outlook
Description: Oil futures sank on Tuesday as weak U.S. economic data dimmed crude's demand outlook and pressured prices, while reports of a third-quarter decline in output from the world's largest oil producers kept oil from falling further.

Headlines: Exclusive: Comcast emerges as new Google antitrust foe - sources
Description: Comcast Corp, one of America’s largest media and communications companies, is wading into the epic regulatory pile-on against big tech companies such as Google, according to people familiar with the matter.

Headlines: Fears of U.S. slowdown weigh on stocks; bonds rally
Description: Weak economic data in the United States and Europe weighed on global stock benchmarks on Tuesday, sending investors into safe-haven assets.

Headlines: American Airlines pilots demand compensation over Boeing 737 MAX grounding
Description: American Airlines Group's  pilots want compensation for  lost pay stemming from flights canceled as a result of the Boeing 737 MAX grounding, the head of the airline's pilot union said on Tuesday.

Headlines: UAW rejects new GM offer, makes new counterproposal
Description: The United Auto Workers union said a new comprehensive offer made by General Motors Co late Monday to end a two-week-old strike was not acceptable and said it had made a new counterproposal.

Headlines: Exclusive: Italian prosecutors widen probe over safety of Atlantia-operated bridges - sources
Description: Italian prosecutors have widened an inquiry into suspected safety breaches at subsidiaries of Atlantia ATL.MI to include more employees and viaducts than they identified last month, two sources close to the investigation told Reuters.

Headlines: Big drone on campus: UPS gets U.S. government okay for drone airline
Description: United Parcel Service Inc on Tuesday said it won the U.S. government's first full approval to operate a drone airline, which gave it a lead in the nascent U.S. drone delivery business over rivals Amazon.com Inc and Alphabet Inc.

Headlines: U.S. September auto sales fall as shift in Labor Day holiday hurts
