Headlines: Oil rises on expectations of Fed rate cut, another U.S crude drawdown
Description: Oil prices rose about 2% to a two-week high on Tuesday on optimism the U.S. Federal Reserve will cut interest rates this week for the first time in more than 10 years, boosting demand expectations in the world's biggest oil user.

Headlines: Trump says he will seek U.S. trade accord with Brazil
Description: President Donald Trump on Tuesday said he will pursue a U.S. trade agreement with Brazil, suggesting a friendly relationship with President Jair Bolsonaro could help lower trade barriers between the two biggest economies in the Americas.

Headlines: Huawei warns on U.S. ban after China smartphone sales drive first-half revenue
Description: Chinese tech giant Huawei Technologies warned on Tuesday a U.S. trade blacklisting will impact short-term revenue growth, even as its half-year revenue surged 23% thanks to soaring smartphone sales at home.

Headlines: Shares in plant-based burger maker Beyond Meat slide on stock offering
Description: Shares in meat alternatives company Beyond Meat  slid on Tuesday, a day after the company known for its pea-based burgers and sausages announced a stock offering plan to raise capital just three months after going public.

Headlines: P&G posts strong sales, takes $8 billion Gillette writedown
Description: Procter & Gamble Co's  quarterly revenue and adjusted profit beat Wall Street expectations on Tuesday, sending shares to a record-high even as the world's No.1 personal goods company took an $8 billion charge on its Gillette shaving business.

Headlines: Moderate U.S. consumer spending, inflation back Fed rate cut
Description: U.S. consumer spending and prices rose moderately in June, pointing to slower economic growth and benign inflation that could see the Federal Reserve cutting interest rates on Wednesday for the first time in a decade.

Headlines: Cancer drug Keytruda, vaccines propel Merck to quarterly profit beat
Description: Merck & Co Inc  reported better-than-expected second-quarter results on Tuesday and raised its full-year earnings forecast on strong demand for its blockbuster cancer immunotherapy Keytruda and vaccines.

Headlines: Under Armour sales growth in North America trails Nike again; shares sink
Description: Sportswear maker Under Armour Inc   on Tuesday cut its full-year revenue forecast for North America as demand at its stores and online faced pressure from relentless competition from bigger rivals Nike and Adidas.

Headlines: Sony surprises with record profit as image sensor demand offsets weak gaming
Description: Japan's Sony Corp  surprised the market by reporting on Tuesday a record first-quarter operating profit despite the slowing gaming business, as strong demand for multiple-lens camera systems for smartphones boosted sales of image sensors.

Headlines: Newer drugs help Eli Lilly top Wall Street quarterly profit estimate
Description: Eli Lilly and Co  reported a second-quarter profit that topped Wall Street estimates and raised its 2019 earnings forecast on Tuesday, as higher demand for newer drugs offset increased discounts for the U.S. Medicare program and sales declines of medicines that lost patent protection.

Headlines: Xerox cuts full-year revenue forecast, shares fall
Description: Xerox Corp  posted a better-than-expected quarterly profit on Tuesday, but cut its full-year revenue forecast citing organizational changes, primarily in North America.

Headlines: Under fire, Swiss minister dumps Philip Morris as Expo sponsor
Description: Switzerland scrapped a 1.8 million Swiss franc ($1.8 million) sponsorship deal with Philip Morris International  for the country's pavilion at Expo 2020 in Dubai after being widely criticized for taking tobacco money to promote its image abroad.

Headlines: Ralph Lauren hints at weakness in North America business, shares fall
Description: Ralph Lauren Corp  said on Tuesday it expects full-year sales in North America to be pressured by a tough retail environment and weakness in spending by foreign tourists, overshadowing upbeat quarterly earnings and sending its shares down about 4%.

Headlines: D.R. Horton expects lower incentive spending to boost margins
Description: No.1 U.S. homebuilder D.R. Horton Inc  on Tuesday said it expects lower incentive spending and strong buyer demand to benefit margins, sending its shares up about 6%.

Headlines: Ralph Lauren says North America sales to come under pressure; shares fall
Description: Ralph Lauren Corp  said it expects sales in North America for the rest of the year to be pressured by a tough retail environment and weakness in spending by foreign tourists, sending its shares down about 4%.

Headlines: U.S. pending home sales increase more than expected in June
Description: Contracts to buy previously owned homes rose more than expected in June, the National Association of Realtors said on Tuesday in a report that showed lower mortgage rates could be giving support to the housing market.

Headlines: Capital One says information of over 100 million individuals in U.S., Canada hacked
Description: Capital One Financial Corp  said on Monday that personal information including names and addresses of about 100 million individuals in the United States and 6 million people in Canada were obtained by a hacker who has been arrested.

Headlines: New York attorney general to probe Capital One data breach
Description: New York's attorney general on Tuesday said her office will begin an immediate investigation into Capital One Financial Corp's  data breach, which the bank said involved the access of personal information belonging to about 100 million people in the United States.

Headlines: Bayer sees glyphosate settlement only if financially reasonable
Description: Bayer on Tuesday said it would consider settling with U.S. plaintiffs suing over the German group's Roundup herbicide only on reasonable terms, and if such a move wraps up all cases.

Headlines: Goodyear plant conditions raise concerns about Mexican labor reforms: U.S. lawmakers
Description: A group of U.S. Democratic lawmakers on Monday criticized Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co  for refusing to let them visit its Mexican plant, and said poor conditions there raised questions about Mexican labor reforms seen as key to ensuring passage of a new U.S.-Mexico-Canada trade agreement.

Headlines: ConocoPhillips profit misses on lower crude prices, higher spending
Description: ConocoPhillips  missed Wall Street estimates for quarterly profit on Tuesday as it spent more than expected and took a hit from lower crude prices due to fears of a slowing global economy.

Headlines: Brazil Embraer's deliveries of commercial jets continue to fall in second quarter
Description: Brazil planemaker Embraer  delivered 26 commercial planes in the second quarter of 2019, down from 28 planes in the same period of 2018 and 35 in 2017, the company said in a securities filing on Tuesday.

Headlines: BP profit again outstrips forecasts, lifted by higher oil output
Description: A strong rise in oil and gas production helped BP  offset weaker crude prices and refining profit to again beat profit expectations on Tuesday, boosting its shares.

Headlines: Swiss help Japan's investigation into ex-Renault-Nissan boss Ghosn
Description: Swiss prosecutors said on Tuesday they are assisting Japanese authorities in their investigation into former Renault  and Nissan Motor  boss Carlos Ghosn, who faces charges of fraud and misconduct.

Headlines: Higher consumer spending helps Mastercard beat quarterly profit estimates
Description: Mastercard Inc  on Tuesday beat Wall Street estimates for quarterly profit, as a robust economy encouraged customers to spend more, boosting fee income for the world's second-largest payment processor.

Headlines: Texas shale pioneers struggle to appease investors
Description: Seven years ago, Diamondback Energy Inc went public with a modest parcel of drillable land in the Permian Basin of West Texas.

Headlines: U.S., China move trade talks to Shanghai amid deal pessimism
Description: U.S. and Chinese trade negotiators shift to Shanghai this week for their first in-person talks since a G20 truce last month, a change of scenery for two sides struggling to resolve deep differences on how to end a year-long trade war.

Headlines: Brazil oil block auction looks very expensive: BP CEO
Description: Brazil's closely-watched auction of offshore oil blocks looks "very expensive" and BP  has yet to decide if it will take part in it, Chief Executive Officer Bob Dudley said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Exxon Mobil's second-quarter results expected to sag, spotlighting need for asset sales
Description: Exxon Mobil Corp's  plan to accelerate asset sales, a way of delivering needed cash to finance shareholder returns and major projects, is getting off to a slow start as oil companies pull back on big deals.

Headlines: Lufthansa braces for more challenges after price war hits earnings
Description: German airline Lufthansa  said it was braced for very tough price competition with Ryanair  and easyJet  for at least the rest of this year as it reported a plunge in second-quarter earnings on Tuesday.

Headlines: Bayer says 2019 profit goal becoming a stretch
Description: Germany's Bayer has warned that its 2019 earnings target has become harder to reach, becoming the latest agricultural supplies company to be affected by flooded U.S. farms and trade disputes.

Headlines: BP has no plans to take its tankers through Hormuz
Description: BP  has not taken any of its oil tankers through the Strait of Hormuz since a July 10 attempt by Iran to seize one of its vessels, the British company's Chief Financial Officer Brian Gilvary said on Tuesday.

Headlines: U.S. firms see little clarity on Huawei as U.S.-China talks resume
Description: A month after President Donald Trump said he would allow U.S. companies to resume selling to blacklisted Chinese telecommunications giant Huawei, his administration has done little to clarify what sales will be permitted.

Headlines: Telecoms lobby demands access to high-band spectrum for 5G
Description: The global telecoms industry on Tuesday demanded access to the high-capacity spectrum it says it needs to support data-intensive 5G services, accusing the space lobby of hogging frequencies in a way that could stunt the technology.

Headlines: Huawei outsells smartphone rivals in China, tightens market grip amid U.S. spat
Description: China's Huawei Technologies cemented its dominance of the domestic smartphone market in the second quarter, with shipments and market share rising, as Chinese customers backed the embattled firm amid its trade fight with the United States.

Headlines: Beyond Meat shares crumble on stock offering surprise, demand for meatless burgers soars
Description: Beyond Meat Inc's  shares tumbled on Monday on plans for another stock offering just three months after its IPO while demand for its plant-based burgers and sausages prompted an increase in its full-year sales forecast.

Headlines: As trade war bites, China's factories set for third month of shrinking activity: Reuters poll
Description: Factory activity in China is expected to have contracted for the third month in a row in July, a Reuters poll showed, underlining the intensifying strains on the world's second-biggest economy from a protracted trade war with the United States.

Headlines: Khazanah, Temasek to sell part of joint Singapore property for about $1.2 billion
Description: A joint venture between Malaysia sovereign wealth fund Khazanah and Singapore state investor Temasek is selling the office and retail units of its DUO property development in Singapore, it said late on Monday.

Headlines: Trade jitters running high at U.S. companies ahead of new U.S.-China talks
Description: Worries about the U.S.-China trade war are running high during the current U.S. quarterly reporting season, with companies as diverse as Juniper Networks and O'Reilly Automotive bemoaning the consequences but saying they are finding ways to weather the storm.

Headlines: Ex-Seattle tech worker arrested for Capital One hack - U.S. Justice Department
Description: The U.S. Justice Department said Paige Thompson, a former Seattle technology company software engineer, was arrested on Monday on a criminal complaint charging computer fraud and abuse for hacking into stored data of Capital One Financial Corp .

Headlines: J&J says FTC probing efforts to protect arthritis drug Remicade
Description: The Federal Trade Commission issued civil subpoenas to Johnson and Johnson in June as part of an investigation into whether contracting practices for its blockbuster rheumatoid arthritis drug, Remicade, violated antitrust laws, the company said in a regulatory filing on Monday.

Headlines: Aircraft lessor BOC Aviation expects delayed delivery of up to 30 jets
Description: Aircraft lessor BOC Aviation Ltd  said on Tuesday it expected up to 30 Boeing Co  and Airbus SE  jets that had been scheduled to arrive this year could be delayed, primarily due to the Boeing 737 MAX grounding.

Headlines: Anadarko Petroleum sheds new light on Occidental finances ahead of vote
Description: Anadarko Petroleum Corp  on Monday released new financial details of its proposed combination with Occidental Petroleum  that revealed its acquirer did not expect to generate enough cash to cover its shareholder payments until 2022.

Headlines: LSE shares hit record high as investors cheer $27 billion Refinitiv bid
Description: London Stock Exchange Group Plc  shares rose more than 15% to a record high on Monday as investors cheered its $27 billion bid to buy financial data firm Refinitiv Holdings Ltd, in a deal that could transform the exchange operator into a global market infrastructure and data giant.

Headlines: Bank of America ends joint venture with Fiserv's First Data
Description: Bank of America Corp  said on Monday it would end its electronic payment services joint venture with First Data Corp next June, hours after Fiserv Inc  completed its acquisition of the payment processor.

Headlines: GM braces for attacks from Democrats in Detroit debates
Description: General Motors Co  is bracing for attacks from Democratic presidential candidates at two debates that begin on Tuesday in Detroit near its headquarters.

Headlines: Mylan deal puts future of its beleaguered EpiPen in spotlight
Description: Mylan NV's  planned merger with Pfizer Inc's  off-patent branded drugs business may have boosted its share price on Monday, but one of its most pressing problems remains: shortages of its flagship EpiPen emergency allergy treatment.

Headlines: Wall St. takes a pause in wait for Fed news, trade progress
Description: U.S. stocks stepped back from peak levels on Monday as investors took a breather as they anticipated a U.S. Federal Reserve interest rate cut this week and looked for signs of progress from U.S.-China trade negotiations, currently under way in Shanghai.

Headlines: Sterling slumps on 'no-deal Brexit' worries; stocks dip
Description: The British pound touched its lowest level in over two years against the dollar after Prime Minister Boris Johnson said a hard divorce from the EU was in the cards, while stocks dipped globally with Wall Street backing off record highs.

Headlines: Citi combines its stock trading and prime brokerage business
Description: Citigroup Inc  is combining its stock trading business with its prime brokerage unit, which caters to hedge funds, private equity firms and other investors.

Headlines: Uber lays off 400 employees in marketing team
Description: Ride-hailing company Uber Technologies Inc  said on Monday it laid off 400 people globally from its marketing team.

Headlines: Pfizer to spinoff, merge off-patent drugs unit with Mylan
Description: Pfizer Inc  has agreed to spin off its off-patent branded drugs business and combine it with generic drugmaker Mylan NV , a move that leaves Pfizer with its more profitable innovative drugs, including cancer treatment Ibrance and pneumonia vaccine Prevnar.

Headlines: Oil edges up on prospect of U.S. interest rate cut
Description: Oil prices rose on Monday as the prospect of an expected interest rate cut by the U.S. Federal Reserve overshadowed  pessimism over U.S.-China trade talks and worries about slower global economic growth.

Headlines: Germany's Bayer dealt new legal blow as more Brazil farmers challenge soy patent
Description: Germany's Bayer AG , which completed the takeover of U.S.-based Monsanto last year, has been dealt a legal blow in Brazil as more farmers joined a lawsuit challenging the protection of a key soy seed patent.

Headlines: Exclusive: India's SBI tightens lending terms for auto dealers - source, internal memo
Description: State Bank of India (SBI)  has tightened lending terms dramatically for auto dealerships, according to a source and an internal memo seen by Reuters, seeking to reduce its exposure to risk from a sector in the midst of a sharp downturn.

Headlines: Takeaway.com lands $10 billion Just Eat deal in food delivery race
Description: Amsterdam-based Takeaway.com  has agreed to buy Just Eat  in an 8.2 billion pound ($10.1 billion) deal to create the world's largest online food delivery firm outside China in a race to rule the $100 billion market.

Headlines: Activist investor Cat Rock calls Just Eat, Takeaway.com deal 'excellent news'
Description: Investment firm Cat Rock on Monday lauded Amsterdam-based Takeaway.com's  deal to buy Just Eat  in an 8.2 billion pound ($10.05 billion) deal to create one of the world's largest online food delivery firms.

Headlines: Alphabet, Starbucks drive Wall Street to record high
Description: (This July 26 story fixes spelling of company name in paragraph 12)

Headlines: FINRA fines Citigroup for loose background checks
Description: The Financial Industry Regulatory Authority said on Monday it has fined Citigroup's Global Markets business $1.25 million for failing to perform proper background checks on thousands of employees between 2010 and 2017.

Headlines: Barclays, JP Morgan among banks facing UK class action over forex-rigging
Description: Barclays , JP Morgan , RBS , UBS and Citigroup  are being sued by investors over allegations they rigged the global foreign exchange market, in a test of U.S.-style class actions in Britain.

Headlines: Exclusive: First big U.S. offshore wind project hits snag due to fishing-industry concerns
Description: Trump administration infighting is holding up approval of the first major U.S. offshore wind energy project, with agencies sparring over whether the proposal does enough to protect the fishing industry, according to interviews and agency documents.

Headlines: Diagnostic company Exact Sciences to buy Genomic Health in $2.8 billion deal
Description: Exact Sciences Corp  said on Monday it will buy peer Genomic Health Inc  for about $2.8 billion in cash and stock, expanding the cancer diagnostic company's testing capabilities to breast and prostate cancers.

Headlines: That bad? How the U.S. economy stacks up to past rate cut cycles
Description: Spooked by a global economic slowdown, the U.S. Federal Reserve is seen launching on Wednesday its fifth interest rate-cutting campaign since 1995. It will come despite many signs of strength in the U.S. economy.

Headlines: Amazon plans imminent launch of online food delivery service in India: sources
Description: Amazon.com Inc is planning a foray into the burgeoning online food delivery business in India this year, two sources aware of the development said, in a move that could raise competition in an increasingly crowded market.

Headlines: Heineken's beer boost offset by higher aluminum costs
Description: Heineken NV  on Monday missed estimates for first-half profits, as higher packaging costs offset increased beer sales, but the world's second-largest brewer stuck with its full-year profit growth forecast.

Headlines: Pfizer posts 30% rise in quarterly profit
Description: Pfizer Inc  on Monday reported a 30% rise in quarterly profit, helped by demand for its branded treatments such as Ibrance, Eliquis and Xeljanz.

Headlines: Exclusive: BlackRock in talks to take over Cofense after U.S. security concerns - sources
Description: BlackRock Inc , an investor in Cofense Inc, is in advanced talks to take over the U.S. cyber security firm, after a U.S. national security panel asked buyout firm Pamplona Capital Management LLP to sell its stake, people familiar with the matter said on Sunday.

Headlines: Top EU court rejects BMW appeal against limit on car plant aid
Description: The European Union's top court on Monday rejected an appeal by German carmaker BMW  against a European Commission decision to limit the state aid it could receive for a car plant in eastern Germany.

Headlines: Singapore's Scoot to convert six Airbus orders to larger A321neos, lease 10
Description: Singapore Airlines Ltd's  budget offshoot Scoot said on Monday it would convert six Airbus SE  A320neo orders to the larger A321neo model and lease another 10 A321neos to help meet the airline's growth goals.

Headlines: Grab commits $2 billion to Indonesia with SoftBank's backing
Description: Southeast Asian ride-hailing firm Grab on Monday said it will invest $2 billion into Indonesia over five years using capital from Japan's SoftBank Group Corp, marking its biggest commitment in the region's most populous market.

Headlines: Lufthansa considers holding structure: Handelsblatt
Description: German airline Lufthansa  is considering adopting a corporate holding structure to simplify its operations, improve profitability and regain the support of investors, newspaper Handelsblatt reported on Monday.

Headlines: As rural India develops taste for chocolate, a dominant Mondelez extends its reach
Description: Two years ago, Satish P., a bakery owner in the small village of Harohalli near Bengaluru, had his doubts about stocking Mondelez's  Cadbury Silk bars.

Headlines: From Belarus to Bahrain, the small states going big on cryptocurrency
Description: When Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko met entrepreneur Viktor Prokopenya in March 2017, their discussion was scheduled to last for an hour but went on for three times that long.

Headlines: LSE-Refinitiv deal faces long antitrust review: sources
Description: U.S. buyout fund Blackstone Group Inc  is expected to announce the merger of its majority-owned financial data firm Refinitiv with the London Stock Exchange Group Plc  within a week, but the deal is expected to face a long antitrust review before it can close, four sources told Reuters.

Headlines: LSE's bid for Refinitiv spotlights quest for data, globality
Description: London Stock Exchange Group Plc's  planned purchase of Refinitiv in a $27 billion deal is the latest sign that exchange operators are focusing more on data products to increase revenue, while also trying to expand their global reach.

Headlines: SABIC CEO says no interest in taking over Clariant
Description: Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC)  has no interest in taking over Swiss chemicals firm Clariant  and considers its 25% stake in the company as "a long term strategic investment," said its chief executive Yousef al-Benyan on Sunday.

Headlines: Exact Sciences in advanced talks to buy Genomic Health for $2.8 billion: Bloomberg
Description: Cancer diagnostics company Exact Sciences Corp  is in advanced negotiations to buy healthcare company Genomic Health Inc  for about $2.8 billion to strengthen its cancer testing, Bloomberg reported on Saturday.

Headlines: London Stock Exchange in talks to buy Refinitiv for $27 billion
Description: The London Stock Exchange Group Plc  said on Friday it was in discussions to acquire financial data analytics provider Refinitiv Holdings Ltd for $27 billion, including debt.

Headlines: Pfizer in talks to merge off-patent drugs business with Mylan: source
Description: Pfizer Inc  is in talks to merge its off-patent drugs business with Mylan NV  in a stock deal, according to a source familiar with the matter.

Headlines: Bosch sees car production falling 5% in 2019: report
Description: Auto supplier Robert Bosch has revised its forecast for automotive production on Saturday, expecting a 5% fall this year, bigger than an earlier estimate for a 3% decline, the company's chief financial officer told Boersen-Zeitung.

Headlines: Novartis CEO pledges not to sell Sandoz generics unit
Description: Novartis  Chief Executive Vas Narasimhan pledged in an interview published on Saturday not to sell the Swiss drugmaker's generics unit Sandoz amid a revamp that has prompted speculation he is preparing to offload the business.

Headlines: Trump's ambitious Fannie, Freddie overhaul faces hurdles
Description: President Donald Trump's administration faces a growing list of hurdles that could scuttle its ambitions to remove U.S. mortgage giants Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac from their government lifeline.

Headlines: Factbox: Fannie, Freddie and the government: it's complicated
Description: The Trump administration wants to take Fannie and Freddie out of government conservatorship, but doing so will be complicated due to the central role they play in the housing market and the Treasury's holdings in the two firms. [L2N24J0YC]

Headlines: U.S. Department of Justice approves T-Mobile, Sprint tie-up
Description: The U.S. Justice Department said it was greenlighting T-Mobile US Inc's request to acquire rival Sprint Corp after the companies agreed to divest Sprint's prepaid businesses including Boost Mobile to Dish Network Corp in an effort to create a new wireless competitor.

Headlines: U.S. to deny tariff relief for Apple Mac Pro parts from China: Trump
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday said his administration would not grant Apple Inc any relief for tariffs on parts made in China for its Mac Pro computer and later added he thought the firm would build a plant in Texas.

Headlines: Democrat calls for 'good faith' talks with USTR on USMCA trade deal
Description: The Democratic head of the U.S. House Ways and Means Committee on Friday called for "good faith" negotiations with the Trump administration to address concerns about the new U.S.-Mexico-Canada trade agreement and pave the way for its passage.

Headlines: LSE says it is in talks to buy Refinitiv for enterprise value of $27 billion
Description: The London Stock Exchange Group Plc  said on Saturday it was in talks to buy data analytics platform Refinitiv for a total enterprise value of about $27 billion by issuing new LSE Group shares.

Headlines: Sprint, T-Mobile win U.S. antitrust approval for $26 billion merger
Description: T-Mobile US Inc won U.S. antitrust approval for its $26 billion takeover of rival Sprint Corp, the Justice Department said Friday, clearing a major hurdle to a deal that merges the nation's third and fourth largest wireless carriers.

Headlines: Trump says he expects Apple to announce it will build plant in Texas
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday he wanted Apple Inc  to build its plants in the United States and expects the technology firm to announce it will build one in Texas.

Headlines: Anadarko Petroleum beats profit estimates on higher output
Description: Anadarko Petroleum Corp , in its last earnings report before shareholders vote on its sale to Occidental Petroleum , on Friday reported a quarterly profit that topped analysts' estimates, as higher production offset lower prices for its oil.

Headlines: U.S. economy slows in second quarter; weak business investment a red flag
Description: U.S. economic growth slowed less than expected in the second quarter as a surge in consumer spending blunted some of the drag from declining exports and a smaller inventory build, which could further allay concerns about the economy's health.

Headlines: Dish Network has tough road to become competitive mobile carrier
Description: Dish Network's  bid to become a fourth U.S. mobile carrier may cost billions more than it expected and pits it against corporate giants, but the satellite TV provider has an advantage in starting fresh with no legacy technology to maintain and deep-pocketed potential partners.

Headlines: S&P 500, Nasdaq hit record highs; dollar gains ground
Description: The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq closed at record levels and the dollar reached a two-month high on Friday as strong economic data and a string of upbeat earnings reports brought buyers back to the market.

Headlines: Elon Musk's Boring Co raises about $117 million in latest funding round
Description: Elon Musk's Boring Co raised about $117 million in its latest round of funding from 20 unnamed investors after offering to sell about $120 million in equity, the company disclosed in a regulatory filing on Friday.

Headlines: Oil gains on U.S. economic data, Gulf crude tanker dispute
Description: Oil prices inched up on Friday, ending the week higher after stronger-than-expected U.S. economic data brightened the crude demand outlook and concerns over the safety of oil transport around the Strait of Hormuz threatened supply.

Headlines: T-Mobile says cost to close merger with Sprint should come down by 10%
Description: T-Mobile US said on Friday that the cost required to acquire smaller rival Sprint will come down by 10 percent from the initial $26.5 billion following the divesture of assets to Dish Network.

Headlines: China's Wanda Sports raises $190.4 million in downsized IPO
Description: Wanda Sports Group , a sport events owner whose interests include the distribution of media rights in Asia for the FIFA World Cup, said on Friday it priced a smaller-than-expected U.S. initial public offering (IPO) below its targeted range to raise $190.4 million.    The Beijing-based company, a unit of Chinese conglomerate Dalian Wanda Group, sold about 23.8 million American depositary shares (ADS) at $8 each, compared with a previously stated target

Headlines: McDonald's beats sales forecast on new deals, store revamp
Description: McDonald's Corp  beat quarterly sales expectations at established U.S. restaurants on Friday, as the world's largest burger chain attracted more diners with upgraded stores and new promotions, such as the 2 for $5 Mix and Match deal.

Headlines: Chevron 'hopeful' of U.S. approval to continue operating in Venezuela
Description: Chevron Corp , the last U.S. oil company operating in Venezuela, said on Thursday it hopes to be able to remain in the Latin American nation as the Trump administration mulls whether to renew its license, expiring on Saturday, to do business there.

Headlines: Trump warns Google after Treasury chief says no concerns on China
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday kept up his pressure on global tech giant Google days after his Treasury secretary ruled out any national security concerns over the company's work in China.

Headlines: In Roundup case, U.S. judge cuts $2 billion verdict against Bayer to $86 million
Description: A California judge on Thursday reduced a $2 billion jury verdict, slashing the award for a couple who blamed Bayer AG's glyphosate-based weed killer, Roundup, for their cancer to $86.7 million.

Headlines: Wall Street Week Ahead: Even if Fed cut is a given, Powell seen as wild card for stock market
Description: U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell will have to walk a fine line to avoid roiling the stock market next week, even if the central bank delivers on expectations and lowers interest rates for the first time in more than a decade.

Headlines: New auto safety technology leaves insurers in the dark
Description: Automakers are accelerating the rollout of technology designed to avoid crashes, but insurance companies are waving a caution flag at consumers eyeing discounts for buying collision-avoiding brakes or automated cruise control.

Headlines: N.Y. Fed model raises U.S. third quarter GDP view above 2%
Description: U.S. economy is growing faster in the third quarter than previously thought based on this week's June data on durable goods orders and new home sales, the New York Federal Reserve's Nowcast model showed on Friday.

Headlines: SoftBank Group's $108 billion Vision Fund 2 draws in Microsoft, Apple
Description: SoftBank Group Corp  has secured pledges from Microsoft Corp  and other investors of around $108 billion for a second Vision Fund aimed at investing in technology firms.

Headlines: U.S. economy misses Trump's 3% target in 2018
Description: U.S. economic growth in 2018 missed the Trump administration's 3% target by any measure, which could renew criticism of the White House's $1.5 trillion in tax cuts.

Headlines: Twitter shares jump 10% on solid user growth, revenue beat
Description: Twitter Inc  on Friday reported better-than-expected second-quarter revenue as design changes to its microblogging website attracted more users and advertisers, sending its shares up 10%.

Headlines: Italy picks Deloitte to set up 500 million-euro real estate fund
Description: Italy has picked the consulting firm Deloitte as its financial adviser in setting up a 500 million-euro real estate fund in an effort to squeeze money out of the property it owns, an official told Reuters on Friday.

Headlines: Trump says second-quarter economic growth was 'not bad'
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump wrote in a tweet on Friday that second-quarter economic growth, which slowed by less than expected, was "Not bad considering we have the very heavy weight of the Federal Reserve anchor wrapped around our neck."

Headlines: U.S.-China tensions weigh on Huawei's ties with partners FedEx, Flex
Description: U.S. FedEx Corp  on Friday again apologized and blamed Washington's ban on Huawei for being "unclear" as Beijing deepened an investigation into why the delivery firm was holding up packages meant for the telecoms equipment maker.

Headlines: Alphabet shares jump 9% on ad rebound, cloud promise
Description: Shares of Alphabet Inc  rose nearly 9% in premarket trading on Friday, after the company handily beat Wall Street targets on higher ad sales and touted growth at its cloud unit, a high-margin business it is leaning more on to drive growth.

Headlines: Instant View: U.S. second quarter GDP growth slows to 2.1% but tops estimates
Description: U.S. economic growth slowed less than expected in the second quarter as a surge in consumer spending blunted some of the drag from declining exports and a smaller inventory build, which could further allay concerns about the economy's health.

Headlines: Renault cuts revenue goal as car industry misery spreads
Description: Renault  warned revenue may decline this year, scrapping a previous goal, after first-half profit was hit by weakening car demand and an earnings collapse at alliance partner Nissan  in the wake of the Carlos Ghosn scandal.

Headlines: Alphabet says to continue talks with DoJ in antitrust review
Description: Alphabet Inc on Thursday acknowledged a broader U.S. Department of Justice antitrust review of large technology firms and said it will continue to engage with the regulator.

Headlines: Alphabet's revenue rebounds; easing doubts on growth and boosting shares
Description: Alphabet Inc shares rose about 8% after the company reported quarterly results that eased investors' concerns about growth challenges facing its Google advertising business.

Headlines: Huawei rolls out 5G phone and flags first Hongmeng device
Description: Huawei Technologies [HWT.UL] on Friday released its first 5G phone in China and said it would soon launch smart TVs equipped with its own Hongmeng operating system.

Headlines: Apple pays $1 billion for Intel unit in push for chip independence
Description: Apple Inc took a major step toward supplying its own smartphone chips by purchasing the majority of Intel Corp's modem business in a deal valued at $1 billion, the companies said on Thursday.

Headlines: Australia to 'lift veil' on Facebook, Google algorithms to protect privacy
Description: Australia said it would establish the world's first dedicated office to police Facebook Inc  and Google  as part of reforms designed to rein in the U.S. technology giants, potentially setting a precedent for global lawmakers.

Headlines: Factbox: How Australia plans to curb Facebook and Google's market power
Description: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission has found, after an 18-month investigation, that Google and Facebook hold enormous power in the country's online advertising and news distribution markets, and that antitrust and privacy laws have not caught up to the real world.

Headlines: Canada's new cannabis licensing favors richer companies, experts say
Description: A new licensing process for legal cannabis producers in Canada limits the ability of smaller companies to attract investment, which could leave the fledgling industry dominated by companies with deep pockets or those who got a foot in the door prior to regulation changes in May, industry executives said.

Headlines: Australian regulator to get unit specializing in tech companies
Description: Australia's antitrust watchdog will be strengthened with a special branch to oversee the market power of U.S. technology giants Facebook  and Google  under sweeping regulatory reforms proposed by the government on Friday.

Headlines: California, four automakers defy Trump, agree to tighten emissions rules
Description: Four major automakers said on Thursday they have reached an agreement with California on fuel efficiency rules, bypassing a Trump administration effort to strip the state of the right to fight climate change by setting its own standards.

Headlines: U.S. to pay farmers up to $16 billion for trade war losses, South to benefit
Description: The U.S. government will pay American farmers hurt by the trade war with China between $15 and $150 per acre in an aid package totaling $16 billion, officials said on Thursday, with farmers in the South poised to see higher rates than in the Midwest.

Headlines: Amazon's push for one-day delivery dents profits, costs up 21%

Headlines: Intel says customers stockpiling chips on U.S.-China tension, hikes forecast

Headlines: Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway raises stake in Bank of America
Description: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway  has raised its stake in Bank of America Corp , the company said in a regulatory filing on Thursday.

Headlines: Starbucks traffic surges, posts best sales growth in three years

Description: U.S. antiviral drugmaker Gilead Sciences  will invest $5.1 billion in a major expansion of its partnership with Belgo-Dutch biotech Galapagos NV .

Description: More than 2,000 workers at seven Amazon  sites across Germany have gone on strike over pay for at least two days, labor union Verdi said on Monday.

Description: China's industrial output grew 6.3% in June from a year earlier, official data showed on Monday, picking up from May's 17-year low and handily beating market expectations.

Description: China's daily aluminum output hit record levels in June, according to Reuters calculations, even as total production for the whole of the month fell slightly according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Monday.

Description: The Federal Reserve may launch a policy tool to lend to banks using Treasuries and other securities as collateral in early 2020, with possible testing to begin later this year, a Deutsche Bank strategist said.

Headlines: GSK in talks to name HSBC's Symonds as its next chairman: Bloomberg
Description: GlaxoSmithKline Plc  is in talks to name HSBC's deputy chairman Jonathan Symonds as the next chairman of the British drugmaker, Bloomberg reported on Sunday, citing a person familiar with the matter.

Headlines: India says Deloitte misreading law in challenging government's call for ban
Description: India has told a tribunal the local auditing affiliate of international accounting group Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu is misreading a key federal law as the firm seeks to avoid a five-year ban on new business, according to legal documents reviewed by Reuters on Sunday.

Description: U.S. luxury department store operator Barneys New York Inc is exploring options that include a bankruptcy filing, as it struggles with high rents and changing consumer tastes, people familiar with the matter said on Saturday.

Description: Anheuser-Busch InBev said on Friday it will not proceed with the planned listing in Hong Kong of its Asia Pacific unit, Budweiser Brewing Company APAC Ltd, in what would have been the world's biggest initial public offering (IPO) of 2019.

Headlines: U.S. to hold hearing on French tax investigation Aug. 19

Headlines: China June new loans rise to three-month, still below forecasts
Description: New bank loans in China rose to a three-month high in June as policymakers sought to keep ample funds in the financial system to support the slowing economy amid rising U.S. trade pressure.
