Description: PSA Group on Wednesday launched its Citroen C5 Aircross SUV in India and said it would be available before the end of 2020, as the French carmaker re-enters the Indian market to expand beyond Europe.

Headlines: Pernod Ricard betting on growth from green agenda
Description: Drinks group Pernod Ricard, which is being targeted by activist investor Elliott, is banking that its push into socially and environmentally sound business practices will boost its growth in the coming decade.

Headlines: Exclusive: Japan Display to supply OLED screens for Apple Watch - sources
Description: Japan Display Inc will begin to supply organic light-emitting diode (OLED) screens for the Apple Watch later this year, two sources said, a breakthrough for the cash-strapped company whose late shift to OLED has cost it orders from Apple.

Headlines: Commerzbank to decide on April 9 on merger talks with Deutsche: WiWo
Description: Commerzbank's executive board is due to decide on April 9 whether to intensify merger talks with Deutsche Bank or back away from a deal, German business weekly Wirtschaftswoche said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Roche says $4.3 billion Spark offer still on track for June completion
Description: Roche Holding said its effort to expand in gene therapy via the $4.3 billion takeover of Spark Therapeutics remained on track despite failing to get enough votes to clinch the deal and as U.S. regulators continued scrutinizing it.

Headlines: Daimler, BMW to limit cooperation to affordable electric car in China: paper
Description: Daimler and BMW are looking to limit their planned cooperation to jointly produce an affordable electric car in China, German daily Sueddeutsche Zeitung reported on Wednesday.

Headlines: UAE to validate any Boeing MAX fix before lifting airspace ban: official
Description: The United Arab Emirates will make its own checks on any fixes for the Boeing 737 MAX before permitting the grounded jet to resume flying in its airspace, a senior aviation regulatory official said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Norwegian's CEO held 'good meetings' with Boeing regarding MAX
Description: Norwegian Air, a major client of Boeing, has had positive meetings with the U.S. planemaker regarding the grounding of its MAX planes after an Ethiopian Airlines crash last month, the airline's chief executive said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Jewelers must say whether diamonds are mined or synthetic: U.S. FTC
Description: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission, which investigates allegations of deceptive advertising, has sent warning letters to eight companies to insist they distinguish in advertisements between diamonds from mines and those made in laboratories, it said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Ethiopian Airlines pilots initially used Boeing emergency procedures before crash: WSJ
Description: The pilots of an Ethiopian Airlines 737 MAX jet that crashed last month had initially followed Boeing Co's emergency procedures but later deviated from them as they tried to regain control of the plane, the Wall Street Journal said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Carlos Ghosn on Twitter: Ready to 'tell the truth' about events
Description: Ousted Nissan Motor Co boss Carlos Ghosn on Wednesday said on Twitter that he was getting ready to tell the truth about recent events and that he would hold a news conference on April 11.

Headlines: Chinese tech giant Tencent plans $5 billion bond sale: sources
Description: China's Tencent Holdings Ltd is returning to the market with a U.S. dollar bond that could raise about $5 billion, two people with direct knowledge of the matter said.

Headlines: AIG paid CEO Duperreault $20.9 million in 2018: filing
Description: Insurer American International Group Inc said on Tuesday it paid Chief Executive Officer Brian Duperreault $20.9 million in 2018 while also outlining a series of reforms to its pay practices in the face of shareholder criticism.

Headlines: PG&E to name TVA's Bill Johnson as CEO: source
Description: PG&E Corp is expected to name Bill Johnson as chief executive of the bankrupt California energy company facing $30 billion in wildfire liabilities, as soon as Wednesday, a source familiar with the private negotiations said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Purdue's Sackler family fights 'inflammatory' Massachusetts opioid case
Description: Members of the Sackler family behind OxyContin maker Purdue Pharma LP have asked a judge to toss a lawsuit by the Massachusetts attorney general that claims they helped fuel the U.S. opioid epidemic, arguing it contains "misleading and inflammatory allegations."

Headlines: Exclusive: Venezuela oil exports stable in March despite sanctions, blackouts
Description: Venezuela's state-run energy company, PDVSA, kept oil exports near 1 million barrels per day in March despite U.S. sanctions and power outages that crippled its main export terminal, according to PDVSA documents and Refinitiv Eikon data.

Headlines: U.S. judge orders PG&E to hold dividends to pay for efforts to reduce wildfire risks
Description: A U.S. judge said on Tuesday that PG&E Corp cannot resume dividends and must use the money to reduce wildfire risk in California, stopping short of more costly measures he proposed earlier this year.

Headlines: U.S. March and quarter one auto sales drop in weak start to 2019
Description: Major automakers on Tuesday reported weak U.S. sales for March and the first quarter, citing a rough start to the year, but said a robust economy and strong labor market should encourage consumers to buy more vehicles as 2019 rolls on.

Headlines: Wall Street treads water after rally, Walgreens slumps on profit warning
Description: The benchmark S&P 500 stock index paused on Tuesday, taking a breather from Monday's strong quarterly kickoff as a decline in shares of Walgreens Boots Alliance Inc weighed and economic data did little to ease growth concerns.

Headlines: Canada auto sales fall 2.5 percent in March
Description: Canada's auto sales fell 2.5 percent in March from a year earlier, marking 13 straight months of declines, according to industry data released on Tuesday.

Headlines: Citing climate differences, Shell walks away from U.S. refining lobby
Description: Royal Dutch Shell Plc on Tuesday became the first major oil and gas company to announce plans to leave a leading U.S. refining lobby due to disagreement on climate policies, citing its support for the goals of the Paris climate agreement.

Headlines: White House sees 'headway' on U.S.-China trade ahead of new talks this week
Description: The United States and China "expect to make more headway" in trade talks this week, White House economic adviser Larry Kudlow said on Tuesday as the top U.S. business lobbying group said differences over an enforcement mechanism and the removal of U.S. tariffs were still obstacles to a deal.

Headlines: Massachusetts says Wynn Resorts executives concealed sexual misconduct accusations involving Steve Wynn
Description: Massachusetts gaming regulators on Tuesday released an investigative report concluding that former executives of Wynn Resorts Ltd concealed sexual misconduct allegations against the casino operator's billionaire founder, Steve Wynn.

Headlines: Former UAW official pleads guilty in U.S. corruption case
Description: A former top United Auto Workers official in charge of the union's relations with Fiat Chrysler Automobiles NV (FCA) pleaded guilty on Tuesday in a U.S. federal court in Detroit to misusing the automaker's funds for lavish spending on UAW officials.

Headlines: Oil hits 2019 high as supply squeeze looms; Brent nears $70 per barrel
Description: Oil prices on Tuesday hit their highest level so far in 2019, with Brent crude approaching $70 a barrel, on the prospect that more sanctions against Iran and further Venezuelan disruptions could deepen an OPEC-led supply cut.

Headlines: Airbus CEO's exit package excessive: French minister
Description: A retirement pot of almost 40 million euros ($44.78 million) for outgoing Airbus Chief Executive Officer Tom Enders is excessive and may harm the company's image, France's finance minister said in remarks published on Tuesday.

Headlines: Stocks edge up to hit six-month peak, oil closes on $70 per barrel
Description: World stock markets were little changed on Tuesday but still managed to touch a six-month high as investors took a breather following a three-day run of gains while the possibility of tightening supply kept oil prices on the rise .

Headlines: Harley-Davidson workers in Wisconsin reject new labor contract
Description: Harley-Davidson Inc's workers in Milwaukee and Tomahawk, Wisconsin, have rejected the motorcycle maker's proposal for a five-year contract, their union said on Tuesday, citing non-financial issues such as temporary workers and job security.

Headlines: U.S. Senate panel reviewing whistleblower claims on aviation safety: panel chair
Description: The U.S. Senate Commerce Committee is investigating claims by a number of whistleblowers that aviation safety inspectors, including some who worked to evaluate the now-grounded Boeing 737 MAX, were not properly trained or certified, the committee chairman said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Care.com slumps after Best Buy suspends relationship
Description: Electronics retailer Best Buy Co Inc said on Tuesday it had suspended its relationship with Care.com Inc, sending the online childcare marketplace operator's stock down 9.8 percent.

Headlines: Trump says trade talks with China are going very well
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that trade talks with China were going very well.

Headlines: Air Canada delays launch of seasonal routes due to Boeing MAX grounding
Description: Air Canada said on Tuesday it would delay the launch of certain seasonal flights this spring, as the carrier wrestles with the challenge of servicing routes previously flown by its grounded Boeing 737 MAX aircraft.

Headlines: To save time and money, companies roll out caregiving benefits
Description: When Laura Hirsch of Keller Texas had to find a rehabilitation center to help her father recover from a difficult surgery in September, the caregiving service Cariloop saved her a whole day.

Headlines: Founder of Britain's Superdry wins investor backing for board return
Description: The co-founder and former boss of Superdry, Julian Dunkerton, returned to the board and was appointed interim CEO on Tuesday after winning the backing of shareholders keen for a revival of the British fashion group's fortunes.

Headlines: Lyft falls further from IPO after receiving first 'sell' rating
Description: Lyft Inc's stock sank further below its IPO price on Tuesday after receiving its first negative review from an analyst who is skeptical that consumers will give up car ownership in favor of relying on ride-hailing services.

Headlines: Apple, luxury brands drop prices in China on VAT cut
Description: Apple and luxury labels such as Gucci have lowered their prices in China after a cut in its value-added tax (VAT) rate came into effect from April 1.

Headlines: BlackRock's Larry Fink overhauls leadership ranks in key business units
Description: BlackRock Inc, the world's largest asset manager, has made changes to its senior leadership ranks aimed at winning more business from top institutional clients and boosting growth of its alternative investing business, according to a memo seen by Reuters on Tuesday.

Headlines: Superdry founder named interim CEO as majority of board steps down
Description: Superdry named its co-founder and former boss Julian Dunkerton as interim chief executive officer on Tuesday after a majority of the British fashion group's board stepped down.

Headlines: U.S. manufacturing sector stabilizing, challenges remain
Description: New orders for key U.S.-made capital goods slipped in February and shipments were unchanged, but data for January was revised slightly higher, which could support views that the manufacturing sector was stabilizing.

Headlines: Vodafone expects mid-year EU approval on Liberty Global deal
Description: Vodafone still expects to secure EU antitrust approval for its $22 billion purchase of Liberty Global's assets in Germany and eastern Europe by the middle of the year, it said on Tuesday.

Headlines: EU has no major concerns in Germany over Vodafone-Liberty deal: sources
Description: The European Union has not raised any major concerns about the impact on Germany's cable market of Vodafone buying Liberty Global's assets, sources with direct knowledge of the matter said on Tuesday, improving the chances of the deal going ahead.

Headlines: Bitcoin jumps 20 percent, mystery order seen as catalyst
Description: Bitcoin soared to its highest in almost five months on Tuesday, pulling smaller cryptocurrencies up with it, after a major order by an anonymous buyer set off a frenzy of computer-driven trading, analysts said.

Headlines: GM U.S. new vehicle sales fall 7 percent in first quarter
Description: General Motors Co on Tuesday reported a 7 percent fall in U.S. new vehicle sales for the first quarter, hit by declines in passenger car sales.

Headlines: Bayer board says pursuit of Monsanto was done diligently
Description: Bayer's non-executive board reaffirmed its support for top management's decision to acquire seed maker Monsanto last year, after losing high-profile lawsuits to U.S. plaintiffs who claimed Monsanto's Roundup weedkiller caused their cancer.

Headlines: Exclusive: China's huge Airbus order padded by old or incomplete deals - sources
Description: A landmark order from China for 300 Airbus jets signed during a state visit last week was bolstered by repeat announcements of dozens of existing deals and advance approval for deals that have yet to be struck, two people familiar with the matter said.

Headlines: Daimler CEO: Boeing safety debate highlights challenge for autonomous tech
Description: Daimler Chief Executive Dieter Zetsche said on Tuesday the debate surrounding the safety of Boeing's aircraft shows how hard it can be to win public acceptance for autonomous car technology.

Headlines: Top House Democrat cites labor, enforcement concerns on new NAFTA
Description: U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi said on Tuesday lawmakers could not take up the replacement for the North American Free Trade Agreement unless Mexico passes legislation protecting workers' rights.

Headlines: Brexit leaves Ford at crossroads on long-term British plans
Description: Ford is spending tens of millions of euros preparing for a possible British exit from the European Union without a trade deal and has yet to decide on its longer-term plans for Britain, Ford Europe chairman Steven Armstrong said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Ford would take 'long, hard look' at UK operations after any no-deal Brexit
Description: Ford would have to take a "long, hard look" at its British operations, which include two engine factories, if Britain leaves the European Union without a deal, the U.S. carmaker said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Shell sees rise in Nigeria oil spills in 2018
Description: Royal Dutch Shell last year experienced a sharp rise in the number of oil spills caused by pipeline theft in Nigeria, which the company said were the result of larger output and higher oil prices.

Headlines: Trade slowed in fourth quarter, WTO says; auto tariffs, Brexit are 2019 risks
Description: World trade shrank by 0.3 percent in the fourth quarter of 2018 and is likely to grow by 2.6 percent this year, slower than 3.0 percent growth in 2018 and below a previous forecast of 3.7 percent, the World Trade Organization said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Exor's Elkann stresses long-term commitment to Fiat Chrysler
Description: Exor, the holding company of the Agnelli family, remains committed to Fiat Chrysler (FCA), chairman John Elkann said, in comments that may dampen speculation the Italian carmaker could be the target of a takeover.

Headlines: Why some green investors are passing on Uber and Lyft
Description: Some environmentally focused investors are not ready to buy into Lyft Inc or Uber Technologies Inc, worried about the climate impact of this year's two most closely watched initial public offerings.

Headlines: Maersk management given time to turn around 'supertanker'
Description: The main shareholder and the chairman of Danish shipping group A.P. Moller-Maersk both backed management's efforts to reshape the business, although other investors raised concerns on Tuesday about the rate of progress.

Headlines: Microsoft, BMW launch industrial cloud technology partnership
Description: Microsoft Corp and BMW Group on Tuesday launched an initiative to create an Open Manufacturing Platform that seeks to stimulate innovation and accelerate the development of 'smart' factories.

Headlines: Exclusive: Exxon weighs sale of Nigerian oil and gas fields for up to $3 billion
Description: Exxon Mobil recently held talks on the sale of a suite of oil and gas fields in Nigeria as the company focuses on new developments in U.S. shale and Guyana, industry and banking sources told Reuters.

Headlines: U.S. auto tariffs, no-deal Brexit are major risks for trade growth: WTO
Description: The imposition of tariffs on U.S. imports of cars would have a bigger impact on the world economy than the U.S.-China trade war has had to date, while a "no deal" Brexit could also weigh on trade growth, the WTO's chief economist said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Ghosn's lawyers say his trial must be separate from Nissan's to ensure fairness
Description: Lawyers for Carlos Ghosn asked a Tokyo court on Tuesday to try the ex-Nissan Motor Co boss separately from his former employer, arguing he would otherwise not get a fair hearing to fight charges of financial wrongdoing.

Headlines: Swiss court backs Swatch in 'Think Different' row with Apple
Description: A Swiss court has backed Swatch Group in a trademark row with Apple Inc over the watchmaker's use of the "Tick different" slogan, which Apple had decried as an infringement of its "Think Different" advertising campaign.

Headlines: Tesla will pay $31,000 to settle U.S. EPA hazardous waste claims
Description: Tesla Inc will pay a $31,000 penalty and purchase $55,000 in emergency response equipment for a California city under a settlement reached with the Environmental Protection Agency over federal hazardous waste violations at its automotive factory, the government said Monday.

Headlines: Asda overtakes suitor Sainsbury to become UK's No. 2 supermarket: Kantar
Description: Sainsbury has lost its status as Britain's No. 2 supermarket group by market share to takeover target Asda for the first time in four years, industry data showed on Tuesday.

Headlines: Boeing to submit 737 MAX software upgrade 'in the coming weeks'
Description: Boeing Co said on Monday it planned to submit a proposed software enhancement package for the grounded 737 MAX in "the coming weeks" after the company had previously said it planned to deliver the fix for government approval by last week.

Headlines: Singapore Airlines grounds two 787-10s citing Rolls-Royce engine problem
Description: Singapore Airlines Ltd said on Tuesday it had grounded two Boeing Co 787-10 jets fitted with Rolls-Royce Holdings PLC Trent 1000 TEN engines after checks of its fleet found premature blade deterioration.

Headlines: Lawyer for ousted Nissan boss Ghosn says hasn't discussed Oman issue with him
Description: The defense lawyer for ousted Nissan Motor Chairman Carlos Ghosn said on Tuesday he had not discussed with Ghosn a report that Nissan's alliance partner Renault had alerted French prosecutors about payments to an Omani distributor.

Headlines: Ghosn would not get fair trial if tried alongside former employer Nissan, lawyer says
Description: Ousted Nissan boss Carlos Ghosn would not get a fair trial by a Tokyo court if he were tried alongside his former employer, a lawyer for Ghosn said on Tuesday, saying the carmaker was more like a prosecutor than a defendant in the case.

Headlines: Ryanair pilots in Portugal vote for pay agreement
Description: Irish-based carrier Ryanair said on Tuesday its pilots based in Portugal have voted for a labor agreement for the next four years, taking another step to head off any risk of another round of damaging strikes ahead of its peak summer season.

Headlines: French group Thales completes 4.8 billion euro takeover of Gemalto
Description: French aerospace and defense electronics group Thales said it had completed its previously announced 4.8 billion euros ($5.4 billion) takeover of chipmaker Gemalto, boosting Thales' presence in the booming security services market.

Headlines: U.S. to probe thousands of fires connected to Hyundai, Kia vehicles
Description: The top U.S. auto safety regulator said on Monday it will open an investigation into 3 million Hyundai Motor Co and Kia Motors Corp vehicles after reviewing reports of more than 3,000 fires that injured over 100 people.

Headlines: Uber's Kalanick, directors win dismissal of investor lawsuit
Description: Travis Kalanick, the co-founder of ride-hailing company Uber, and the company's directors won the dismissal of an investor lawsuit that sought to hold them liable for a fight over trade secrets that slowed Uber's push into autonomous vehicles.

Headlines: Exclusive: Investors drop out of two groups vying for Petrobras' gas pipeline unit - sources
Description: At least three investors left separate groups interested in acquiring a gas network pipeline that will be sold by Brazil's state-controlled oil company Petroleo Brasileiro SA, three sources with knowledge of the matter said.

Headlines: 'Impossible' meatless patty gets Burger King Whopper test
Description: Vegetarian burgers may finally be getting the recognition they need to go mainstream. On Monday Burger King and Silicon Valley startup Impossible Foods announced the rollout of the Impossible Whopper in 59 stores in and around St. Louis, Missouri.

Headlines: Lyft gives up debut gains in second day of trading
Description: Shares of ride-hailing company Lyft Inc crashed below their initial public offering price in just their second day of trading on Monday, matching the speed at which Facebook Inc gave up its IPO price after a rocky debut nearly seven years ago.

Headlines: Exclusive: Renault alerts prosecutors to Oman dealer payments under Ghosn
Description: Renault SA  has alerted French prosecutors to payments made to a Renault-Nissan business partner in Oman under former Chief Executive Carlos Ghosn, three sources told Reuters.

Headlines: Wall Street rallies on upbeat China, U.S. manufacturing data
Description: U.S. stocks rallied on Monday, starting off the second quarter on a strong note, as upbeat manufacturing numbers from China and the United States eased worries about slowing global growth.

Headlines: Stocks rally at start of second quarter on manufacturing data, trade hopes
Description: Global stocks rallied on Monday, kicking off the second quarter on a strong note, as investors cheered upbeat factory activity data in China and the United States and signs of progress on the U.S.-China trade front.

Headlines: Oil rises to 2019 highs as demand outlook improves
Description: Oil climbed about 2 percent to new 2019 highs on Monday, with Brent crude touching $69 a barrel, after positive signs for the global economy and tighter supplies drove both benchmarks' largest first-quarter gains in nearly a decade.

Headlines: Mixed data offer glimmers of hope for slowing U.S. economy
Description: U.S. retail sales unexpectedly fell in February, but a rebound in factory activity in March and strong increase in construction spending offered hope the economy was not slowing as sharply as previously feared.

Headlines: Swiss drugmaker Novartis must face doctor kickback suit, U.S. judge rules
Description: Novartis AG must face a U.S. government lawsuit accusing it of paying millions of dollars in kickbacks to doctors so they would prescribe its drugs, after a federal judge ruled in a decision released on Monday that the government had offered evidence of a "company-wide kickback scheme."

Headlines: U.S. Labor Department moves to ease companies' liability for franchisee wage violations
Description: The U.S. Department of Labor on Monday issued a proposal that would make it more difficult to prove companies are liable for the wage law violations of their contractors or franchisees, a top priority for business groups.

Headlines: When it comes to disclosing sponsors, your Google Assistant may be mute
Description: On stage at an investor conference last month, Google's Chief Business Officer Philipp Schindler identified a vexing challenge for the company's most prized app: its virtual assistant.

Headlines: China's Kunlun in talks with U.S. over Grindr: filing
Description: Chinese gaming company Beijing Kunlun Tech Co Ltd said on Monday that it was in talks with U.S. government authorities about whether it should continue to own popular gay dating app Grindr LLC.

Headlines: Kellogg agrees $1.3 billion cookie sale with Nutella-maker Ferrero
Description: U.S. food group Kellogg Co has agreed to sell its Keebler biscuits brand and other assets to Nutella maker Ferrero for $1.3 billion as it focuses on its core cereals and snacks businesses.

Headlines: Sweden will not pursue Browder's Swedbank complaint
Description: Sweden's Economic Crime Authority said it will not investigate Swedbank over a criminal complaint alleging money laundering brought by campaigning investor Bill Browder.

Headlines: U.S. airlines back up after second system glitch in a week
Description: Major U.S. airlines were back up and running on Monday after a system-wide outage delayed hundreds of flights and fired-up customer complaints on social media, the second such disruption in a week.

Headlines: Ex-CEO tells Lynch trial HP did not need Autonomy at any cost
Description: Hewlett-Packard did not have to buy Britain's Autonomy to solve the U.S. company's other problems in 2011, its former chief executive told the $5 billion fraud trial of Mike Lynch.

Headlines: Saudi ban on Boeing MAX flights to continue for near future: minister
Description: Saudi Arabia has no immediate plans to allow Boeing 737 MAX aircraft to operate in the kingdom, its transport minister said on Monday, as state airline flyadeal potentially reconsiders an order for the jets.

Headlines: Ethiopian crash could be largest non-war aviation reinsurance claim: Willis Re
Description: Liability claims related to the Ethiopian Airlines crash and the grounding of Boeing 737 MAX 8 aircraft could be the largest non-war aviation reinsurance claim on record, hitting reinsurers' profitability, reinsurance broker Willis Re said.

Headlines: J&J baby shampoo samples fail Indian quality test; company rejects findings
Description: Johnson & Johnson's baby shampoo samples failed quality tests conducted by the northwestern Indian state of Rajasthan, according to a public notice from the state's drugs watchdog, findings that were rejected by the U.S. drugmaker.

Headlines: Denmark's DSV to buy logistics company Panalpina in $4.6 billion deal
Description: Swiss logistics group Panalpina has bowed to an increased 4.6 billion Swiss francs ($4.6 billion) bid from Danish rival DSV, ending a more than two month takeover battle designed to build scale in the consolidating transport sector.

Headlines: EasyJet summer clouded by Brexit and economic weakness
Description: Budget airline EasyJet warned on Monday that European travelers were holding off booking their summer holidays for fear of how the Brexit process will end, weakening demand for tickets and prices.

Headlines: Swedish FSA says Swedbank situation no threat to financial stability
Description: Swedbank's recent problems with alleged money-laundering has affected trust in the bank, but the situation does not pose a problem to financial stability, the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority (FSA) said on Monday.

Headlines: U.S. construction spending rises to a nine-month high in February
Description: U.S. construction spending increased for a third straight month in February, boosted by gains in both private and public construction projects, offering some good news on the economy following a string of weak reports.

Headlines: U.S. manufacturing rebounds in March - ISM
Description: U.S. manufacturing activity rebounded a bit more than expected in March, according to an industry report released on Monday, as production, new orders and hiring all picked up.

Headlines: U.S. business inventories rise more than expected in January
Description: U.S. business inventories increased more than expected in January as sales rose moderately, and businesses were taking the longest time in nearly 1-1/2 years to clear shelves, a sign of slowing demand.

Headlines: Aramco's $10 billion-plus bond plan shows profits put top earner Apple in shade
Description: Saudi Aramco, the world's biggest oil producer, made core earnings of $224 billion last year, almost three times as much as Apple, figures from the state-owned company showed on Monday ahead of its debut international bond issue.

Headlines: Airbnb to invest $100-200 million in India's OYO - source
Description: Home-renting company Airbnb will invest between $100 and $200 million in SoftBank Group-backed Indian hotel start-up OYO, a source with direct knowledge of the matter told Reuters, as it dives deeper into the hotel-booking business.

Headlines: U.S. retail sales unexpectedly fall in February
Description: U.S. retail sales unexpectedly fell in February, the latest sign economic growth has shifted into low gear as stimulus from $1.5 trillion in tax cuts and increased government spending fades.

Headlines: U.S. says several airlines' operations affected by non-FAA data program
Description: Operations for Southwest Airlines Co, United Continental, JetBlue Airways Co, Alaska Air Group and Delta Air Lines Inc were impacted on Monday by data problems, the Federal Aviation Administration said in a statement.

Headlines: Global factory activity weak in March as clouds gather
Description: Factory activity remained weak around the world last month, reinforcing worries of a global slowdown as forward-looking indicators pointed to gloomy times ahead, surveys showed on Monday.

Headlines: Take Five: The shape of you - world market themes for the week ahead
Description: Following are five big themes likely to dominate thinking of investors and traders in the coming week and the Reuters stories related to them.

Headlines: Financial Times reaches a million paying readers
Description: The Financial Times has reached a milestone of a million paying readers, it said on Monday, with revenues and profits continuing to rise since the London-based business publication was acquired by Japan's Nikkei from Pearson in 2015.

Headlines: Norwegian Air CEO to visit Boeing, discuss MAX aircraft grounding
Description: Norwegian Air Chief Executive Bjoern Kjos will travel to Seattle on Monday to visit aircraft maker Boeing and address problems linked to the recently grounded MAX aircraft, the company said.

Headlines: Brexit is wrecking Britain's business reputation: Siemens UK head
Description: Britain is wrecking its reputation for business stability with political divisions over Brexit and risks leaving the trading bloc with a hugely damaging "no-deal", the UK head of German industrial giant Siemens has said.

Headlines: Sports Direct says other Debenhams investors back making Ashley boss
Description: Sports Direct, the sportswear group that is seeking control of Debenhams, said it has been contacted by other shareholders in the department store group expressing their support to install Mike Ashley as Debenhams CEO.

Headlines: Novartis to pay $310 million for assets from inflammation specialist IFM
Description: Novartis on Monday said it had agreed to pay $310 million upfront, with the possibility for more later, for some research assets of Boston-based inflammation specialist IFM Therapeutics as the Swiss drugmaker expands its immunology pipeline.

Headlines: Saudi Aramco hires banks ahead of debut multi-tranche dollar bond: document
Description: Saudi Aramco, the world's top oil producer, has hired banks ahead of a planned multi-tranche debut dollar bond issue, according to a document issued by one of the banks leading the deal and reviewed by Reuters.

Headlines: Rakuten says to book $990 million gain on Lyft investment
Description: Japan's Rakuten said on Monday it will book a 110 billion yen ($989.74 million) gain in the quarter through March on its investment in Lyft following the U.S. ride-hailing firm's listing last week.

Headlines: Japan's business confidence hits two-year low as trade war stings
Description: Japan's business mood slumped to a two-year low in the March quarter, a central bank survey showed, underscoring concerns that Sino-U.S. trade tensions and softening global demand were taking a toll on the export-reliant economy.

Headlines: South Korea's burned out millennials choose YouTube over Samsung
Description: Yoon Chang-hyun's parents told him to get his sanity checked when he quit his secure job as a researcher at Samsung Electronics Co in 2015 to start his own YouTube channel.

Headlines: Samsung C&T, Samsung Electronics almost double cost of finishing new chip line
Description: Samsung C&T Corp and Samsung Electronics Co Ltd have almost doubled the size of a contract related to the construction of a semiconductor production line, taking the project's total cost to 1.46 trillion won ($1.29 billion).

Headlines: Bond yield curveball stalls global stocks rally
Description: This year's roaring rally in world equities ran into sand by the end of the quarter, with warning signs from bond markets, U-turns from central banks and persistent trade worries scattering consensus about what happens over the rest of 2019.

Headlines: Japan March factory output falls at fastest rate in nearly three years: PMI
Description: Japanese manufacturing activity contracted at a slower pace in March than the previous month, but output fell at the sharpest rate in nearly three years, a private business survey showed on Monday, reflecting weak demand at home and abroad.

Headlines: National Enquirer: Bezos' girlfriend's brother 'single source' for reports
Description: The publisher of the National Enquirer on Sunday said its reports on Amazon Chief Executive Jeff Bezos' private life were based on information from a single source, the brother of Bezos' girlfriend, Lauren Sanchez.

Headlines: Saudis gained access to Amazon CEO Bezos' phone: Bezos' security chief
Description: The security chief for Amazon chief executive Jeff Bezos said on Saturday that the Saudi government had access to Bezos' phone and gained private information from it.

Headlines: Pilots of India's Jet Airways defer strike, seek salary dues by April 14
Description: The pilots' union of India's troubled Jet Airways said on Sunday it will give the carrier's new management two weeks to clear unpaid salaries, deferring its plan to take strike action.

Headlines: U.S. investors seek comfort in flood of data
Description: Wall Street will be watching next week's economic data with a laser focus after a dismal February jobs report and recessionary warning signals from U.S. Treasury yields.

Headlines: China March factory activity grows for first time in four months, but exports weak
Description: Factory activity in China unexpectedly grew for the first time in four months in March, an official survey showed on Sunday, suggesting government stimulus measures may be starting to take hold in the world's second largest economy.

Headlines: Facebook CEO calls for updated internet regulations
Description: Facebook Chief Executive Mark Zuckerberg called on Saturday for regulators to play a "more active role" in establishing rules that govern the internet, as the world's largest social media network struggles to defuse criticism.

Headlines: Southwest to keep Boeing 737 MAX off schedules through May instead of April 20: company memo
Description: Southwest Airlines Co said on Friday it was pulling its Boeing Co 737 MAX jets from flight schedules through May, extending its earlier timeline from April 20, according to a company memorandum seen by Reuters.

Headlines: South Africa's Denel may wind down manufacturing for Airbus A400M
Description: South African state arms company Denel is in talks with Airbus about winding down production of parts for the European planemaker's A400M military aircraft, Denel said on Saturday.

Headlines: Brazil automaker CAOA signs agreement with Ford over plant purchase: source
Description: Brazilian automaker CAOA has signed a confidentiality agreement to negotiate a potential purchase of Ford Motor Co's plant in the industrial city of Sao Bernardo do Campo, according to a source familiar with the matter.

Headlines: India's cash-strapped Jet Airways to pay December salaries

Headlines: Daimler asks EU antitrust regulators to probe Nokia patents
Description: German carmaker Daimler has complained to EU antitrust regulators about Nokia patents essential to car communications, a move underlining the tensions between tech companies and the car industry on the use of key technologies.

Headlines: Honda says 16th U.S. death confirmed in air bag rupture
Description: Honda Motor Co said on Friday it had confirmed a 16th U.S. death has been tied to a faulty Takata air bag inflator.

Headlines: Lyft shares soar on Nasdaq debut, setting stage for Uber
Description: Lyft Inc's shares rose as much as 23 percent in their market debut on Friday, amid strong investor demand for the ride-hailing service that bodes well for larger rival Uber Technologies Inc.

Headlines: White House calls for Fed to reverse U.S. rate hikes
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday that the Federal Reserve made a mistake by raising interest rates and blamed the central bank for hurting the U.S. economy and stock market.

Headlines: Trade hopes lift Wall Street; S&P 500 notches best quarter since 2009
Description: U.S. stocks ended the final trading day of the first quarter on a strong note on Friday and the S&P 500 posted its best quarterly gain since 2009, boosted by optimism over the latest round of trade talks between the United States and China.

Headlines: Exclusive: Trump eyeing stepped-up Venezuela sanctions for foreign companies - Bolton
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump is considering imposing sanctions on companies from other countries that do business with Venezuela  to cut off revenues to President Nicolas Maduro, Trump's national security adviser John Bolton told Reuters TV on Friday.

Headlines: U.S., China report progress in Beijing trade talks
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday that trade talks with China were going very well, but cautioned that he would not accept anything less than a "great deal" after top U.S. and Chinese trade officials wrapped up two days of negotiations in Beijing.

Headlines: Fed policymakers do not want rate cuts, not even the doves
Description: Barely a week after the U.S. Federal Reserve called a halt to interest rate hikes, policymakers are now battling a view growing in financial markets, and embraced by the Trump administration, that the Fed will need to cut rates before long.

Headlines: Outsider CEO won't be a quick fix for Wells Fargo: analysts
Description: Wells Fargo & Co's plan to bring in an outsider as its next chief executive could give the scandal-plagued bank a much needed fresh start, but a turnaround will not be easy for whoever takes the helm, analysts said.

Headlines: Factbox: Five challenges in store for Wells Fargo's next CEO
Description: Wells Fargo & Co's board started its official search for a new chief executive officer on Friday after announcing the abrupt departure of CEO Tim Sloan a day earlier.

Headlines: Apple, in rare reversal, pulls plug on wireless charging mat
Description: Apple Inc on Friday said it is canceling the AirPower wireless charging mat that the company announced in 2017 on the same day as its iPhone X, a rare public retreat for the gadget maker known for splashy product launches.

Headlines: Trade hopes buoy stocks, Brexit setback hits pound
Description: Stock markets around the world moved higher on Friday following signs of progress in U.S.-China trade talks, while the British pound fell after lawmakers rejected Prime Minister Theresa May's Brexit agreement for the third time.

Headlines: Factbox: Venture backers reap multibillion-dollar payday in Lyft IPO
Description: Lyft Inc's initial public offering on Thursday marked the latest chapter in the seven-year journey of the U.S. ride-hailing app, from a startup backed by seed funding to a publicly traded company worth more than $27 billion.

Headlines: White House's Kudlow says U.S.-China trade talks making headway
Description: White House economic adviser Larry Kudlow said on Friday the United States and China are making progress in trade talks.

Description: U.S. consumer spending barely rose in January and income increased modestly in February, suggesting the economy was fast losing momentum after growth slowed in the fourth quarter.

Headlines: Anti-stall system active before Ethiopian 737 MAX crash: sources
Description: An anti-stall system at the center of a probe into the crash of a Boeing 737 MAX jetliner in Indonesia five months ago was also at play when an identical aircraft crashed in Ethiopia earlier this month, three people briefed on the matter said.

Headlines: TUI sticks with Boeing 737 MAX orders despite profit hit
Description: TUI remains committed to its Boeing 737 MAX orders despite two fatal crashes that have led to the grounding of the plane worldwide and caused the Anglo-German tour operator to issue a profit warning on Friday.

Headlines: Versum opens books, begins to warm to rival suitor Merck KGaA
Description: Versum Materials Inc has opened its books to suitor Merck KGaA, saying the German group's unsolicited $5.9 billion offer might be sweetened and could edge out an agreed merger with Entegris.

Headlines: Recharged bulls give stocks, commodities flying start to year
Description: What goes down must come up! Three months after one of the worst years on record, investors have seen world stocks and key commodity markets roar back with their best first quarter since 2012.

Headlines: Starboard abandons campaign to scuttle Bristol-Myers-Celgene deal
Description: Activist hedge fund Starboard Value LP on Friday abandoned a campaign to convince Bristol-Myers Squibb Co shareholders to vote down the drugmaker's proposed $74 billion takeover of biotech Celgene Corp after the two leading proxy advisory firms backed the deal.

Headlines: U.S. new home sales rise to 11-month high in February
Description: Sales of new U.S. single-family homes increased to an 11-month high in February and sales for January were revised higher, suggesting that lower mortgage rates were starting to lift the struggling housing market.

Headlines: Starboard no longer urging investors to vote against Bristol-Celgene deal
Description: Activist hedge fund Starboard Value LP said on Friday it will no longer urge shareholders to oppose Bristol-Myers Squibb Co's plans to buy Celgene Corp, even though it thinks the deal is too risky and will vote its own shares against it.

Headlines: Cost of Boeing groundings rises as TUI takes $200 million-plus hit
Description: Anglo-German tour operator TUI became the latest Boeing 737 MAX operator to warn of a hit to its profits as the U.S. planemaker moved to restore confidence in its best-selling model after two fatal crashes that have grounded the planes worldwide.

Headlines: Lyft to prioritize North America growth over international expansion: chairman
Description: Lyft Inc Chairman Sean Aggarwal said on Friday the ride-hailing company will continue to prioritize North America growth over international expansion after completing its initial public offering (IPO).

Headlines: Lyft valued at $24.3 billion in first ride-hailing IPO
Description: Lyft Inc was valued at $24.3 billion in the first initial public offering (IPO) of a ride-hailing startup on Thursday, raising more than it had set off to do as investors overlooked uncertainty over its path to becoming a profitable company.

Headlines: Lyft indicated to open 19.4 percent higher for Nasdaq debut, after IPO
Description: Lyft Inc shares on Friday were seen opening 19.4 percent higher at $86.00 in its market debut on the Nasdaq, after the company was valued at $24.3 billion in the first initial public offering (IPO) of a ride-hailing startup.

Headlines: TUI sticks with Boeing, sees 737 MAXs flying by mid-July
Description: Anglo-German tour operator TUI said it has no intention of scaling back orders for Boeing's 737 MAX planes after two fatal crashes, and expects them to be flying again by mid-July based on feedback from the U.S. planemaker and EU regulator.

Headlines: AstraZeneca pays up to $6.9 billion in Daiichi Sankyo cancer deal
Description: AstraZeneca Plc will pay up to $6.9 billion to work with Daiichi Sankyo Co Ltd on a hotly-tipped experimental treatment for breast cancer, in a direct challenge to the world's biggest cancer drug maker Roche.

Headlines: Mondelez in advanced talks for Campbell's international business: Bloomberg
Description: Oreo cookies maker Mondelez International Inc is in advanced talks to buy international brands of U.S. food company Campbell Soup Co, Bloomberg reported late on Thursday.

Headlines: Daimler buys Torc Robotics stake for self-driving trucks
Description: Daimler Trucks has agreed to buy a majority stake in self-driving truck software maker Torc Robotics as part of a broader push to develop autonomous vehicles.

Headlines: White House says progress made in trade talks with China
Description: The White House said on Friday that the United States and China made progress toward a trade agreement during "constructive discussions" this week in Beijing.

Headlines: Women running the money? Rarely at hedge funds
Description: Generous salary and juicy bonus? Check. Client meetings at private members' club? Check. Swanky Mayfair office? Check. Company maternity scheme? Maybe, we’ll get back to you.

Headlines: Factbox: Airlines set out cost after Boeing plane grounded
Description: Tour operator TUI warned its profit would fall by at least 200 million euros ($225 million) this year after the grounding of Boeing's 737 MAX aircraft, further evidence of the financial impact of two fatal crashes involving the same type of plane.

Headlines: H&M shares fly off the shelves as turnaround strategy shows promise
Description: Fashion retailer H&M reported a much smaller than expected fall in quarterly profit on Friday as it sold more products at full price and margins held up, in a first sign that its turnaround strategy is producing results.

Description: (This March 28 story corrects third paragraph after Amazon corrects number of Latin America Edge locations from four to six.)

Description: Lyft Inc has been challenging larger ride-hailing rival Uber Technologies Inc for years by cultivating an image of caring more for its drivers, riders and the environment. As the company debuts in the stock market on Friday, it hopes to convince investors the "nice guy" image will pay off.

Headlines: Huawei urges U.S. to drop 'loser's attitude' as carrier business revenue slips
Description: China's Huawei Technologies called on Washington to drop the "loser's attitude" and once again rubbished U.S. allegations its gear could be used by Beijing for spying, as its network business weakened amid mounting global scrutiny.

Headlines: BP CEO Dudley's 2018 pay slips to $14.7 million
Description: BP Chief Executive Bob Dudley's pay package slipped to $14.7 million last year from $15.1 million in 2017, even though the oil and gas company's profits doubled to a five-year high.

Headlines: Exclusive: Goldman’s China-backed fund bucks trade tensions to buy U.S. firm
Description: Goldman Sachs Group Inc invested money from China's sovereign wealth fund in a California-based industrial company and is looking for more U.S. deals, three sources familiar with the matter said, even after increased scrutiny from Washington all but stopped U.S.-China deals last year.

Headlines: Exclusive: Chinese EV car maker NIO restricts its IPO banks from working for rivals - sources
Description: Chinese electric vehicle (EV) maker NIO Inc has blocked the eight top investment banks that did its IPO from working for rivals by tying them up in rare year-long non-compete clauses, several people with direct knowledge of the matter said.

Headlines: Rescue deal is no panacea for India's struggling Jet Airways
Description: Jet Airways' investors are cheering this week's government-led rescue deal, but the cash-strapped Indian airline's future looks mired in uncertainty as convincing a new investor to come on board may not be easy.

Headlines: As IPO flood recedes, Asia bankers bet on follow-on capital raising
Description: Bankers in Asia are betting on newly-listed companies returning to the markets for fresh capital as last year's flood of initial public offerings (IPOs) slows to a trickle, with 2019 seeing the weakest start in equity sales in three years.

Headlines: Thyssenkrupp, Embraer to build four ships for Brazil's navy
Description: Brazil's navy has selected German industrial conglomerate Thyssenkrupp and domestic aircraft maker Embraer to build four corvettes, Thyssenkrupp said on Friday.

Headlines: U.S. authority sent Nordea and SEB information requests: Bloomberg
Description: New York's financial regulator has sent letters to Nordic banks Nordea and SEB asking for detailed information about their dealings with Danske Bank, Bloomberg reported, citing an unidentified source.

Headlines: Sriwijaya Air cancels plan to lease two Boeing 737 MAX jets
Description: Indonesia's Sriwijaya Air, which is operated by flag carrier Garuda Indonesia, has cancelled plan to lease two Boeing Co 737 MAX jets, a spokesman said on Friday.

Headlines: Mnuchin says U.S.-China trade talks were 'constructive'
Description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin said in a tweet on Friday that he and U.S. Trade Representative Robert Lighthizer had concluded "constructive" trade talks in Beijing.

Headlines: Tesla supplier agrees to buy GM's South Korean plant for EV manufacturing
Description: A South Korean supplier of Tesla Inc said on Friday it had agreed to buy a shuttered auto factory from General Motors' local unit to start contract manufacturing of electric vehicles.

Description: Stephen Wang is counting the costs of President Donald Trump's trade war. He had to put down 12 times more cash as a guarantee to U.S. customs that he would pay the bill for tariffs on the Chinese-made pumps, valves and motors he imports.

Headlines: Global M&A slides in first quarter as Brexit weighs on Europe

Description: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Thursday delayed a controversial plan aimed at evaluating how stock exchange fees and incentives affect how brokers trade, while the exchanges sue the regulator in an attempt to kill the experiment.

Headlines: Fed done raising interest rates; significant chance of cut in 2020: Reuters poll

Headlines: Nestle to face lawsuit saying Poland Spring water not from a spring: U.S. judge
Description: A federal judge on Thursday rejected Nestle SA's bid to dismiss a revised lawsuit claiming that it defrauded consumers by filling bottles of its Poland Spring water with ordinary groundwater.

Headlines: U.S. lawsuit filed against Boeing over Ethiopian Airlines crash
Description: A lawsuit against Boeing Co was filed in U.S. federal court on Thursday in what appeared to be the first suit over a March 10 Ethiopian Airlines 737 MAX crash that killed 157 people.

Headlines: Bayer shares sag after U.S. jury verdict in Roundup cancer trial
Description: Bayer AG shares sank to their lowest in almost seven years on Thursday after a U.S. jury awarded $80 million to a man who claimed use of the group's weed killer Roundup caused his cancer, with thousands of similar lawsuits looming.

Headlines: No call for simulators in new Boeing 737 MAX training proposals
Description: Boeing Co said it will submit by the end of this week a training package that 737 MAX pilots are required to take before a worldwide ban can be lifted, proposing as it did before two deadly crashes that those pilots do not need time on flight simulators to safely operate the aircraft.

Headlines: Wells Fargo CEO Tim Sloan steps down
Description: Wells Fargo & Co said on Thursday Tim Sloan will resign immediately as chief executive, becoming the second CEO to leave the bank in the fallout of a wide-ranging sales practices scandal.

Headlines: Disney bans smoking at U.S. parks ahead of 'Star Wars' openings
Description: Walt Disney Co will ban smoking, vaping and large strollers at its U.S. theme parks in California and Florida starting on May 1, the company said on Thursday.

Description: Facebook Inc toughened its rules on political advertising in Europe on Friday under pressure from EU regulators to do more to guard against foreign meddling in the bloc's upcoming legislative election.    Chastened since Russia used the social media platform to influence polls that swept U.S. President Donald Trump to power, Facebook says it has ploughed resources and staff into safeguarding the ballot across 27 EU nations on May 26.

Headlines: WTO says U.S. failed to halt state tax subsidy for Boeing

Description: Swedbank dismissed Birgitte Bonnesen as chief executive on Thursday only an hour before its annual meeting after disgruntled shareholders rounded on her handling of a rapidly-growing money laundering scandal.

Description: General Motors Co on Thursday said it has no plan to cut the sticker price on its electric Chevrolet Bolt sedan after a federal tax credit drops by half to $3,750 on Monday.

Headlines: Benchmark yields rise, stocks mixed with eye on trade, growth

Headlines: Citgo raises $1.2 billion loan to run operations, refinance debt
Description: Citgo Petroleum, the U.S.-based unit of Venezuelan state-run oil firm PDVSA, said on Thursday it raised $1.2 billion through a five-year term loan to cover operating expenses and to refinance existing debt.

Description: Apple Inc attempted to reintroduce itself on Monday as an entertainment and financial services company that also makes iPhones as it launched a streaming television service, a credit card and an online gaming arcade.

Description: Apple Inc brought in Oprah Winfrey, Steven Spielberg, Jennifer Aniston and Jason Momoa to talk up its new television streaming service at a Hollywood-style event on Monday marked by standing ovations, hugs and soaring rhetoric.

Headlines: Buffett says Apple content plan hard to predict, touts airline safety
Description: Warren Buffett on Thursday said he could not predict the success of Apple Inc's new suite of services but was confident the public would benefit as content providers vie for their wallets.

Description: Washington Governor Jay Inslee said on Thursday his state was reviewing a World Trade Organization ruling against Boeing Co on a tax case and will consult with the U.S. Trade Representative on next steps.

Description: J. Crew Group Inc has tapped restructuring lawyers for the second time in as many years to explore options for reworking its debt, as the U.S. clothing chain struggles with falling sales and a dwindling cash pile, people familiar with the matter said on Thursday.

Headlines: Britain rebukes Huawei over security failings, discloses more flaws

Description: A brawl between World Wrestling Entertainment Inc's bears and bulls could reach a peak this year as the company renegotiates overseas contracts.

Headlines: N.Y. accuses opioid maker Purdue of illegal fund transfers to Sacklers
Description: Purdue Pharma LP fraudulently transferred funds to members of the wealthy Sackler family who control the OxyContin maker despite knowing it faced major liabilities that had made it already insolvent, New York's attorney general alleged on Thursday.

Headlines: Lyft raises IPO price target as investor fret over missing out
Description: Lyft Inc on Wednesday raised the price range for its initial public offering, as investors looked past the ride-hailing startup's mounting losses to the company's growing market share against larger rival Uber Technologies Inc.

Headlines: Lululemon soars on menswear, online push; inches into Nike turf
Description: Shares of yoga-pants specialists Lululemon Athletica Inc rose 15 percent on Thursday, with several Wall Street analysts raising their price targets for the company after a blockbuster fourth quarter.

Description: Apparel maker PVH Corp said on Thursday it would exit its high-end collection of Calvin Klein apparel and shut the label's flagship store on New York's Madison Avenue, as the fashion line failed to strike a chord with customers.

Headlines: Kudlow says U.S. could lift some tariffs on China as part of trade deal
Description: White House economic adviser Larry Kudlow said on Thursday the United States could lift some tariffs on China, while leaving others in place as part of an enforcement mechanism on a U.S.-China trade deal.

Description: A second former Barclays banker has been convicted of conspiring to manipulate global Euribor interest rates, taking  to nine the number of people found guilty in six rate-rigging trials.

Description: Volkswagen has signed a deal to develop a pickup truck with U.S. rival Ford and continues discussions about extending its alliance to include autonomous driving and mobility services, the German carmaker said on Thursday.

Description: A U.S. jury on Wednesday awarded $80 million to a man who claimed his use of Bayer AG's glyphosate-based weed killer Roundup caused his cancer, in the latest legal setback for the company facing thousands of similar lawsuits.

Headlines: Swedish minister 'outraged' over Swedbank handling of money laundering allegations
Description: Sweden's financial markets minister on Thursday expressed outrage over how Swedbank had handled money laundering allegations against it, saying separately it could put confidence in the financial system at risk.

Description: - The U.S. economy slowed more than initially thought in the fourth quarter, keeping growth in 2018 below the Trump administration's 3 percent annual target, and corporate profits failed to rise for the first time in more than two years.

Headlines: EU court clears German green charge exemption to industry
Description: Germany acted legally when it exempted heavy industry from a green energy surcharge in 2012, the European Union's top court said on Thursday, overturning a decision by the EU antitrust regulator and annulling EU orders to recover the aid.

Headlines: Sony to close smartphone plant in China to cut costs
Description: Sony Corp is closing its Beijing smartphone plant, a spokesman said on Thursday, as the Japanese electronics giant cuts costs in an attempt to make the money-losing handset business profitable from next year.

Headlines: Exclusive: U.S.-hired firm audits Russia's Rusal for compliance with sanctions deal
Description: A firm hired by the U.S. Treasury Department is auditing Russian aluminum giant Rusal to check whether it is complying with the terms of a deal under which Washington agreed to lift sanctions on the company, Rusal said.

Headlines: Swedbank says has been truthful over money laundering probes
Description: Swedbank believes it has been honest with authorities looking into allegations that accounts at the bank may have been used for money laundering, its chairman said on Thursday.

Description: Britain's markets watchdog said on Thursday it had fined Goldman Sachs International a record 34.3 million pounds ($45 million) for failing to provide accurate reporting of transactions over a decade.

Description: Sony Corp on Thursday said chairman Kazuo Hirai, who helped engineer the electronics giant's recent revival, will retire in June, bowing out as the Japanese company is on track for another record profit this year.

Headlines: Zara founder's real estate arm buys Amazon offices in Seattle
Description: Pontegadea Inmobiliaria, the real estate arm of the founder of fashion group Inditex, Amancio Ortega, this week completed the purchase of two Seattle office blocks leased to Amazon, a Pontegadea spokesman said on Thursday.

Description: Daimler will build its next generation of Smart electric cars in China through a joint venture with Geely, as a way to increase economies of scale in a market segment that is struggling to turn a profit.

Description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin said on Thursday he and U.S. Trade Representative Robert Lighthizer looked forward to "productive meetings" as they arrived in Beijing leading a delegation for trade talks with China.

Description: Volkswagen is not interested in a tie-up with rival Fiat Chrysler as the German carmaker's efforts were all focused internally, Chief Executive Herbert Diess told Il Sole 24 Ore and other two newspapers.

Description: After almost three decades in senior compliance roles at large financial firms including Bank of New York Mellon's Pershing and Goldman Sachs Group Inc, Jeff Horowitz made an unconventional career move.

Description: Some creditors of PG&E Corp, including Elliott Management Corp and Pacific Investment Management Co (Pimco), are proposing a $35 billion plan for the California power utility to exit bankruptcy within a year, Bloomberg reported late on Wednesday.

Description: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration said Wednesday that it has not yet granted provisional approval for Boeing Co's announced anti-stall software upgrade of 737 MAX aircraft following crashes in Indonesia and Ethiopia.

Description: The U.S. Commerce Department said on Wednesday it had initiated an anti-dumping duty and countervailing duty investigation of wooden cabinets and vanities imported from China to determine whether they are being dumped on the U.S. market.

Headlines: J&J settles three mesothelioma talc cases-plaintiffs' lawyer
Description: Johnson & Johnson has settled three cases brought by plaintiffs who claimed asbestos in the company's talcum-based products caused mesothelioma, an attorney for the plaintiffs' said on Wednesday.
