Headlines: EU signs Singapore trade deal, urges China to open up
Description: The European Union signed a free-trade deal with Singapore at a summit with Asian leaders on Friday and pressed China to allow greater foreign investment in its economy, but ran into familiar resistance from Beijing over state subsidies.

Headlines: Honeywell says China growth slowing, tariffs to squeeze margins
Description: Honeywell  said on Friday it was seeing slower growth in China and that trade tariffs would squeeze margins and potentially cost it "hundreds of millions" of dollars in 2019.

Headlines: P&G shares surge on strong results, higher product prices
Description: Procter & Gamble Co  reported better-than-expected quarterly profit and sales, and said it was raising prices on several products around the world, sending shares up on Friday by their most in a decade.

Headlines: SolarWinds shares rise 3.2 percent in downsized market debut
Description: SolarWinds Corp's shares  rose as much as 3.2 percent in their downsized U.S. market debut on Friday, giving the enterprise software maker a market value of about $4.80 billion.

Headlines: Daimler's diesel troubles trigger new profit warning
Description: German carmaker Daimler AG  said its operating profit would fall by over 10 percent this year, its second earnings warning since June, blaming "government proceedings and measures in various regions" as a crackdown on diesel emissions takes a toll.

Headlines: Schlumberger reports slight profit beat, warns of sluggish U.S. growth
Description: Schlumberger NV , the world's largest oilfield services provider, reported a slight profit beat on Friday but cautioned that North American growth would slow due to transportation bottlenecks and hurt results next quarter.

Headlines: Australia's NAB cuts 300 staff over wrongdoing
Description: About 300 staff of National Australia Bank  have been fired or left the company as a result of internal investigations into wrongdoing, Chief Executive Andrew Thorburn said on Friday, following public revelations of misconduct across the sector.

Headlines: Ford CEO seeks to rally dealers as shares sink to new low
Description: With Ford Motor Co's stock at nearly a nine-year low and the company squeezed by tariffs and trade tensions, Chief Executive Jim Hackett sought to restore confidence among dealers gathered in Las Vegas this week, days ahead of announcing the automaker's third-quarter results.

Headlines: U.S. existing home sales fall for sixth straight month
Description: U.S. home sales fell in September by the most in over two years as the housing market continued to struggle despite strength across the broader economy.

Headlines: Honeywell says tariff-related costs to weigh on margins in 2019
Description: Honeywell International Inc  said on Friday costs related to trade tariffs could put pressure on margins in 2019.

Headlines: China moves to lift confidence as economic growth hits weakest pace since 2009
Description: China's economic growth cooled to its weakest quarterly pace since the global financial crisis, with regulators moving  quickly to calm nervous investors as a years-long campaign to tackle debt risks and the trade war with the United States began to bite.

Headlines: Exclusive: OPEC, allies struggle to fully deliver pledged oil output boost - internal document
Description: OPEC is struggling to add barrels to the market after agreeing in June to increase output, an internal document seen by Reuters showed, as an increase in Saudi Arabia was offset by declines in Iran, Venezuela and Angola.

Headlines: Dell to take $21.7 billion tracking stock offer to December vote: sources
Description: Dell Technologies Inc will ask holders of "tracking stock" tied to its software company VMware Inc to vote on its $21.7 billion cash-and-stock offer to buy it back from them on Dec. 11, according to people familiar with the matter.

Headlines: EU Commission approves Microsoft's acquisition of Github
Description: The European Commission approved on Friday the acquisition of software development tool maker GitHub by software giant Microsoft without conditions saying the purchase would not damage competition in the sector.

Headlines: Clash over Trump tariffs heats up with barrage of WTO litigation
Description: Disputes over U.S. tariffs and retaliatory moves by other states have sparked 12 requests for adjudication at the World Trade Organization, signalling an escalation in global trade tensions.

Headlines: UK should bring forward new petrol and diesel car ban to 2032 – lawmakers
Description: Britain should bring forward a ban on the sale of new petrol and diesel cars and vans by eight years to 2032 to help the country reduce its greenhouse gas emissions, a parliamentary committee said on Friday.

Headlines: Tesla rises after co launches new Model 3 for $45,000
Description: - Shares of electric carmaker  up 1.6 pct at $268.21 premarket

Headlines: Europe-Asia statement to avoid China subsidies criticism: draft
Description: A final communique for the Europe-Asia leaders summit will not include language calling for an end to trade and market distorting measures by governments at China's request, according to the latest draft and EU diplomats.

Headlines: No room at the inn: Central Europe student housing crunch attracts investors
Description: Wroclaw's hulking Soviet-era public dormitories held little appeal for Odysseas Savvas when he moved to the Polish city from Greece to study business at university. Instead, he opted for his own room and bathroom in a newly built private residence.

Headlines: China's regulators rush to rally market confidence, boosting shares
Description: China's regulators lined up to rally market confidence on Friday with new rules, measures and words of comfort as shares brushed near four-year lows for the second straight day before surging.

Headlines: Vivendi CEO denies company wants to call Telecom Italia shareholder meeting on board
Description: A report Vivendi  is thinking of calling a shareholder meeting at Telecom Italia  to appoint four more board members are off the mark, the French media group's CEO said.

Headlines: SAIC VW starts work on $2.5 billion China plant in Audi pivot
Description: Volkswagen AG's  China venture with SAIC Motor Corp Ltd  has started building a $2.5 billion new energy vehicle (NEV) plant in Shanghai, which will make VW's luxury Audi AG  brand cars, a possible first for the venture.

Headlines: Italy's Armani will remain independent: paper
Description: Italian fashion house Giorgio Armani has been approached by many suitors but intends to remain an independent player, the company's founder and owner said in an interview in MF daily on Friday.

Headlines: Asia air cargo market gets e-commerce boost as trade war yet to bite
Description: Strong e-commerce demand is fuelling Asia's air freight market, with the U.S.-China trade war having minimal negative impact so far and in some cases even boosting shipments, industry executives said on Friday.

Headlines: China's real estate investment slows in September as caution sinks in
Description: Growth in China's real estate investment eased in September and home sales fell for the first time since April, as developers dialed back expansion plans amid economic uncertainties and as additional curbs on speculative investment kicked in.

Headlines: China September coal output hits nine-month high as new capacity starts up
Description: China's coal output hit its highest in nine months in September, government data showed on Friday, boosted as new mining capacity started up in the country's northwest.

Headlines: Instant View: China's third quarter GDP rises 6.5 percent year-on-year, slowest since 2009
Description: China's third quarter economic growth slowed to its weakest pace since the global financial crisis, and missed expectations, as a years-long campaign to tackle debt risks and the trade war with the United States began to bite.

Headlines: China able to reach 2018 growth target: stats bureau
Description: China will be able to reach its full-year economic growth target of around 6.5 percent in 2018 even as downward pressure increases, and will be able to maintain steady growth next year, a spokesman of the country's statistics bureau said on Friday.

Headlines: China September industrial output weakens; investment, retail sales beat expectations
Description: China's industrial output grew 5.8 percent in September from a year earlier, missing expectations, while fixed-asset investment growth rose to 5.4 percent in the first nine months, above forecasts, data showed on Friday.

Headlines: China third quarter GDP growth slows to 6.5 percent year-on-year, missing forecast
Description: China's economy grew at a slower than expected pace of 6.5 percent in the third quarter from a year earlier, marking the weakest rate since the global financial crisis, official data showed on Friday.

Headlines: Exclusive: U.S. asks for WTO panel over metals tariff retaliation
Description: The United States is requesting that a World Trade Organization dispute resolution panel get involved in a clash over international retaliation over U.S. tariffs on steel and aluminum, according to a U.S. official familiar with the matter.

Headlines: China asks WTO to set up panel to discuss U.S. steel, aluminum measures
Description: China has filed a request with the World Trade Organisation to establish an expert group to determine the legality of tariffs imposed by the United States on imports of steel and aluminum, the Ministry of Commerce said late on Thursday.

Headlines: Wall St. slides as Saudi Arabia, Italy add to economic concerns
Description: U.S. stocks fell more than 1 percent on Thursday as the European Commission issued a warning regarding Italy's budget and concerns mounted over the possibility of strained relations between the United States and Saudi Arabia, further denting investors' appetite for risk amid global trade tensions and rising interest rates.

Headlines: Mexico's Walmex third-quarter profit driven by solid sales
Description: Mexico's biggest retailer, Wal-Mart de Mexico , reported on Thursday a 7.9 percent rise in third-quarter revenue, capitalizing on sales traffic in Mexico that compensated for slow growth in Central America and a tough comparison base.

Headlines: Micron to buy Intel's stake in joint venture IM Flash Technologies
Description: Micron Technology Inc  said on Thursday it planned to take full control of IM Flash Technologies joint venture with Intel Corp .

Headlines: Goldman Sachs joins growing band of businesses snubbing Saudi conference
Description: Goldman Sachs Group Inc on Thursday joined the growing list of high-profile businesses snubbing a Saudi investment conference next week amid mounting pressure on Riyad over the disappearance of journalist Jamal Khashoggi.

Headlines: Amazon to open Manchester office as it adds 1,000 British jobs
Description: Amazon.com  is opening its first office in Manchester, northern England, and expanding two other centers to house 1,000 new R&D roles in what it said was a major new investment in British innovation.

Headlines: PayPal quarterly profit beats estimates, shares rise
Description: PayPal Holdings Inc  on Thursday reported a third-quarter  profit that beat analysts' estimates as the company signed up more new customers and volume of payments processed rose.

Headlines: AIG sees third-quarter catastrophe losses of $1.5 billion-$1.7 billion
Description: Insurer American International Group Inc  said on Thursday it expects third-quarter pre-tax catastrophe losses, net of reinsurance, of between $1.5 billion and $1.7 billion.

Headlines: Internet provider groups sue Vermont over net neutrality law
Description: Five industry groups representing major internet providers and cable companies filed suit on Thursday seeking to block a Vermont law barring companies that do not abide by net neutrality rules from receiving state contracts.

Headlines: Banks urge U.S. regulators to reconsider 'Volcker Rule' tweaks
Description: Banks on Thursday pushed back on how regulators are attempting to simplify rules prohibiting banks from trading on their own account, a development that is likely to delay efforts to wrap up the overhaul in the coming months.

Headlines: Global stocks tumble on souring sentiment; oil falls
Description: Stocks fell sharply on Thursday while the Japanese yen rose in a move toward safety assets, with traders citing the Sino-U.S. trade war, Italy's budget concerns and a widening gap between the United States and Saudi Arabia.

Headlines: Campbell, Third Point battle heats up, no concessions on the table
Description: Activist investor Daniel Loeb and Campbell Soup Co  hardened their positions in the battle over the soup maker's future on Thursday as the hedge fund manager tried to woo retail shareholders and the company's interim chief executive told Reuters that Loeb had left no room for compromise.

Headlines: AmEx tops profit estimates on higher consumer spending
Description: American Express Co  topped Wall Street estimates for third-quarter profit on Thursday and lifted its yearly earnings forecast, as a strengthening U.S. economy powered higher credit card spending.

Headlines: Senator Warren urges Fed to require removal of Wells Fargo CEO
Description: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren said on Thursday the Federal Reserve should not allow Wells Fargo & Co  to grow in size until the bank replaces Chief Executive Officer Tim Sloan.

Headlines: De Beers eyes tech markets for synthetic diamonds future
Description: Anglo American unit De Beers is going after lucrative, but elusive high-tech markets in quantum computing, as it aims to expand its lab-grown diamond business beyond drilling and cutting.

Headlines: Goldman Sachs sees five more Fed rate hikes through end of 2019
Description: Goldman Sachs economists on Thursday said the firm remained "comfortable" with its call for five more interest rate hikes — two more than priced in financial markets — through the end of 2019.

Headlines: Colgate halts Venezuela detergent plant for lack of boxes
Description: U.S. consumer goods maker Colgate-Palmolive Co  has halted production at its detergent and dish soap plant in Venezuela because it lacked cardboard boxes to ship products, a union leader said on Thursday.

Headlines: VW's Porsche expects to repeat record vehicle sales this year
Description: Volkswagen's  Porsche brand does not need a stock market listing to fund growth, Chief Executive Oliver Blume said, adding he is confident the maker of the iconic 911 sportscar can repeat last year's record sales in 2018.

Headlines: Campbell Soup CEO sees no room for concessions to Third Point
Description: Campbell Soup Co  interim Chief Executive Keith McLoughlin does not believe that there are any concessions to be made in an ongoing proxy fight with hedge fund Third Point LLC, he told Reuters on Thursday.

Headlines: Casino confident on disposal plan, third-quarter sales accelerate
Description: French retailer Casino , which is battling investor concern over its high debt, said sales growth accelerated in the third quarter, reflecting an improving performance in France and Brazil and it predicted a similar trend for the fourth quarter.

Headlines: Busy as a Jollibee: Asia's fast-food giant expands abroad
Description: Jollibee Foods , a major Asian fast-food operator, hopes to generate half its sales outside its home market of the Philippines within five to seven years, up from 30 percent now, its chief executive told Reuters.

Headlines: Michelin cuts market forecasts on EU emissions squeeze, China slowdown
Description: French tire maker Michelin  cut its full-year market forecasts on Thursday and said a sales slowdown would worsen in the fourth quarter, blaming weaker Chinese vehicle demand and new emissions standards that have hit European registrations.

Headlines: Starbucks to let Mexico's Alsea operate stores in four European markets
Description: Starbucks Corp  said on Thursday it would give its longtime partner Mexico's Alsea SAB  the rights to operate its cafes in France, the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg as the coffee chain tries to streamline its operations in markets where sales have struggled.

Headlines: Blackstone waves off concerns over Saudi funding
Description: Blackstone Group LP , the U.S. buyout firm which is relying on Saudi Arabia to provide half the money for its planned $40 billion infrastructure fund, waved off concerns about funding on Thursday even as controversy rages over the disappearance of a Saudi journalist that has frayed relations between Wall Street and the oil-rich kingdom.

Headlines: U.S. probes 54,400 Ford trucks over tailgate complaints
Description: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said Thursday it had opened a preliminary investigation into 54,400 Ford Motor Co  pickup trucks after receiving five complaints that tailgates had unexpectedly opened while the vehicles were in motion.

Headlines: Square introduces new payment terminal for small businesses
Description: Square Inc, the company led by Twitter Inc Chief Executive Jack Dorsey, on Thursday launched a payment terminal for small business clients, expanding its suite of hardware products.

Headlines: Coca-Cola names company veteran Brian Smith chief operating officer
Description: Coca-Cola Co  on Thursday appointed company veteran Brian Smith as its chief operating officer, a role that has been vacant since former COO James Quincey became chief executive officer last year.

Headlines: VW to offer buyer incentive for scrapping older German diesels
Description: Volkswagen  on Thursday said it will offer trade-in incentives and a bonus for scrapping older diesel vehicles in Germany, in a move to stave off driving bans in polluted cities.

Headlines: Factbox: Trade-in incentives in Germany to replace old diesel cars
Description: Carmakers have started offering trade-in incentives in Germany  to encourage customers to scrap older diesel vehicles and buy more sustainable engines.

Headlines: SAP plays down margin fears, prioritizes growth: CFO
Description: Faster than expected growth in its cloud business has pressured margins at German business software company SAP , but for Chief Financial Officer Luka Mucic that's a good problem to have.

Headlines: Brazil court denies Monsanto bid to halt seed licensing to bankrupt firm
Description: A Brazilian appeals court denied a request this month by Monsanto's local unit to suspend licensing of its popular Intacta soy seed technology to privately owned seed maker Sementes Talismã, according to a ruling seen by Reuters.

Headlines: Motor racing: McLaren sign short-term partnership with Coca-Cola
Description: McLaren have signed a partnership with Coca-Cola until the end of the season that will see the soft drinks company's brand appear on a Formula One car for the first time, the team announced on Thursday.

Headlines: Pricing boost helps Philip Morris quarterly results to beat estimates
Description: Philip Morris International , maker of Marlboro cigarettes, maintained its full-year guidance on Thursday after higher pricing helped it to report better than expected quarterly sales and profit.

Headlines: Ryanair makes no concessions to Polish union demands on contracts
Description: Ryanair  will press ahead with plans to move Polish staff on to self-employed contracts, Ryanair's Chief Marketing Officer Kenny Jacobs said in an interview with Reuters.

Headlines: Macau billionaire revives dormant theme park project, without theme park
Description: The son of billionaire Macau casino magnate Stanley Ho on Thursday announced the revival of an entertainment project left dormant for eight years, as authorities move to seize idle land in the world's largest gambling hub.

Headlines: Primark sharpens ethical focus in bid for German customers
Description: Primark, the fashion chain owned by Associated British Foods , has emphasized its commitment to environmental standards and safer working conditions as it fights for market share in discount-loving Germany and other countries.

Headlines: Price increases underpin sales growth at Nestle, Unilever
Description: Nestle  and Unilever  , two of the world's biggest consumer goods makers, both reported a pick-up in quarterly sales on Thursday after getting higher prices for their products.

Headlines: Ericsson has dismissed 50 employees following U.S. corruption probe
Description: Mobile telecom gear maker Ericsson  said on Thursday that it has dismissed 50 people over a U.S. corruption probe it warned could lead to a financial penalty.

Headlines: Tesla secures Shanghai site for $2 billion China Gigafactory
Description: Tesla Inc has signed an agreement with the Shanghai government for an 860,000 square meter plot of land to build its first overseas Gigafactory, the electric carmaker said in a Chinese social media post on Wednesday.

Headlines: Air France KLM shares rise on hopes of union pay deal
Description: Air France KLM  shares rose on Thursday, which traders attributed to a report on the website of business publication La Tribune that Air France would put forward a pay agreement proposal to unions later this week.

Headlines: Indonesia raids home of Lippo Group deputy chairman in bribery probe
Description: Indonesia's anti-graft agency said on Thursday it had raided 10 locations, including the home of Lippo Group Deputy Chairman James Riady, as part of a bribery investigation linked to the conglomerate's $21 billion Meikarta real estate project.

Headlines: 'Enough excuses!' France's Le Maire grows impatient over GAFA tax
Description: Europe has talked long enough about whether to make internet giants like Google , Apple  and Facebook  pay more taxes and it is time for a decision, French Finance Minister Bruno Le Maire said on Thursday.

Headlines: Google to charge smartphone makers for Google Play in Europe
Description: Alphabet Inc's  Google on Tuesday revamped how it distributes its mobile apps in the European Union, introducing a licensing fee for device makers to access its app marketplace in a response to regulators' findings that it had broken antitrust law.

Headlines: Exxon Mobil bets big on China LNG, sidesteps trade war
Description: In the middle of a Sino-U.S. trade war, the world's largest publicly traded oil and gas company is turning toward Beijing for business at a time when most of Corporate America is looking elsewhere to avoid the threat of tariffs.

Headlines: Hacked, scammed and on your own: navigating cryptocurrency 'wild west'
Description: When Peggy and Marco Lachmann-Anke learned in January that hackers cracked a 40-character password and cleaned out their cryptocurrency wallet, they did not go to the police or alert the tokens' issuer, the Berlin-based technology group IOTA.

Headlines: Takeda gets Japanese approval for $62 billion Shire purchase
Description: Takeda Pharmaceutical Co Ltd  said on Thursday Japan's Fair Trade Commission had approved its $62 billion acquisition of Shire Plc , bringing the Japanese firm closer to sealing a deal that will make it a global top 10 drugmaker.

Headlines: UK fashion retailer New Look to exit China, close 120 stores
Description: British fashion group New Look is to exit China and will close its remaining 120 stores there by the end of the year, it said on Thursday.

Headlines: Blackstone concedes defeat to Canada's Oxford in battle for Australia's Investa
Description: Private equity giant Blackstone Group  has quit a takeover battle for Australian office-block owner Investa Office Fund  after it was gazumped by Canadian landlord Oxford Properties Group's A$3.35 billion ($2.4 billion) bid.

Headlines: Dividend windfall: Santander latest target in Germany's giant fraud probe
Description: Spain's Santander  is the latest bank to be caught up in Germany's biggest post-war fraud investigation involving a share-trading scheme that the authorities say cost taxpayers billions of euros.

Headlines: Trade off: China soybean imports set for biggest drop in 12 years amid tariff conflict
Description: China's soybean imports are set to drop by a quarter in the last three months of 2018, their biggest fall in at least 12 years as buyers curb purchases amid the Sino-U.S. trade war and high domestic stockpiles.

Headlines: U.S. Senate panel wants to question Hyundai, Kia over engine fire reports
Description: The Senate Commerce Committee's Republican chairman and ranking Democrat said on Wednesday they had asked top U.S. executives at Hyundai Motor Co  and Kia Motors Corp  to testify at a Nov. 14 hearing on reports of engine fires involving vehicles from the Korean automakers.

Headlines: Story on Zhoushan in talks with Exxon Mobil on ethylene plant withdrawn
Description: The story headlined 'China's Zhoushan city woos Exxon Mobil for a $7 bln ethylene plant' is withdrawn. The provincial government has withdrawn its original statement issued on Wednesday because it was not factually correct, an official told Reuters. There will be no replacement story.

Headlines: China's Geely 'corrects' rumors about presidential family ties
Description: Chinese carmaker Geely Automobile Holdings Ltd , long the subject of speculation about its political ties, has moved to dispel a widely held belief its chairman's wife was related to Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Headlines: Facebook tentatively concludes spammers were behind recent data breach: WSJ
Description: Facebook Inc  has tentatively concluded that spammers looking to make money, and not a nation-state, were behind the largest-ever data theft at the social media company, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.

Headlines: Alcoa's profit beat fueled by rising alumina prices, shares rise
Description: Top U.S. aluminum producer Alcoa Corp  reported a better-than-expected quarterly profit on Wednesday, as a series of supply hits boosted alumina prices.

Headlines: At Facebook, public funds join push to remove Zuckerberg as chairman
Description: Four major U.S. public funds that hold shares in Facebook Inc on Wednesday proposed removing Chief Executive Officer Mark Zuckerberg as chairman following several high-profile scandals and said they hoped to gain backing from larger asset managers.

Headlines: Corona maker's CEO Rob Sands to step down, insider to replace him
Description: Constellation Brands Inc's  Rob Sands is stepping down as CEO, ending an era in which the family-backed alcohol producer became one of the biggest beer brewers in the United States and placed a multi-billion dollar bet on the cannabis industry.

Headlines: Wall St. falls as investors eye a united hawkish Fed
Description: Wall Street's major indexes edged lower after a choppy session on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve showed broad agreement on the need to raise borrowing costs further, cementing investor concerns that had helped cause a major sell-off the week before.

Headlines: Musk to buy $20 million in Tesla stock
Description: Tesla Inc  Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk will purchase company stock worth $20 million in the next open trading session, the electric carmaker said in a filing on Wednesday.

Headlines: Factbox: Tesla executive departures since 2016
Description: Electric carmaker Tesla Inc  has seen a flurry of senior executives leave the company in recent months.

Headlines: Northrop Grumman wins $697 million U.S. defense contract: Pentagon
Description: Northrop Grumman Corp  has been awarded a $697 million U.S. defense contract for upgrades to the EA-18G Growler and EA-6B Prowler electronic warfare aircraft for the U.S. Navy and the government of Australia, the Pentagon said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Spotify takes minor stake in music distributor DistroKid
Description: Music streaming service Spotify said on Wednesday it had taken a stake in DistroKid, a distribution service that allows recording artists to upload music across online stores and streaming platforms including Spotify's biggest rival, Apple Music.

Headlines: U.S. environmental agency says in talks with Volvo over emissions issue
Description: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency said on Wednesday it has been in talks with Volvo over the last few weeks about an issue with catalytic converters causing some of its vehicles to exceed nitrogen oxide emission limits.

Headlines: U.S. data drags oil lower; dollar up after Fed minutes
Description: Oil prices fell on Wednesday after U.S. crude inventories rose by much more than expected and exports fell, while the dollar added to gains after minutes showed Federal Reserve policy makers largely united on the need to raise borrowing costs further.

Headlines: Despite Trump criticism, Fed sees need for more rate hikes
Description: Federal Reserve policymakers are largely united on the need to raise borrowing costs further, minutes from their most recent policy meeting show, despite U.S. President Donald Trump's view that interest rate hikes have already gone too far.

Headlines: Exclusive: Don't mention the oil price - U.S. legal threat prompts change at OPEC
Description: OPEC has urged its members not to mention oil prices when discussing policy in a break from the past, as the oil producing group seeks to avoid the risk of U.S. legal action for manipulating the market, sources close to OPEC said.

Headlines: Appeals court to hear U.S. Justice Department objection to AT&T deal on Dec. 6
Description: A U.S. appeals court will hear oral arguments on Dec. 6 in the Justice Department's fight against AT&T Inc's  $85.4 billion purchase of Time Warner, the court said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Hurricane Florence, rising mortgage rates hurt U.S. homebuilding
Description: U.S. homebuilding dropped more than expected in September as construction activity in the South fell by the most in nearly three years, likely held down by Hurricane Florence.

Headlines: SEC mulls consultation on easing quarterly reporting rules
Description: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) said in a notice that it will consider seeking public comment on ways to ease the quarterly reporting burden on publicly listed companies.

Headlines: Fed downplays policy headaches from drop in bank reserves
Description: The Federal Reserve downplayed any disruption to its policy tools from a drop last month in the so-called excess reserves that flow among banks, according to minutes published Wednesday of the U.S. central bank's Sept. 25-26 meeting.

Headlines: Tesla's vice president of manufacturing departs: Business Insider
Description: Tesla Inc's  vice president of manufacturing, Gilbert Passin, has left the company, Business Insider reported on Wednesday, citing a source familiar with the situation.

Headlines: GE to pay penalty if falls short of French job pledges: ministry
Description: General Electric's new CEO told France's finance minister on Wednesday that it would stick to his predecessor's French job pledges or pay a penalty, the Finance Ministry said.

Headlines: Indian regulator asks Fortis Healthcare to recover $55 million from founders, eight firms
Description: India's capital markets regulator has asked Fortis Healthcare  to recover 4.03 billion rupees ($55 million) from its founder brothers and firms related to them, pending an investigation into loans made by the company.

Headlines: Express Scripts covers Amgen, Lilly migraine drugs, excludes Teva
Description: Express Scripts Holding Co, one of the largest U.S. prescription benefits managers, will cover new migraine drugs from Eli Lilly and Amgen Inc, but exclude a rival medication from Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd after price negotiations with all three manufacturers.

Headlines: Exclusive: Amazon zooms in on central Mexico for large new warehouse
Description: Amazon.com Inc is scouting for land in central Mexico for a fourth distribution center in the country, sources said, aiming at a bigger slice of the burgeoning e-commerce market in Latin America's second-largest economy.

Headlines: Pfizer to cut around 2 percent of jobs through early next year
Description: U.S. drugmaker Pfizer Inc  plans to reduce its global headcount by around 2 percent through voluntary retirements and layoffs this year and early next year, as it looks to streamline its corporate structure and eliminate some managerial roles and responsibilities.

Headlines: White House's Kudlow says Trump not demanding Fed policy change
Description: White House economic advisor Larry Kudlow said on Wednesday that U.S. President Trump was not demanding a policy change at the Federal Reserve after Trump heaped more criticism on the Fed on Tuesday, calling rising U.S. interest rates his "biggest threat."

Headlines: Campbell heirs to vote for own board, Third Point calls move a 'stunt'
Description: Campbell Soup Co  said on Wednesday that four key shareholders, all descendants of the company's former chairman John Dorrance, have formally aligned themselves against hedge fund Third Point LLC's plans to oust the embattled soupmaker's entire board.

Headlines: U.S. pushes EU for rapid trade results, says progress not enough
Description: The United States demanded rapid results on Wednesday from its trade talks with the European Union and complained that the bloc was stalling progress.

Headlines: U.S. regains crown as most competitive economy for first time since 2008: WEF
Description: The U.S. economy sits atop of the World Economic Forum's annual global competitiveness survey for the first time since the 2007-2009 financial crisis, benefiting from a new ranking methodology this year, the Swiss body said on Tuesday.

Headlines: SoftBank lines up $9 billion in loans for Vision Fund from banks: Bloomberg
Description: Banks, including underwriters of SoftBank Group's  initial public offering of its mobile unit, are finalizing terms for a $9 billion loan to its Vision Fund, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.

Headlines: Fujifilm wins appeal in battle with Xerox over aborted merger
Description: Japan's Fujifilm Holdings Corp has won an appeal in its legal battles with Xerox Corp, with a New York court overturning preliminary injunctions requested by an activist investor that had blocked their planned merger.

Headlines: U.S. holiday hiring hits highest since 2014 as consumer confidence soars
Description: Holiday hiring of more than 700,000 workers by U.S. retailers would be the largest since 2014, according to a report by a global outplacement firm, underscoring a robust economy that has seen consumer confidence at its highest in nearly two decades.

Headlines: Hard Brexit could ground UK flights for three weeks: Ryanair CEO
Description: A hard Brexit could ground UK flights for up to three weeks but would be survivable for Ryanair , the Irish budget airline's CEO Michael O'Leary said ahead of a meeting of European Union leaders in Brussels on Wednesday.

Headlines: Gulfstream expects market growth in 2019 on new business jets: president
Description: Gulfstream Aerospace expects growth in both sales opportunities and deliveries next year, as the U.S. business jet maker brings two new large-cabin corporate planes to market, company President Mark Burns said on Wednesday.

Headlines: U.S. watchdog threatens retaliation over EU clearing rules
Description: U.S. banks and securities houses could be barred from trading on exchanges in the European Union if the bloc refuses to water down "irresponsible" proposals for regulating foreign clearing houses, a top U.S. regulator said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Trump administration says to open trade talks with EU, UK, Japan
Description: The U.S. Trade Representative's office told Congress on Tuesday it intends to open trade talks with the European Union, the United Kingdom and Japan.

Headlines: Danske Bank forced to resume CEO search after regulator's rejection
Description: Danske Bank , reeling from a money laundering scandal, will resume its search for a new chief executive after a Danish regulator rejected its internal candidate for the job, and analysts said it would be forced to look outside the bank.

Headlines: Netflix shares jump as Wall Street applauds record subscriber growth
Description: Shares of Netflix Inc soared 11 percent before the bell on Wednesday, after the company put fears of a slowdown in growth to bed by racking up seven million new subscribers between July and September.

Headlines: Rising rates knock U.S. mortgage activity to lowest since 2014: MBA
Description: U.S. consumers filed the fewest requests for a mortgage since late 2014 last week as most home borrowing costs reached their highest levels in more than seven years, the Mortgage Bankers Association said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Netflix: Top analyst downgrades citing limited margin expansion
Description: ** Keybanc Capital markets downgrades its rating on Netflix  to "sector weight" from "overweight" citing limited investment efficiency, margin expansion and ancillary opportunities for co over the next year

Headlines: Siemens may have to share big Iraq power contract with GE - Financial Times
Description: Siemens  may have to share a multi-billion dollar deal with U.S. rival General Electric  to improve Iraq's energy supply system following an intervention by President Donald Trump's administration, The Financial Times reported on Wednesday.

Headlines: Iran calls U.S. efforts to cut its oil exports to zero 'political bluff'
Description: Statements by the United States that it would reduce Iran's oil exports to zero are a "political bluff", the head of state-run National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC) said, according to a report published by Tasnim news agency on Wednesday.

Headlines: Boeing signs maintenance deals with El Al Airlines, Lufthansa
Description: Boeing Co  signed a two-year maintenance deal with Israel's El Al Airlines  on Wednesday, as it looks to boost its high-margin after-sales business that services planes bought by airlines and military customers.

Headlines: SocGen CEO cancels attendance at Saudi Arabia investment conference
Description: The chief executive of French bank Societe Generale  has canceled his attendance at a Saudi Arabia investment conference, as leading business executives pull out amid widespread concern about the fate of a Saudi journalist.

Headlines: Timeline: Regulator rejects Danske Bank's choice for chief executive
Description: Danske Bank , reeling from a money laundering scandal, suffered another setback on Wednesday when the Danish financial regulator rejected its candidate for chief executive on the grounds that he lacked sufficient experience.

Headlines: Sprint sells mobile advertising unit to InMobi
Description: Sprint Corp  has sold the mobile data and advertising company it created in 2012 to InMobi, which provides technology for marketers, in an all-stock deal, the companies said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Cheap and unloved: Europe Inc can't afford third-quarter miss as Wall Street gap widens
Description: The third-quarter reporting season kicks off this week with European companies on track for a second year of solid profit growth, but investors are shunning them even though valuations have not been this cheap since the euro zone crisis.

Headlines: Factbox: Potential candidates to become Danske Bank's next CEO
Description: Denmark's largest lender Danske Bank  is looking for a new chief executive in the wake of a money laundering scandal centered on $235 billion in transactions that passed through its Estonia branch.

Headlines: Weaker China demand, regulation spell tough quarter for Europe's auto stocks: Goldman Sachs
Description: Goldman Sachs analysts said slowing car demand in China and new fuel consumption regulations were hurting investors' sentiment toward European autos stocks and warned this results season could be challenging, hitting shares in the sector on Wednesday.

Headlines: VW, FCA and Renault lead emissions-driven European sales slump
Description: Volkswagen Group , Fiat Chrysler  and Renault  led a 23.4 percent European car sales decline in September, the main regional industry body said on Wednesday, as automakers continued to suffer from the introduction of tougher new emissions tests.

Headlines: Search engine Baidu becomes first China firm to join U.S. AI ethics group
Description: Chinese search engine Baidu Inc  has become the first Chinese company to join an artificial intelligence (AI) ethics group led by top U.S. tech firms, amid wider political clashes over AI competition between China and the United States.

Headlines: U.S. oil service firms face tough quarter despite high crude prices
Description: Even as crude prices hover near four-year highs, U.S. oilfield service firms' third-quarter results due out in coming days will reflect a shaky recovery, as their customers face drilling constraints and pressure to hold down spending.

Headlines: SoftBank 'anxiously' monitoring Saudi Arabia situation: executive
Description: SoftBank Group  Chief Operating Officer Marcelo Claure said on Tuesday it is "business at usual" at companies backed by its nearly $100 billion Vision Fund despite a tense situation with Saudi Arabia, which provided nearly half of the fund's capital.

Headlines: Uber IPO proposals value company at $120 billion: WSJ
Description: Ride-hailing company Uber Technologies Inc [UBER.UL] could be valued at $120 billion, when it finally goes public next year according to proposals made by U.S. banks bidding to run the offering, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday.

Headlines: Netflix record subscriber growth dispels Wall Street worries
Description: Netflix Inc hooked 7 million new streaming subscribers from July to September, a third more than Wall Street had expected, reassuring investors who had worried the company was facing a slowdown in its fast-paced growth.

Headlines: Big U.S. banks end third quarter on high note
Description: Wall Street's top investment banks enjoyed a strong third quarter as strength in stock trading and equity underwriting added to the benefits from a strong U.S. economy and tax reforms.

Headlines: Railroad operator CSX's quarterly profit tops Wall Street target
Description: CSX Corp  on Tuesday reported quarterly profit that topped Wall Street's view and raised its full-year revenue forecast, as the No. 3 U.S. railroad operator benefited from ongoing cost-cutting and higher prices for moving freight.

Headlines: U.S. Senate bill could give Tesla, GM electric car tax credit boost
Description: Tesla Inc  and General Motors Co , which have lobbied Congress to lift a cap on electric vehicles eligible for a $7,500 tax credit, could get their way for up to four years under a new proposal from a Republican senator.

Headlines: Wall St. rallies over 2 percent with earnings, data boost
Description: U.S. stocks surged more than 2 percent on Tuesday after upbeat earnings reports from major companies including UnitedHealth and Goldman Sachs and solid economic data, as equities rebounded from a recent sharp sell-off.

Headlines: Honda Aircraft expects higher light jet deliveries in 2019
Description: Honda Aircraft Co chief executive Michimasa Fujino said on Tuesday he expects deliveries of the HondaJet to rise in 2019 above the estimated 50 aircraft customers will take this year, as the light business plane maker targets Asia for growth.

Headlines: IBM revenue misses as server, software sales slow
Description: IBM Corp reported a bigger-than-expected drop in revenue on Tuesday, hit by slowing software sales and wavering demand for mainframe servers, pointing to a bumpy recovery for the technology services giant that is in the midst of a turnaround.

Headlines: Target adds new space, more toys for holiday season
Description: Target Corp  will dedicate nearly a quarter of a million square feet of new space to its toy business across 500 of its stores, the retailer said on Tuesday, part of an effort to win more holiday sales.

Headlines: United lifts 2018 target as network growth boosts third-quarter profit
Description: United Airlines  posted solid third-quarter profit on Tuesday and raised its 2018 outlook for the third time this year, helped by its strategy to add flights at three mid-continent U.S. hubs: Chicago, Denver and Houston.

Headlines: Goldman Sachs will slow consumer loan growth if market falters
Description: Goldman Sachs  will limit loan growth in one of its new business areas if it sees a marked deterioration in credit quality, potentially jeopardizing new Chief Executive David Solomon's task of boosting revenue by $5 billion by 2020.

Headlines: Global stocks rebound with earnings in focus; oil little changed
Description: Stocks bounced back on Tuesday across the world, supported by strong earnings expectations, while oil prices were wobbly as evidence of higher U.S. production was overshadowed by a tighter global supply outlook as Iran prepares for U.S. sanctions.

Headlines: U.S. judge approves SEC settlement with Tesla, Musk;  shares jump
Description: A U.S. judge on Tuesday approved a settlement between a federal regulator, Tesla Inc and its chief executive officer, Elon Musk, over his tweets promising to take the company private, signaling an end to a tumultuous period for investors.

Headlines: EU regulators ask Sony's rivals and users how it might use power after EMI deal
Description: EU antitrust regulators reviewing Sony Corp's $2.3 billion bid for EMI are asking rivals and users whether they think the Japanese group would use its greater market power to win better terms in digital media deals.

Headlines: Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen dies of cancer complications at 65
Description: Microsoft Corp  co-founder Paul Allen, the man who persuaded school-friend Bill Gates to drop out of Harvard to start what became the world's biggest software company, died on Monday at the age of 65, his family said.

Headlines: Walmart CEO points to new company culture, cuts profit forecast
Description: Walmart Inc's  chief executive officer on Tuesday urged investors to revise their view of the company's business, touting its tech investments to grow online sales at a time that Walmart is battling Amazon.com  for market share.

Headlines: U.S. seen likely to relieve Prudential of 'systemic' oversight
Description: A panel of U.S. regulators is seen as likely to relieve Prudential Financial Inc from stricter oversight when it meets on Tuesday, in a move that could reduce the insurance company's regulatory costs.

Headlines: Dell maintains plans to go public despite Icahn opposition
Description: Dell Technologies Inc said on Tuesday it was sticking to its plans to go public by buying back its tracking stock , a day after activist investor Carl Icahn opposed the move.

Headlines: Lyft selects JPMorgan, Credit Suisse for IPO in 2019: source
Description: Ride-hailing company Lyft Inc has chosen JPMorgan Chase & Co, Credit Suisse and Jefferies as underwriters for its initial public offering, slated for the first half of 2019, according to a person familiar with the matter.

Headlines: U.S. industrial output rises; job openings at record high
Description: U.S. industrial production increased for a fourth straight month in September, boosted by gains in manufacturing and mining output, but momentum slowed sharply in the third quarter.

Headlines: Activist investor Icahn takes stake in Dollar Tree - NY Post
Description: Billionaire activist investor Carl Icahn is accumulating a significant stake in discount chain Dollar Tree Inc , the New York Post reported on Tuesday.

Headlines: Nomura to pay $480 million to U.S. over 'fraudulent' mortgage-backed securities
Description: Nomura Holdings Inc  has agreed to pay $480 million to resolve civil claims by the U.S. government that it misled investors in marketing residential mortgage-backed securities, U.S. authorities said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Huawei launches new flagship phones in bid to keep No. 2 spot
Description: Huawei [HWT.UL] unveiled new flagship smartphones with novel smart camera and video features on Tuesday, as it seeks to sustain momentum among price-conscious consumers.

Headlines: U.S. Fed says terminates 2013 enforcement action against RBS group for sanctions lapses
Description: The U.S. Federal Reserve said on Tuesday that it terminated a  2013 enforcement action against Royal Bank of Scotland Group  for sanctions lapses in its foreign operations.

Headlines: German prosecutors fine Audi 800 million euros for diesel violations
Description: German premium car brand Audi, a division of Volkswagen , said it was fined 800 million euros ($927 million) on Tuesday for violations tied to heavily polluting six- and eight-cylinder diesel engines.

Headlines: Equity trading strength boosts profits at Morgan Stanley, Goldman
Description: Wall Street's top investment banks reported better-than-expected quarterly profits on Tuesday, helped by strength in stock trading and equity underwriting, wrapping up what has been a strong quarter for the big U.S. banks.

Headlines: Tough markets hit BlackRock results; shares slump 4 percent
Description: BlackRock Inc's  quarterly revenue fell short of Wall Street's expectations on Tuesday as the world's biggest asset manager reported its lowest sales of equity, bond and other long-term investments since the second quarter of 2016.

Headlines: Wells Fargo to shift European investment banking business to Paris as Brexit looms
Description: Wells Fargo & Co  said on Tuesday it had applied for an investment firm license in France as part of a Brexit strategy to shift some of its servicing of European mainland customers out of London.

Headlines: U.S. job openings hit record high of 7.14 million
Description: U.S. job openings jumped to a record high in August, far outpacing a rise in hiring, suggesting that companies could be increasingly having difficulties finding qualified workers.

Description: When Sears Holdings Corp filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on Monday, it said it would close another 142 unprofitable Sears and Kmart locations and seek to reorganize around financially healthier stores. It also triggered a "time bomb" that retailers have had a tough time surviving.

Headlines: VW targets online sales, over-the-air updates in new contract with European dealers
Description: Volkswagen  will overhaul its dealership and sales organization by April 2020 to enable online sales and over-the-air software updates for its new electric cars, the German automaker said on Tuesday.

Headlines: U.S. government posts widest deficit since 2012

Headlines: Morgan Stanley profit beats on strength in equity trading, underwriting
Description: Morgan Stanley  reported a better-than-expected quarterly profit on Tuesday, driven by higher revenue in its stock trading and equity underwriting businesses.

Description: Qualcomm Inc and the U.S. Federal Trade Commission on Monday asked a federal judge to delay a preliminary ruling in an antitrust case U.S. regulators brought against the mobile chip company in order to pursue settlement talks.

Description: Tesla Inc Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk said a new chip that improves autopilot features would be available in about six months in all of the company's new production electric cars.

Description: Softbank's Vision Fund plans to pump more money into insurance, a sector it sees as both ripe for disruption and a potential booster for its bigger bets in cars, health and financial services, a Vision Fund executive told Reuters.

Description: U.S. carmaker Ford Motor Co  unveiled a new China sport utility vehicle (SUV) on Tuesday, and said its plan to release a spate of new models will help turn around tumbling sales in the world's top auto market from the start of next year.

Headlines: Safe havens rise on West-Saudi tension; world stocks fall
Description: Major stock markets slipped on Monday as rising tensions between Western powers and Saudi Arabia added to concerns over the pace of global economic growth, with investors flocking to traditional safe-havens like the Japanese and Swiss currencies, as well as gold.

Headlines: Carl Icahn boosts stake in Dell IPO standoff
Description: Activist investor Carl Icahn reported an increased 8.3 percent stake in Dell tracking stock on Monday, as he looks to block a proposed plan by the computer maker to return to the public market without an IPO.

Description: U.S. retail sales barely rose in September as a rebound in motor vehicle purchases was offset by the biggest drop in spending at restaurants and bars in nearly two years.

Headlines: Disney offers EU antitrust concessions over $71.3 billion Fox deal
Description: Walt Disney  has offered concessions in an attempt to allay EU antitrust concerns over its $71.3 billion bid for Twenty-First Century Fox Inc's  entertainment assets, the European Commission said on Monday.

Headlines: Burberry joins luxury sector's race to refresh products monthly
Description: Britain's Burberry  said on Monday it would start releasing limited edition clothes and products every month, joining a growing number of rivals in the luxury sector trying to churn out collections more frequently to keep clients hooked.

Headlines: Unwelcome guest: U.S. tariffs loom at China's biggest trade fair
Description: Amid gathering gloom over the state of the Chinese economy, exporters of motorcycles, tractors, photocopiers and Christmas tree lighting will join thousands of other companies peddling their wares at China's largest trade fair Monday.

Headlines: Fidelity launches new company for trading and storing cryptocurrencies
Description: Fidelity Investments has launched a new company for its institutional clients that will trade and store digital assets  such as bitcoin, the asset manager said on Monday.

Headlines: Around 100,000 Opel vehicles to be recalled in diesel probe - ministry
Description: Germany's Transport Ministry said on Monday that roughly 100,000 Opel vehicles were to be recalled shortly after a further manipulation of diesel emissions by exhaust management software was discovered.

Description: Credit Suisse on Monday downgraded the U.S. steel sector as it expects prices to fall due to oversupply, stemming from the Trump administration's move to slap tariffs on Chinese imports.

Headlines: Novo Nordisk hires AstraZeneca executive to revive struggling biopharma unit
Description: Novo Nordisk  is in advanced talks to acquire assets to bolster its struggling biopharma business, its chief executive said on Monday after the drugmaker announced it had hired an AstraZeneca executive to head the unit.

Headlines: SoftBank's Saudi ties unnerve investors as shares drop 8 percent
Description: SoftBank Group Corp  saw its shares drop on Monday as fallout from the disappearance of a Saudi journalist spread to the Japanese conglomerate, whose nearly $100 billion Vision Fund is almost half financed by Saudi Arabia.

Headlines: Kuwait Airways signs agreement to buy eight Airbus A330-800neo planes
Description: Kuwait Airways said on Monday it has signed an agreement with European planemaker Airbus  to buy eight A330-800neo airliners following five months of negotiations.

Headlines: Bayer may outsource some drug research - works council
Description: Bayer's  chief executive is considering farming out certain drug research activities to cut costs amid slower growth at its pharmaceuticals division, the German company's works council said on Monday.

Headlines: Korean Air chief indicted on embezzlement, other charges: prosecutors
Description: Korean Air Lines Co Ltd  Chairman Cho Yang-ho was indicted on Monday on charges including embezzlement and breach of trust, South Korean prosecutors said, adding to a string of woes at the country's biggest airline group.

Headlines: Labor strife in India's manufacturing hubs may undermine Modi's jobs push
Description: Labor unrest is on the rise at two centers in India where motorcycles and components are manufactured, underlining the problems Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government faces in creating new manufacturing jobs that are sustainable and pay attractive wages.

Headlines: Chinese electric carmaker NIO delivers 3,268 SUVs in third quarter
Description: Chinese electric carmaker NIO Inc  said on Monday it delivered 3,268 electric SUVs in the third quarter, exceeding its own target of 2,900-3,000 vehicles.

Description: China's HNA Group is exploring an outright sale and other options for its IT outsourcing unit Pactera and has held talks with investors including Ant Financial [ANTFIN.UL], people with knowledge of the situation said.

Headlines: Higher U.S. tariffs on Japanese cars less likely, trade war posing risk: Reuters poll
Description: Higher U.S. tariffs on Japanese car exports are less likely now the two nations agreed to start new trade talks, economists said, but most think U.S. trade friction with China and other economies will have a significant impact on Japan.

Headlines: Exclusive: Sears CEO steps in for bankruptcy financing - sources
Description: Sears Holdings Corp CEO Eddie Lampert has stepped in to contribute toward a financing package of between $500 million and $600 million that the U.S. department store operator was close to securing on Sunday to fund operations during bankruptcy proceedings, people familiar with the matter said.

Description: Apple Inc has acquired music analytics start-up Asaii, Axios reported on Sunday, citing sources, in a bid to strengthen content recommendations to its music users.

Headlines: Embraer launches longer-range private jets in turnaround push

Headlines: Barclays to challenge Goldman in digital-only bank market: FT

Headlines: India's IndiGo eyes wide-bodied aircraft from Airbus, Boeing: executive
Description: Indian airline IndiGo on Sunday said wide-bodied aircraft are an “aspiration” and talks with manufacturers are ongoing but there is no firm timeline amid difficult market conditions in the Indian market.

Headlines: Mexico says new U.S. trade deal won't block other economic relations

Description: The United States sought to make currency a central part of any solution to a bruising trade fight with China, keeping the pressure on Beijing to speed up economic reforms at a gathering of world policy makers who pledged to do more to safeguard global growth.

Description: Central bankers from the United States to Europe are coming under pressure from their governments to loosen their purse strings again as a decade of accelerating economic growth and booming markets fueled by cheap cash comes to an end.

Headlines: StanChart CEO says 'actively working' on Indonesian bank stake
Description: Standard Chartered Plc  is "actively working" on options for its stake in Indonesia's PT Bank Permata tbk , the British lender's Chief Executive Bill Winters said on Saturday.

Headlines: Bundesbank chief sees reducing chance that U.S.-China will escalate trade conflict
