Headlines: One 'rant,' rough talks sour G7 mood in confrontations with Trump
Description: The Group of Seven leaders came to their summit in Canada braced for battle, and while everyone had smiles ready for the cameras, behind the scenes U.S. President Donald Trump delivered a "rant" and recriminations on trade to U.S. allies, leaving the once united club deeply divided.

Headlines: German regulator found defeat devices in Daimler diesel cars: BamS
Description: Germany's road vehicle authority KBA has found five "illegal switch-off devices" in Daimler  car engines, newspaper Bild am Sonntag (BamS) reported on Sunday.

Headlines: UK's May: welcomes G7 agreeing to maintain Russia sanctions
Description: British Prime Minister Theresa May welcomed a G7 statement that recognized the need to maintain sanctions on Russia on Saturday, after U.S. President Donald Trump floated the suggestion that the country be allowed back in the group.

Headlines: Heavy security quells scattered protests at Canada G7 summit
Description: A heavy police presence and an isolated summit site thwarted protesters at the Group of Seven meeting in Canada on Saturday, dousing all but a smattering of demonstrations against the powerful world leaders.

Headlines: G7 leaders commit to fighting trade protectionism: communique
Description: Leaders of the Group of Seven industrialized nations agreed at the conclusion of their summit on Saturday on the need for "free, fair, and mutually beneficial trade" and the importance of fighting protectionism, their communique said.

Headlines: Italy's anti-elite prime minister plays by rules at G7 club
Description: Italy's new anti-elite Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte played by the rules at the Group of Seven industrialized nations summit, leaving none of the club's members unhappy in his debut on the international stage in Canada.

Headlines: With sales boom in mind, Gucci tightens grip on suppliers
Description: Kering's  fashion powerhouse Gucci is bringing more manufacturing in-house, as luxury firms step up efforts to meet rampant demand from Chinese shoppers with slicker operations.

Headlines: France's Macron: G7 statement on trade only first step
Description: French President Emmanuel Macron said on Saturday that a joint statement from Group of Seven nations was just a first step and marked an attempt to "stabilize things" as a trade dispute with the United States threatened to tear the alliance apart.

Headlines: Merkel says differences on trade remain despite joint G7 communique
Description: Leaders of the G7 countries will stress the importance of rules-based trade in a joint communique but there were still differences between Europe and the United States on the issue, German Chancellor Angela Merkel said on Saturday.

Headlines: G7 leaders on track for joint communique: French official
Description: The leaders of the Group of Seven nations are on track to agree a joint communique when their summit ends later on Saturday, a French presidency official said, a day after diplomats cited deep splits over the proposed text.

Headlines: Italy's Conte wants G8 with Russia, not quick end to sanctions
Description: Italian Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte said on Saturday he hopes the Group of Seven nations can re-admit Russia as soon as possible but Italy is not seeking an overnight lifting of sanctions against Russia.

Headlines: Trump says United States needs fair access to markets
Description: U.S President Donald Trump said on Saturday he told Group of Seven leaders that the United States required fair access to markets and an end to unfair trade practices.

Headlines: Investors focusing on profit margins as rising prices, wages start to bite
Description: For years U.S. inflation has been the dog that did not bark, but rising prices and wages are now showing signs of squeezing profit margins across corporate America, leading investors to punish companies whose results are deteriorating.

Headlines: U.S., EU take small step on trade, but no breakthrough at G7 summit
Description: The United States and European Union will establish a dialogue on trade within the next two weeks, a French official said on Friday, signaling a modest step forward for bitterly divided allies at a Group of Seven summit in Canada.

Headlines: Trump, Macron cool down the buddy act at Canada's G7
Description: It was only six weeks ago when U.S. President Donald Trump and French President Emmanuel Macron grinned, laughed, and hugged their way through a state visit in Washington, showing all the signs of two leaders with a genuine friendship.

Headlines: Kia recalls 507,000 vehicles in U.S. for air bag issues
Description: Kia Motors Corp said on Friday it was recalling more than 507,000 vehicles in the United States because an electronic glitch may prevent air bags from deploying in a crash.

Headlines: Disney animation chief, Pixar co-founder Lasseter to quit after 'missteps'
Description: Walt Disney Co animation head and co-founder of Pixar John Lasseter, regarded as a modern day Walt Disney because of his creativity and commercial success, will leave at the end of the year, the company said on Friday.

Headlines: France's Macron sees way forward on trade, Trump says working together
Description: French President Emmanuel Macron said on Friday it was possible to make progress on trade issues that have split the United States and its allies after meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump.

Headlines: U.S. can sell pork to Mexico through import quota, despite tariffs: Mexico
Description: U.S. producers can sell pork legs and shoulders to Mexico via an import quota despite retaliatory measures taken this week after U.S. President Donald Trump imposed tariffs on steel and aluminum, the Mexican government said on Thursday.

Headlines: U.S. Justice Department, AT&T await nail-biter of a court decision
Description: A federal judge will decide next week whether AT&T , which owns DirecTV, will be allowed to buy Time Warner , home to CNN and March Madness basketball, for $85 billion.

Headlines: EU Commission head offers joint EU-U.S. trade assessment in tariff dispute
Description: The European Union's executive arm offered U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday a joint assessment of EU-U.S. trade to help resolve a dispute over U.S. steel and aluminum tariffs that the EU believes are based on a misreading of trade data.

Headlines: Verizon names tech chief CEO, prioritizes 5G network over content
Description: Verizon Communications Inc  named Chief Technology Officer Hans Vestberg as its new CEO on Friday, surprising analysts and signaling the largest U.S. wireless company's priority is building the next-generation 5G network, not expanding further into media content.

Headlines: Wall Street rises, investors eye Fed decision, summit fears ebb
Description: U.S. stock indexes closed higher on Friday as investors shrugged off concerns about global trade tensions but trading volume was relatively light ahead of a busy week of central bank meetings.

Headlines: U.S. dollar gains, yields dip as G7 summit in focus
Description: The U.S. dollar rose and Treasury yields slipped on Friday on anxiety about a potential global trade war as the leaders of the Group of Seven countries met in Canada.

Headlines: Shareholder lawsuit attacks Musk's pay, seeks to overhaul Tesla board
Description: Elon Musk's multi-billion dollar compensation package should be rescinded and the board of Tesla Inc should be overhauled to better protect investors in the electronic car company, according to a law suit filed by a shareholder on Thursday.

Headlines: Exclusive: Iran slams U.S. for seeking Saudi oil output hike, says OPEC won’t comply
Description: Iran said on Friday a U.S. request for Saudi Arabia to pump more oil so that it could cover a drop in Iranian exports was "crazy and astonishing" and said OPEC would not heed the appeal, setting the stage for a tough OPEC meeting this month.

Headlines: OPEC likely to reject Iran request for discussion of U.S. sanctions
Description: OPEC is likely to reject a request by Iran to discuss U.S. sanctions against Tehran at this month’s meeting of the oil producer group, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters.

Headlines: Oil falls on concerns over rising supply, weaker demand
Description: Oil prices fell on Friday as concerns about surging U.S. output and falling demand in China weighed on the contract and JP Morgan cut its price forecast.

Headlines: Airbus nails down Bombardier CSeries deal in boost to jet
Description: European planemaker Airbus SE  has finalized a rescue deal for Bombardier Inc's  CSeries jet and is expected to flex its cost-cutting and marketing muscle to revive the money-losing Canadian venture.

Headlines: Airbus to seek CSeries efficiencies across the board: exec
Description: Airbus SE  will seek efficiencies across the board after taking on Bombardier Inc's  struggling CSeries jet program but is not looking for an adversarial relationship with parts makers, one of its senior executives said.

Headlines: EU will stand united at G7, Italy included: Tusk
Description: European Union members of the Group of Seven, including Italy's new Prime Minister Guiseppe Conte, will present a united front on all issues to be discussed at a G7 summit in Charlevoix, the chairman of EU leaders Donald Tusk said on Friday.

Headlines: EU appeals at G7 for support for jailed Ukraine film maker
Description: The chairman of European Union leaders Donald Tusk appealed at a G7 summit on Friday for support for Ukrainian film maker Oleg Sentsov, sentenced by Russia to 20 years in a prison camp in Siberia for opposing Russia's annexation of Crimea.

Headlines: France's Macron, Trump talk trade, North Korea in 'cordial' G7 meeting: official
Description: French President Emmanuel Macron and U.S. President Donald Trump, who exchanged terse Twitter messages ahead of the G7 summit, had a brief "very cordial" discussion about trade and North Korea, a French official said on Friday.

Headlines: G7 to cooperate against malign interference in elections: draft
Description: The Group of Seven leaders are to agree on Friday to share information between themselves and work with internet service providers and social media companies to thwart foreign meddling in elections in their countries, a draft summit commitment said.

Headlines: UK steps into G7 trade dispute, warns of tit-for-tat dangers
Description: British Prime Minister Theresa May on Friday warned both U.S. President Donald Trump and the European Union of the dangers of  entering a tit-for-tat trade war over tariffs, urging both sides to instead focus on China's excess steel production.

Headlines: Canada's Freeland holds firm on tariff retaliation at G7
Description: Talks among top world leaders at the Group of Seven summit have so far been cordial, but Canada will not change its mind when it comes to illegal U.S. steel and aluminum tariffs, Canadian Foreign Minister Chrystia Freeland said on Friday.

Headlines: Trump says Russia should be at G7 meeting, Moscow not so sure
Description: Russia should be attending a Group of Seven summit in Canada, U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday, a controversial idea that even Moscow seemed to reject, as he headed for a chilly reception at the meeting where other leaders are set to clash with him over trade.

Headlines: Apple to make 20 percent fewer new model iPhones this year: Nikkei
Description: Apple Inc  expects to ship 80 million new model iPhones this year, down 20 percent from what it had planned at the same time last year, Japanese financial daily Nikkei reported on Friday, citing industry sources.

Headlines: G7 communique unlikely due to lack of consensus: officials
Description: Leaders from the Group of Seven countries are highly unlikely to issue a final communique when a two-day summit in Canada ends on Saturday because of a lack of consensus among the group, who are deeply divided over trade issues.

Headlines: Porsche to name all-electric model Taycan
Description: Sport car maker Porsche will name its first all-electric car model the Taycan, it said on Friday, a year before it plans to launch serial production of a vehicle that will compete with Tesla's  Model S.

Headlines: Comcast to win unconditional EU okay for Sky bid: sources
Description: U.S. cable company Comcast is set to gain unconditional EU antitrust approval for its bid to buy European pay-TV company Sky , two people familiar with the matter said on Friday.

Headlines: Tesla must fix 'flaws' in Autopilot after fatal crash: U.S. consumer group
Description: A consumer advocacy group on Friday urged Tesla Inc to fix what it termed as "flaws" in the automaker's driver-assistance system Autopilot after a preliminary government report said a driver did not have his hands on the vehicle's steering wheel in the final six seconds before a fatal crash.

Headlines: Ant Financial raises $14 billion in world's largest-ever single fundraising
Description: Ant Financial Services Group, operator of China's biggest online payment platform, on Friday said it raised around $14 billion in what market watchers called the biggest-ever single fundraising globally by a private company.

Headlines: Italy's luxury brand Prada paves way for family succession: CEO
Description: Prada  Chief Executive Patrizio Bertelli said on Friday his family would not sell its 80 percent stake in Italy's biggest luxury goods group and said his son Lorenzo may one day head the company.

Headlines: Exclusive: Malaysia considering seeking return of Goldman Sachs' 1MDB fees
Description: Malaysia is considering asking the U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) to get Goldman Sachs  to return nearly $600 million in fees it earned from bonds raised for scandal-tainted 1Malaysia Development Berhad (1MDB), two sources familiar with the matter said on Friday.

Headlines: VW says 250,000 cars could be delayed by new testing rules
Description: Volkswagen  said production of up to 250,000 cars from its group brands in the second half will be delayed because of effects from new mandatory lab tests for emissions and fuel economy.

Headlines: BT boss Patterson steps down after investors lose faith
Description: BT Group's  Chief Executive Gavin Patterson will step down this year after its chairman said a new leader was needed to restructure Britain's biggest broadband and mobile provider.

Headlines: UK, U.S. are good friends despite trade row: PM May
Description: Britain and the United States remain good friends who can talk frankly with each other when they disagree, Prime Minister Theresa May said on Friday ahead of a Group of Seven  summit.

Headlines: EU's Tusk anticipates tough G7 talks, sees Europe united
Description: Talks at the Group of Seven summit will not be easy as the United States is in conflict with the rest of the group on trade, climate change and the nuclear deal with Iran, the chairman of European Union leaders Donald Tusk said on Friday.

Headlines: Italy's new PM says to take 'moderate' line on tariffs at G7
Description: New Italian Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte said on Friday he would try to promote "moderate" positions on trade tariffs at a Group of Seven summit where the contentious issue looks set to dominate talks among leaders.

Headlines: Why Canada's pot legalization won't stop black-market sales
Description: Jake Rowinski, a 20-year-old University of Toronto student, buys marijuana every week from one of the many self-described "medical" dispensaries in downtown Toronto.

Headlines: China's ZTE apologizes after paying 'disastrous price' in U.S. sanction case
Description: The chairman of ZTE Corp   apologized to staff and customers on Friday after the Chinese technology firm agreed to pay a $1 billion fine to the United States to end a supplier ban that has crippled its business.

Headlines: Italy's new PM backs Trump on re-admitting Russia into the G7
Description: New Italian Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte threw his weight on Friday behind U.S. President Donald Trump's call for Russia to be included once more into Group of Seven meetings.

Headlines: Kremlin, responding to Trump, says attending G7 not a priority: Sputnik
Description: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov, on U.S. President Donald Trump's remark that Russia should be attending a Group of Seven (G7) nations meeting, said: "Russia is focused on other formats, apart from the G7," Sputnik reported.

Headlines: Germany urges European unity in face of trade tensions with U.S.
Description: German Economy Minister Peter Altmaier called on Friday for Europe to remain unified in the face of rising trade tensions with the United States, saying it was unclear how a summit of the Group of Seven rich nations would end.

Headlines: Goal! Investors line up World Cup winners off the pitch
Description: The soccer World Cup is a massive money-spinner and stock market players are busy picking brewers, betting firms, pub chains and sportswear brands that will benefit from the associated global spending surge.

Headlines: Production ramp-up first priority in CSeries takeover: Airbus
Description: Airbus  pledged on Friday to focus on a smooth and sustainable increase in production of the Bombardier  CSeries jet as it finalised a deal to take control of the loss-making Canadian aircraft program.

Headlines: Britain's FCA goes ahead with disputed 'Aramco' listing rule
Description: Britain's markets watchdog will press ahead with a new premium listing next month aimed at attracting companies like state-controlled Saudi Aramco to London, although the rules have been "refined" following investor criticism.

Headlines: UK's May not snubbed by Trump at G7 summit: PM's spokeswoman
Description: British Prime Minister Theresa May has not been snubbed by U.S. President Donald Trump at the G7 summit in Canada and will speak to him even though no bilateral meeting is planned, a spokeswoman for May said on Friday.

Headlines: Mitsubishi Materials finds fresh cases of misconduct, loses certification
Description: Japan's Mitsubishi Materials Corp  said on Friday it has found fresh cases of misconduct at its Naoshima copper smelter and refinery in western Japan and the plant's Japanese Industrial Standards (JIS) certification has been revoked.

Headlines: Standard Chartered  compliance chief leaves bank after investigation
Description: Standard Chartered  compliance chief Neil Barry will leave the bank with immediate effect, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters, after an investigation into his behavior.

Headlines: EU regulators to rule on Ryanair, Laudamotion deal by July 12
Description: EU antitrust regulators will decide by July 12 whether to wave through Irish budget airline Ryanair's  bid for a 75 percent stake in the rebranded former Niki airline Laudamotion, a filing on the European Commission site showed on Friday.

Headlines: Volkswagen labour boss says will block sale of specialist assets
Description: Volkswagen's  powerful works council will continue to block the potential sale of specialist industrial assets and instead seek to work with the carmaker's new chief executive to  develop them, its labour leader told Reuters.

Headlines: Dollar near 3-week trough, lower U.S. yields and strong euro weigh
Description: The dollar wallowed near a three-week low against its peers on Friday as U.S. Treasury yields fell sharply, while the euro's recovery remained intact amid expectations the European Central Bank will begin unwinding its stimulus program.

Headlines: China Huarong to refocus on bad loans amid probes into chairman, investment
Description: China Huarong Asset Management Co Ltd  will focus on its core bad debt business, the company said, amid investigations by the official anti-corruption watchdog of its chairman, Lai Xiaomin, and a company it had invested in.

Headlines: Japan's home-sharing offerings evaporate ahead of new regulations
Description: Japan, which just months ago had tens of thousands of Airbnb and home-sharing properties available, has approved only about 150 before a new law kicks in next week, meant to bring order to the market and create more lodging options for foreign tourists.

Headlines: New Zealand allows fired NBC host Matt Lauer to keep his farm
Description: The New Zealand government ruled on Friday that former U.S. "Today Show" co-host Matt Lauer can keep his farm in the country, saying there was currently "insufficient evidence" he had failed required character tests for overseas investors.

Headlines: Walmart sues to bar former tax executive from joining Amazon
Description: Walmart Inc  has asked a court to block a former top tax executive from joining Amazon.com Inc , saying the move would violate a non-compete agreement and irreparably harm Walmart by potentially tipping off its rival to strategic plans including potential merger targets.

Headlines: Broadcom profit beats; expects wireless to remain weak
Description: Broadcom Inc's  quarterly profit beat Wall Street estimates as demand for its networking chips and storage solutions from data centers more than made up for weakness in its wireless business.

Headlines: Euro extends rally on ECB comments, yields fall ahead of G7
Description: The euro climbed to a three-week peak on Thursday as expectations mounted that the European Central Bank will signal an early wind-down of economic stimulus, while oil prices jumped on concern about a drop in exports from Venezuela.

Headlines: Chinese phone maker ZTE saved from brink after deal with U.S.
Description: China’s No. 2 telecommunications equipment maker ZTE secured a lifeline from the Trump administration on Thursday after agreeing to pay a $1 billion fine and overhaul leadership in a deal that will lift a ban on its doing business with U.S. suppliers.

Headlines: U.S. lawmakers scramble for way to block Trump deal with China's ZTE
Description: Republican and Democratic U.S. senators introduced legislation on Thursday that would roll back an agreement President Donald Trump's administration announced to ease sanctions on Chinese telecommunications company ZTE Corp.

Headlines: U.S. senator queries Alphabet, Twitter on ties with Huawei
Description: A senior U.S. senator said on Thursday that he has asked Google parent Alphabet Inc and Twitter Inc for information about any data sharing agreements they have with Chinese vendors, after Facebook Inc this week disclosed such partnerships with several Chinese companies.

Headlines: S&P, Nasdaq fall as tech rally loses steam; Dow rises
Description: The S&P and Nasdaq fell on Thursday as the technology sector snapped a rally while investors turned to safer bets as they kept an eye on global trade tensions and waited for U.S. and European central bank meetings.

Headlines: Deutsche Bank sounds out investors about Commerzbank deal: Bloomberg
Description: Deutsche Bank  on Thursday downplayed the idea that a deal with cross-town rival Commerzbank  could materialize soon, after Bloomberg reported that top shareholders had been consulted about a potential tie-up.

Headlines: Deutsche Bank says chairman sees no need to bring up Commerzbank deal
Description: Deutsche Bank  on Thursday said its chairman is constantly asked about the potential for a tie-up with peer Commerzbank  but downplayed the idea that a deal could materialize in the short-term.

Headlines: Some fund managers are avoiding Amazon as it leads U.S. market
Description: For most U.S. fund managers, beating the market this year has come down to one decision: whether or not to own shares of Amazon.com Inc .

Headlines: Italy's Illycaffe launches cold coffee as Starbucks looms
Description: Italian premium coffee maker illycaffe will launch hand-pulled cold coffee this summer, in a sign it is feeling the pressure as  coffee chain Starbucks  prepares to debut in its home turf.

Headlines: Ex-Volkswagen CEO summoned to testify in emissions lawsuit: Bild
Description: Former Volkswagen  Chief Executive Martin Winterkorn has been asked to testify before a German court in connection with a lawsuit seeking damages from the carmaker over its emissions cheating scandal, a German paper reported on Thursday.

Headlines: Phony bank accounts not a 'systemic' issue: U.S. regulator
Description: A U.S. bank regulator said on Thursday that an industry-wide review prompted by Wells Fargo & Co's  sales practices scandal had uncovered some instances of phony accounts at other lenders but little evidence of a "systemic" problem.

Headlines: UK lawmakers have 'lost confidence' in TSB boss over IT crisis
Description: The chairman of TSB said on Thursday the bank's chief executive, Paul Pester, had the full support of the board, after Pester came under attack from lawmakers over his handling of an IT crisis, casting doubt on his position.

Headlines: Oil gains on Venezuela export cuts, OPEC production levels
Description: Global benchmark Brent crude surged nearly $2 a barrel on Thursday, lifted by concern about a steep drop in exports from Venezuela and worries OPEC may not raise production at its meeting this month.

Headlines: U.S. antitrust official says worries over limiting vertical deals 'misplaced'
Description: A top antitrust official at the U.S. Justice Department attempted to reassure investors on Thursday that worries that regulators would crack down on proposed combinations of two companies on a supply chain -- known as vertical mergers -- were overblown.

Headlines: TSB chairman says embattled CEO has 'full support' of board
Description: TSB Chairman Richard Meddings said on Thursday that the bank's Chief Executive Paul Pester had the full support of the TSB board, after lawmakers called on them to urgently consider the CEO's position following a severe IT crisis at the bank.

Headlines: Kering's Gucci aims to steal luxury crown from Louis Vuitton
Description: Italian fashion house Gucci said on Thursday it aims to reach 10 billion euros in annual sales and replace LVMH's  Louis Vuitton as the world's biggest luxury label.

Headlines: Yahoo's EU regulator orders privacy changes over data breach
Description: Yahoo's European regulator has ordered it to make privacy changes following a probe into what it said was one of the largest ever data breaches to impact EU citizens.

Headlines: Geordie Greig named as new editor of Daily Mail
Description: Geordie Greig has been named as the new editor of Britain's Daily Mail, the newspaper company Daily Mail and General Trust  said on Thursday.

Headlines: Disney, Fox carved out assets 'surgically': U.S. antitrust chief
Description: Walt Disney Co's  $52.4 billion deal to acquire most of Twenty-First Century Fox Inc's  assets was "surgically" structured on good advice to be submitted to regulators, Makan Delrahim, assistant attorney general for the U.S. Department of Justice's antitrust division, said on Thursday.

Headlines: Bank of America raises planned Paris job moves before Brexit: sources
Description: Bank of America is looking to move more jobs than originally envisaged to its new Paris office, in what is expected to be one of the biggest such shifts from London ahead of Brexit, two sources familiar with the matter said.

Headlines: CEO to be named soon for Berkshire, Amazon, JPMorgan healthcare venture
Description: Berkshire Hathaway Inc , Amazon.com Inc  and JPMorgan Chase & Co  within the next two weeks will likely name a chief executive for their joint venture aimed at lowering the cost of health care, billionaire investor Warren Buffett said in an interview aired on Thursday on CNBC.

Headlines: U.S. weekly jobless claims drop as labor market picks up steam
Description: The number of Americans filing for unemployment benefits unexpectedly fell last week, pointing to a further tightening in labor market conditions.

Headlines: Elliott's Singer agrees with Buffett, Dimon on profit guidance
Description: Hedge fund Elliott Management Corp Chief Executive Paul Singer said on Thursday he agreed with billionaire investor Warren Buffett and JPMorgan Chase & Co  CEO Jamie Dimon that companies should move away from providing quarterly earnings guidance.

Headlines: U.S. ITC says probing Toyota, others in patent infringement case
Description: The U.S. International Trade Commission said on Thursday it would investigate Toyota Motor Corp , Panasonic Corp  and other companies for alleged patent infringement in certain infotainment systems, components and automobiles containing such systems.

Headlines: Exclusive: U.S. Justice Department probes T-Mobile-Sprint merger effect on smaller wireless companies - sources
Description: The U.S. Department of Justice is examining how the proposed merger between T-Mobile US Inc and Sprint Corp could affect prices for smaller wireless operators, according to two people familiar with the matter.

Headlines: GM to sell new electric car batteries to Honda in North America
Description: General Motors Co will supply advanced batteries to Japan's Honda Motor Co, the companies said Thursday, a move that could significantly reduce the cost of future electric vehicles at both automakers after 2020.

Headlines: McDonald's plans fresh round of layoffs: WSJ
Description: McDonald's Corp  is planning a new round of layoffs to flatten out its management structure further, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday, citing a company email sent to all its U.S. employees, suppliers and franchisees.

Headlines: IKEA to use only renewable and recycled materials by 2030
Description: IKEA, the world's biggest furniture retailer, plans to use only renewable and recycled materials in its products by 2030, in the latest commitment by a global store group to reducing its impact on the environment.

Headlines: AmTrust agrees to sweetened $2.95 billion buyout offer
Description: U.S. insurer AmTrust Financial Services Inc  on Thursday agreed to be acquired by a group of investors for a sweetened $2.95 billion deal that also helped secure the support of dissenting shareholder Carl Icahn.

Headlines: Qualcomm CEO hopes ZTE deal will clear acquisition of NXP in China
Description: Qualcomm Inc CEO Steven Mollenkopf said on Thursday he hoped an announced agreement between the United States and China on the future of ZTE Corp will pave the way for China clearing Qualcomm's acquisition of NXP Semiconductors NV.

Headlines: Google faces EU antitrust fine over Android case in July: sources
Description: Google is expected to be hit with a second EU antitrust fine in mid-July for using its dominant Android mobile operating system to squeeze out rivals, three people familiar with the matter said.

Headlines: Top French banks appoint graduate school contemporaries of Macron
Description: France's biggest banks BNP Paribas and Societe Generale have appointed to senior posts former graduate school contemporaries of President Emmanuel Macron, suggesting the institutions want to keep close ties with the political establishment.

Headlines: Trump sticks with hard line on trade as showdown looms at G7
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump is not backing down from the tough line he has taken on trade, the White House's top economic adviser said on Wednesday, setting the stage for a showdown with top allies at this week's G7 summit in Canada.

Headlines: College pay-off seems elusive for many U.S. young people
Description: When Scott Petracco graduated from the University of Illinois at Chicago with a bachelor’s degree in biology eight years ago, he thought he would quickly get a job in a laboratory and pay off $30,000 in student loans.

Headlines: UK's House of Fraser to shut 31 stores, 6,000 jobs at risk
Description: House of Fraser said it needed to close 31 stores to survive, in a plan likely to result in as many as 6,000 job losses, making the department store group the latest in a long line of retail casualties in Britain.

Headlines: Tight security to keep protesters far from G7 summit
Description: Quebec's forested Charlevoix region has begun to look more like a fortress than a resort as organizers of this week's G7 summit gear up to shield seven world leaders from outside disturbances.

Headlines: Kering's Gucci aims to hit 10 billion euro revenue threshold
Description: Italy's Gucci, the fashion brand fuelling a sales boom at Kering , said on Thursday it aimed to keep growing at twice the pace of the luxury market and aims to eventually reach 10 billion euros ($11.82 billion) in annual revenue.

Headlines: Fujifilm could walk away from Xerox deal if no progress for six months
Description: Japan's Fujifilm Holdings Corp  said on Thursday it may have no choice but to abandon a $6.1 billion merger with Xerox Corp  if there is no progress in talks with the U.S. firm's new board for about half a year.

Headlines: Billions in U.S. solar projects shelved after Trump panel tariff
Description: President Donald Trump’s tariff on imported solar panels has led U.S. renewable energy companies to cancel or freeze investments of more than $2.5 billion in large installation projects, along with thousands of jobs, the developers told Reuters.

Headlines: Thai Airways to undertake maintenance of Rolls-Royce engines
Description: Thai Airways International Pcl  will undertake maintenance and repair of Rolls-Royce Trent engines and expects additional revenue of up to 5 billion baht ($156.6 million) in 2020 from the business, the carrier said on Thursday.

Headlines: Ford plans to close Bordeaux plant if no buyer found
Description: Ford  plans to close its Blanquefort gearbox plant in southwestern France if no buyer can be found for the site, which employs 900 workers, the U.S. carmaker said on Thursday.

Headlines: Fed clambers back to positive real rates, now debate is when to stop
Description: The Federal Reserve will likely raise its target interest rate to above the rate of inflation for the first time in a decade next week, igniting a new debate: when to stop.

Headlines: ExxonMobil sees Russian LNG plant's capacity at 6.2 million T/year: Ifax
Description: U.S. major ExxonMobil and Russian energy company Rosneft  expect their future joint project to produce more than 6.2 million tonnes of liquefied natural gas per year, Interfax news agency quoted an ExxonMobil manager as saying on Thursday.

Headlines: Italy court suspends fine on Telecom Italia over Vivendi control
Description: An Italian court has suspended a 74.3 million euro ($88 million)fine imposed on Telecom Italia  for failing to notify the government its main shareholder Vivendi  had effective control.

Headlines: Honolulu lawmakers pass 'surge pricing' cap for ride-hailing companies
Description: Honolulu could become the first U.S. city to limit fares ride-hailing companies can charge when demand spikes, following a city council vote on Wednesday, the Honolulu Star-Advertiser newspaper reported.

Headlines: Twitter to offer $1 billion convertible note as shares rally
Description: Twitter Inc  is preparing a $1 billion convertible note offering, the social media hub said on Wednesday, one day after news that it would be included in the S&P 500 index sent its shares up 5 percent to a more than three-year high.

Headlines: Australia's AMP slapped with fourth lawsuit, shares hit six-year low
Description: Australia's biggest wealth manager, AMP Ltd  on Thursday said it faced a fourth class-action lawsuit for allegedly charging fees for services not provided, sending the company's shares to their lowest in more than six years.

Headlines: Buffett, Dimon say quarterly profit forecasts harming economy: WSJ
Description: Billionaire investor Warren Buffett and JPMorgan Chase  Chief Executive Jamie Dimon voiced concerns that the financial markets' focus on short-term goals is hurting the economy and urged companies to move away from providing quarterly earnings guidance, according to the Wall Street Journal.

Headlines: Daimler fights Tesla, VW with new electric big rig truck
Description: Daimler AG  unveiled on Wednesday an all-electric big rig truck it promises to have in production in 2021, as the German automaker mounts a major challenge to European and American rivals, including new entrants like Tesla Inc .

Headlines: China says it does not want U.S. trade frictions to escalate
Description: China's Commerce Ministry said on Thursday that the country does not want an escalation of trade frictions with the United States, and that some specific progress was made in the latest round of talks that concluded over the weekend.

Headlines: Macau clamps down on use of UnionPay cards to dodge currency controls
Description: Authorities in Macau, the world's biggest gambling hub, have told financial institutions to tackle the illegal use of UnionPay cards to evade exchange controls, China's latest move to clamp down on illicit capital outflows.

Headlines: Icahn buys small stake in drugmaker Allergan: sources
Description: Billionaire investor Carl Icahn has acquired a small stake in Allergan Plc  at a time when the drugmaker is under pressure from other activist shareholders, people familiar with the matter said on Wednesday.

Headlines: U.S. lawmakers press Facebook over Chinese data sharing
Description: Facebook Inc faced criticism on Wednesday from Republican and Democratic U.S. lawmakers who demanded that the social media company be more forthcoming about data it has shared with four Chinese firms.

Headlines: Congress has few options to stop Trump from saving China's ZTE
Description: There is little Congress can do to stop President Donald Trump if he wants to relax penalties on ZTE Corp , despite strong bipartisan opposition to easing restrictions on China's No. 2 telecommunications equipment maker.

Headlines: Wall Street rises on economic data, easing trade worries
Description: Wall Street indexes rallied on Wednesday with help from financial stocks as investors eyed strong economic data and trade war fears took a back seat while the Nasdaq registered its third straight record closing high.

Headlines: Trump's move to please farmers on biofuels reform draws refinery union ire
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump, in yielding to pressure from farming states and agreeing to suspend changes to U.S. biofuel policy is now being criticized by another important constituency, the main union for oil refinery workers.

Headlines: Euro rises to near two-week high, yields jump after ECB comments
Description: The euro rose to a nearly two-week high while the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield hit a 1-1/2-week peak on Wednesday after officials said the European Central Bank could wind down its stimulus program by the end of the year.

Headlines: Wal-Mart settles discrimination lawsuit by transgender worker
Description: Wal-Mart Stores Inc  on Wednesday settled a lawsuit by a transgender former employee in North Carolina who accused the retail giant of unlawfully firing her for complaining about harassment.

Headlines: Mexico's Walmex says same-store sales up 7.2 percent in May
Description: Mexico's biggest retailer, Wal-Mart de Mexico , said on Wednesday that same-store sales in Mexico rose in May by 7.2 percent.

Headlines: Paul Dacre, editor of the UK's Daily Mail, to stand down
Description: The editor of Britain's Daily Mail tabloid Paul Dacre will stand down after 26 years in November to become chairman and editor-in-chief of the title's publisher, Associated Newspapers, Daily Mail and General Trust  said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Drugmaker Lundbeck to settle U.S. charity probe for $52.6 million
Description: Danish drugmaker Lundbeck  said on Wednesday that it will pay $52.6 million to resolve a U.S. probe into its financial support of patient assistance charitable foundations.

Headlines: CP Rail deal will give workers 9 percent raise over four years: union
Description: Canadian Pacific Railway Ltd conductors and locomotive engineers will get a 9 percent salary hike over four years as part of a tentative agreement reached last week with the Teamsters, a union spokesman said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Facebook confirms data sharing with Chinese companies
Description: Facebook Inc  said Tuesday it has data sharing partnerships with at least four Chinese companies including Huawei, the world's third largest smartphone maker, which has come under scrutiny from U.S. intelligence agencies on security concerns.

Headlines: Oil falls on U.S. crude build; global supply seen rising
Description: Oil prices fell on Wednesday on worries that global supply is climbing after U.S. inventories rose unexpectedly and Saudi Arabia and other big producers signaled that they may increase output.

Headlines: U.S. dollar-store shares marked down but specialty discounters thrive
Description: The shares of so-called dollar stores have suffered as U.S. shoppers have started spending more at bargain retailers with focused concepts and big discount chains.

Headlines: Tesla shares rise as Musk says Model 3 set to hit target
Description: Tesla Inc  shares headed for their best day in more than two years on Wednesday after Chief Executive Elon Musk said the car maker was now churning out 500 of its Model 3 sedans a day and should achieve its 5,000 per week target by the end of June.

Headlines: Brown-Forman upped Jack Daniel's shipments as trade war loomed
Description: Jack Daniel's maker Brown-Forman Corp   warned on Wednesday of trouble ahead from tariffs being slapped on U.S. bourbon and said it had been working in recent months to mitigate the potential impact by shipping more liquor overseas.

Headlines: Alphabet shareholders reject diversity proposal backed by employees
Description: Alphabet Inc's shareholders, including top executives, voted down several proposals on Wednesday, defeating campaigns to tie pay to diversity goals and to get the Google parent to provide more data about efforts to moderate user-generated content.

Headlines: UBS cuts at least 100 jobs in asset management arm: Bloomberg
Description: Swiss bank UBS Group AG  is cutting jobs at its asset management unit while it focuses on growth in China along with passive and sustainable investing, Bloomberg said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Oil vs wild rice: Enbridge, opponents gear up final U.S. pipeline push
Description: Canada's Enbridge Inc  faces an indefinite delay to its biggest-ever capital project if a U.S. state regulator denies its preferred pipeline route through Minnesota, but a victory would spell relief for Canadian oil shippers and northern U.S. refiners.

Headlines: VW sees production stoppages due to new testing rules
Description: Volkswagen  faces production stoppages next quarter due to bottlenecks caused by new lab tests for emissions and fuel consumption, and will discuss the implications for workers in the coming days, it said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Delta Air shares slip as rising fuel costs weigh on profits
Description: Delta Air Lines  on Wednesday lowered its second quarter profit forecast due to rising fuel costs, and its shares fell as much as nearly 4 percent before trimming those losses.

Headlines: Uber jumps into Europe's crowded bike-sharing market
Description: Uber, the ride-hailing company which has been banned from many European cities, is about to launch its JUMP electric bicycle sharing service in Germany as it diversifies and seeks to build bridges with local authorities.

Headlines: Germany's E.ON puts fate of Uniper management in Fortum's hands
Description: A vote that could have triggered a probe into whether managers of German energy company Uniper  tried to block the sale of a 47 percent stake to Finland's Fortum  was postponed on Wednesday in line with a proposal by Uniper's biggest shareholder E.ON .

Headlines: Rising exports push U.S. trade deficit to seven-month low
Description: The U.S. trade deficit fell to a seven-month low in April as exports rose to a record high, lifted by an increase in shipments of industrial materials and soybeans.

Headlines: Property investors in Austria give Starwood the cold shoulder
Description: U.S. investment firm Starwood Capital failed on Wednesday in its attempt to take major stakes in Austrian property groups CA Immo  and Immofinanz , as shareholders bet a more lucrative deal could be secured.

Headlines: Athenahealth CEO steps down; company considers sale
Description: Athenahealth Inc's  Chief Executive Officer Jonathan Bush stepped down on Wednesday and the healthcare software maker said it was exploring options, including selling itself, following pressure from activist investor Elliott Management.

Headlines: PetSmart taps advisers to trim $8 billion debt pile: sources
Description: PetSmart Inc, the largest U.S. pet retailer, has hired restructuring advisers to explore ways to trim its debt pile of more than $8 billion as it continues to face falling profits, according to people familiar with the matter.

Headlines: Qatar Airways boss apologizes for remarks on women CEOs
Description: The head of Qatar Airways apologized on Wednesday for saying that a woman could not do his job, while global airlines pledged to speed up efforts to break down gender imbalances in aviation.

Headlines: Indian police source says still seeking to quiz AirAsia boss; airline denies summons
Description: India's federal police will again ask AirAsia Group's  chief to appear for questioning over allegations the airline broke rules to obtain a flying license in the country, a source said on Wednesday, after he failed to answer a previous request.

Headlines: Foxconn looks for its next act but faces risks as it diversifies
Description: Foxconn, the Taiwanese contract manufacturer that rose to global prominence as the manufacturer of the Apple iPhone, is trying to reinvent itself as smartphone sales plateau and Apple Inc diversifies its supplier base.

Headlines: Swiss prosecutors will not pursue Novartis over Trump lawyer payments
Description: The Swiss attorney general's office (OAG) said on Wednesday it will not bring proceedings against Novartis in connection with $1.2 million in payments the Swiss drugmaker made to U.S. President Donald Trump's personal lawyer.

Headlines: Pfizer pumps $600 million into venture capital arm
Description: Pfizer Inc  said on Wednesday it planned to invest $600 million in its venture capital fund, a quarter of which would be earmarked for promising research on neuroscience.

Headlines: Airlines warned against complacency after dream safety run
Description: Global airlines, coming off a record-low accident rate in 2017, need to guard against complacency over safety as heavy growth in travel demand stretches the air transport system, industry leaders warned at a conference this week.

Headlines: U.S. house prices to rise at twice the speed of inflation and pay: Reuters poll
Description: An acute shortage of affordable homes in the United States will continue over the coming year, according to a majority of property market analysts polled by Reuters, driving prices up faster than inflation and wage growth.

Headlines: Airlines struggle with global pilot shortage
Description: A growing shortage of airline pilots is putting the industry's recent growth at risk as planes sit idle, higher salaries cut into profits and unions across the globe push for more benefits.

Headlines: G7 likely to discuss global economy, concerns about U.S. trade policy: Japan's Suga
Description: Japan's top government spokesman said on Wednesday that the Group of Seven leaders were likely to discuss the global economy and concerns about U.S. trade policy.

Headlines: Japan PM Abe: no countries benefit from trade protectionism
Description: Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe said on Wednesday that he wants to send a message at a Group of Seven leaders' summit that no countries benefit from trade protectionism.

Headlines: Fresenius transfers inpatient rehabilitation business to Vamed unit
Description: German healthcare group Fresenius  said it was transferring its inpatient rehabilitation business from its private hospital operations to its Fresenius Vamed unit to better enable continued growth at the two businesses.

Headlines: Siemens signs pacts to deepen ties to China's Belt and Road push
Description: Siemens  has signed more than ten cooperation agreements with Chinese companies as it seeks to benefit from deepening involvement with China's "Belt and Road" infrastructure initiative, the German engineering group said on Wednesday.

Headlines: World's top wealth fund opposed Musk's double role at Tesla
Description: Norway's $1 trillion wealth fund said on Wednesday it had backed an initiative to wrest the role of chairman away from Tesla  Chief Executive Elon Musk.

Headlines: Air Baltic's hurry for Bombardier CSeries deal foreshadows jet selling spree
Description: Latvia-based AirBaltic hastened a deal for Bombardier  CSeries planes before Airbus formally takes over the Canadian planemaker because it was worried about securing the right delivery slots, the carrier's chief executive said on Wednesday.

Headlines: Alibaba's Cainiao JV to invest $1.53 billion in Hong Kong logistics hub
Description: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd's  logistics affiliate said on Wednesday that it would lead a joint venture to invest $1.53 billion in a new logistics center at Hong Kong's airport as part of its efforts to expand its global delivery network.

Headlines: Exclusive: China's ZTE signed preliminary agreement to lift U.S. ban: sources
Description: ZTE Corp  has signed an agreement in principle that would lift a U.S. Commerce Department ban on buying from U.S. suppliers, allowing China's No. 2 telecommunications equipment maker to get back into business, according to sources familiar with the matter.

Headlines: Online shopping boom keeps hopes high for air freight profits
Description: An explosion of e-commerce demand is buoying the air freight business, boosting profit at some major airlines despite global trade tensions and underscoring robust consumer confidence.

Headlines: Honda to start selling Hondajet in Japan next year
Description: Honda Motor Co  on Wednesday said it would start selling its six-seater business jet in Japan next year, as it seeks to expand global sales by tapping into demand from a growing class of high net-worth individuals.

Headlines: Volatility may hit Wall Street as Alphabet, Facebook leave tech sector group
Description: Volatility could well be in the cards for Wall Street again early this fall, but not for the same reason stocks got rattled in February.

Headlines: Mexico minister sees more than 50 percent chance of initial NAFTA deal this year
Description: Mexico's economy minister said on Tuesday that he sees a better than 50 percent chance of reaching an agreement in principle on NAFTA this year despite escalating tensions between his country and the United States.

Headlines: French group Thales targets more sales and profit growth for 2018-2021
Description: French defense electronics group Thales  set out targets for further sales and profit growth over the 2018-2021 period, and added it would increase spending on research as part of its plans to boost earnings and improve its business.

Headlines: Tesla 'quite likely' to meet Model 3 goal; Musk remains chairman
Description: Tesla Inc Chief Executive Elon Musk said on Tuesday that building 5,000 Model 3s per week by the end of June was "quite likely" as the company's production lines were now demonstrating the ability to make 3,500 vehicles per week.

Headlines: Morocco's Centrale Danone workers protest job losses due to boycott
Description: Workers at Morocco's Centrale Danone, a subsidiary of French group Danone , staged a sit-in in Rabat late on Tuesday over losing their jobs as a consumer boycott now in its second month pressures the company.

Headlines: Outside investors rebuke Facebook vote structure, tallies show
Description: A wide majority of outside investors at Facebook Inc backed a measure that would revamp its voting structure and end the supervoting rights of shares held by Mark Zuckerberg and others, seen as a rebuke to the chief executive of the world's largest social media company.

Headlines: Microsoft expands program for women returning to work
Description: Microsoft Corp  is expanding a program designed to increase its hiring of women seeking to rejoin the workforce, following a rash of complaints about sexual harassment and gender discrimination at the world's largest software company.

Headlines: Northrop Grumman wins U.S. antitrust approval to buy Orbital ATK
Description: U.S. defense contractor Northrop Grumman  won U.S. antitrust approval to buy solid rocket motor supplier Orbital ATK Inc  with conditions, the Federal Trade Commission said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Tronc's top shareholder terminates sale of stake to McCormick Media
Description: Newspaper publisher Tronc Inc's  top shareholder said in a filing http://services.corporate-ir.net/SEC.Enhanced/SecCapsule.aspx?c=254385&fid=15681381 on Wednesday that it had terminated the sale of a stake in the company after the prospective buyer, investor group McCormick Media, breached its obligations.

Headlines: Advent plans conversion, not expansion of Walmart's Brazil ops
Description: Advent International, the buyout firm acquiring 80 percent of Walmart Inc's  Brazilian operations, plans to invest in converting store formats instead of opening new ones, an executive said on Tuesday.

Headlines: U.S. retailers, restaurants say tax law 'drafting error' delays investments
Description: A coalition of retailers and restaurants on Tuesday asked the U.S. Congress to fix a "drafting error" in December's tax-cut bill that they said is deterring companies from investing in their stores.

Headlines: Nasdaq hits record closing high again; euro recovers
Description: The Nasdaq hit a record closing high for the second day in a row on Tuesday, helped by tech and consumer discretionary shares, while the euro recovered after Italy's new prime minister said the government had never considered leaving the euro zone.

Headlines: HP sees up to 5,000 job cuts as part of restructuring plan
Description: HP Inc  now expects 4,500 to 5,000 employees to leave the company by the end of fiscal 2019 as part of an ongoing restructuring plan, the PC maker said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Britain clears way for Murdoch to battle Comcast for Sky
Description: Rupert Murdoch faces a 22 billion pound ($29.3 billion) fight with U.S. cable company Comcast for European pay-TV company Sky after Britain cleared his bid providing he sells off its TV news business.

Headlines: Brent gains after touching one-month low on supply concerns
Description: Brent crude reversed losses on Tuesday, after hitting its lowest price in nearly a month following a report the U.S. government asked Saudi Arabia and other major exporters to increase oil output.

Headlines: Nasdaq ends at record close, S&P edges higher on data
Description: The Nasdaq closed at a record high for the second day in a row with help from the technology and consumer discretionary sectors, while the S&P 500 edged higher as investors eyed solid U.S. economic data.

Headlines: BlackRock promises selective fee cuts to capture growth
Description: BlackRock Inc , the world's largest asset manager, on Tuesday said it would continue to reduce fees on a small group of its products with the highest growth potential, days after cutting fees on 11 exchange-traded funds.

Headlines: America Movil to launch new U.S. unit for business clients
Description: Mexican telecommunications company America Movil, controlled by the family of Mexican billionaire Carlos Slim, is launching a U.S.-based unit that will offer information technology and communications to business customers, according to a source and a document on the company's website.

Headlines: Expect disagreements over tariffs at G7 summit: Canada official
Description: The Group of Seven leading industrial nations at its summit this week is poised to disagree over U.S. metals tariffs, which have infuriated Canada and European Union members of the bloc, a Canadian official said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Starbucks investors mourn end of an era as Schultz exits
Description: Starbucks Corp's  shares fell as much as 3 percent on Tuesday as the departure of Howard Schultz, the entrepreneur who turned 11 cafes into a global juggernaut, added to a series of worrying headlines for the world's biggest coffee chain.

Headlines: UBS hires Solon Kentas to lead U.S. consumer and retail M&A
Description: UBS Group AG  has appointed Solon Kentas, previously a managing director at Deutsche Bank AG , to lead the Swiss bank's U.S. consumer and retail dealmaking efforts, UBS announced internally in a memo on Tuesday.

Headlines: Wells Fargo pulls back from U.S. Midwest, selling 52 branches to Flagstar
Description: Wells Fargo & Co  is pulling back from retail banking in the U.S. Midwest, selling all of its branches in three states, as the bank embarks on a broader review of branch profitability across the country.

Headlines: G7 to pledge joint defense of democracies from foreign threats: EU official
Description: G7 leaders will commit at their summit this week to cooperate in defending democracies from foreign threats and establish a response mechanism for that purpose, a senior EU official said on Tuesday.

Headlines: G7 to uphold Russia sanctions: senior EU official
Description: G7 leaders are likely to uphold sanctions against Russia over Moscow's annexation of Crimea and its activity in eastern Ukraine because the conditions to lift them, spelled out in the Minsk agreement, have not been met, a senior EU official said.

Headlines: G7 to call on North Korea to get rid of nuclear weapons: senior EU official
Description: G7 leaders will call on North Korea on Friday to get rid of its nuclear weapons if it wants sanctions against the country to be lifted, a senior European union official said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Two Allergan shareholders call for split of chairman-CEO role
Description: Two of Allergan Plc's  shareholders, hedge funds Appaloosa Management and Senator Investment Group, asked the drugmaker's board to split the role of chief executive officer and chairman as well as reconsider its acquisition strategy.

Headlines: U.S. companies continued stock buyback frenzy in May: report
Description: U.S. companies continued a shopping spree for their own shares in May, making $173.6 billion in buyback announcements, the highest monthly total ever, according to a research report.

Headlines: David Koch to retire from Koch Industries due to poor health: memo
Description: Conservative billionaire industrialist David Koch is retiring from his roles at Koch Industries and associated companies due to poor health, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters.

Headlines: Want to extend the bull market by $6 trillion? Add women
Description: The secret to unlocking a further $6 trillion of gains in global stocks and adding another ten years to this bull run? Forget tax cuts and share buybacks, women are key, according to research by S&P Global.

Headlines: Saudi Aramco names new head of finance after government reshuffle: sources
Description: Saudi Aramco has named six new heads of departments including its finance unit after a government reshuffle last week saw several executives at the oil giant moving to other state posts, the company and industry sources said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Trump may seek separate trade deals with Canada, Mexico: U.S. adviser
Description: U.S. President Donald Trump may seek separate talks with Canada and Mexico in a bid to get individual trade deals with the two countries, White House economic adviser Larry Kudlow said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Airlines hope flashier content for travel agents boosts sales
Description: Airlines are betting that a new system for showcasing their wares on travel agents' screens will help sell fancier seats, tastier meals, lounge access and flight options - and give profits a lift.

Headlines: Twitter shares jump 5 percent as they win new follower: The S&P 500
Description: Consider it the ultimate "like" for a stock: Twitter Inc is joining the benchmark S&P 500 U.S. index, pushing the social media company's stock price up 5 percent on Tuesday as demand surged from equities investors.

Headlines: U.S. services sector activity picks up; job openings at record high
Description: U.S. services sector activity accelerated in May, pointing to robust economic growth in the second quarter, but trade tariffs and a shortage of workers posed a threat to the outlook.

Headlines: Ex-State Street executive cheated clients with secret fees: U.S. prosecutor
Description: A former State Street Corp  executive directed a fraudulent scheme to overcharge several of the bank's clients, including Kuwait's sovereign wealth fund, by applying secret commissions to billions of dollars' worth of trades, a U.S. prosecutor told jurors on Tuesday.

Headlines: StanChart plans to bring Asian operations under two main hubs
Description: Standard Chartered  is drawing up plans to consolidate its Asian operations into two hubs - one in Hong Kong and one in Singapore - in order to better manage its capital, a source familiar with the matter said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Short sellers and options traders bet on more Deutsche Bank pain
Description: Short sellers and derivatives traders are betting Deutsche Bank's  share price recovery will prove temporary, with data suggesting short interest in the German lender is the highest of any global bank.

Headlines: Russian regulator says 19,696 Peugeot and Citroen cars recalled
Description: Russia's standards agency said on Tuesday it had been informed about the voluntary recall of 19,696 Peugeot and Citroen cars sold between February 2008 and September 2014.

Headlines: A decade after debut, first A380 jumbos to be broken up
Description: A German investment company said on Tuesday it would strip two unwanted Airbus A380 superjumbo passenger jets for parts after failing to find an airline willing to keep them flying following a decision by Singapore Airlines not to keep them in service.

Headlines: China launches DRAM chip price probe into Samsung Elec, SK Hynix and Micron
Description: China has launched a probe into Samsung Electronics Co Ltd , SK Hynix Inc  and Micron Technology Inc , the three semiconductor makers who control the market for DRAM memory chips.

Headlines: Britain takes $2.68 billion loss on RBS share sale
Description: Britain has sold some of its holding in Royal Bank of Scotland , the bank which it rescued in the 2008 financial crisis, but has taken a loss of more than 2 billion pounds ($2.68 billion) on the deal.

Headlines: Airline boss stirs gender debate with provocative comment
Description: Promises by the global airline industry to do more to promote gender equality veered off course when one of its top executives suggested his CEO role was too difficult for a woman.

Headlines: Australia charges former local heads of Citi, Deutsche, ANZ in cartel case
Description: Australian authorities have charged the former local bosses of Citigroup Inc and Deutsche Bank AG with "criminal cartel offences" over a $2.3 billion stock issue, one of the country's biggest cases of alleged white-collar crime.

Headlines: Voestalpine CEO to step down in 2019
Description: Voestalpine  Chief Executive Wolfgang Eder will step down in the summer of 2019 after some 15 years at the helm and move to the supervisory board, the Austrian speciality steel company said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Sharp to buy Toshiba PC business, issue $1.8 billion in new shares
Description: Japan's Sharp Corp  said it will buy Toshiba Corp's  personal computer business and issue $1.8 billion in new shares to buy back preferred stock from banks, highlighting a swift recovery under the control of Foxconn.

Headlines: Japan's Sharp to issue new shares worth about $1.8 billion
Description: Japan's Sharp Corp  said on Tuesday it will issue new shares worth about 200 billion yen ($1.8 billion), sending shares of the company tumbling.

Headlines: Air traffic strikes bigger threat than fuel prices in 2018, IAG says
Description: Air traffic control strikes are more of a threat to European airlines this year than a rise in fuel prices, the chief executive of British Airways-owner IAG  said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Australia charges investment banks with alleged cartel activity
Description: Australia's anti-cartel laws have come to global attention with the country's competition watchdog lodging criminal charges for alleged cartel behavior against two global investment banks, in a move one expert called "almost unique".

Headlines: Japan regulators raid Kobe Steel over data tampering
Description: Kobe Steel Ltd  said on Tuesday it had been raided by Japanese regulators over a data tampering scandal revealed last year which had continued for almost 50 years.

Headlines: Europe up against Asian juggernaut in electric car battery drive
Description: Chinese electric vehicle giant BYD  is looking at launching battery production in Europe, joining Asian rivals aiming to cash in on a green car revolution and threatening attempts by Brussels to nurture a home-grown industry.

Headlines: Factbox: Plans for electric car battery production in Europe
Description: China's BYD   is looking at launching battery production in Europe, the latest Asian battery maker aiming to make inroads in Europe as Brussels seek to build a home-grown industry to fuel a surge in electric car production.

Headlines: Toyota's May China vehicle sales +8.6 Percent year on year
Description: Toyota Motor Corp's  vehicle sales in China rose 8.6 percent in May from a year earlier to 122,400 vehicles, the company said on Tuesday.

Headlines: Mexico firms eye workaround on U.S. metals tariffs; consumers in bind
Description: Mexican firms will need to cut deals with suppliers and consider buying goods elsewhere once a conflict over U.S. steel and aluminum import tariffs starts to bite, even as consumers are seen ultimately picking up the tab from any higher prices.

Headlines: Qatar Airways could face 2nd straight annual loss amid Gulf crisis: CEO
Description: Qatar Airways could face a second straight year of losses in 2018 amid a regional dispute that has banned the airline from four Arab countries, the airline's CEO said on Tuesday.

Headlines: GM China raises new-energy vehicle target to 20 models through 2023
Description: General Motors Co  is accelerating the pace of electric vehicle (EV) launches in China as policymakers in the world's biggest auto market continue to promote EVs as an alternative to gasoline cars.

Headlines: Emirates sees oil, dollar 'double whammy', but demand strong
Description: The president of Emirates airline said the rare combination of higher oil and a stronger dollar, which usually move in opposite directions, represented a "double whammy" in terms of their impact on costs but that passenger demand remained strong.

Headlines: Chinese airlines apply fuel surcharge after three-year hiatus
Description: Chinese carriers including Air China   and China Eastern Airlines Corp   will apply a fuel surcharge to domestic routes from Tuesday, the first time they have done so in three years as oil prices begin to rise.

Headlines: Japan's Sharp says to buy Toshiba's PC business
Description: Japan's Sharp Corp said it will acquire Toshiba Corp's personal computer business for $36 million, highlighting its recovery under the control of Foxconn and marking a return to a business it quit eight years ago.

Headlines: Exclusive: Mexico set to impose 20 percent tariff on U.S. pork legs - sources
Description: Mexico will impose a 20 percent tariff on U.S. pork imports, two industry officials with direct knowledge of the plan told Reuters on Monday, for the first time providing details of the country's retaliatory measures to U.S. President Donald Trump's tariffs on steel and aluminum.

Headlines: Starbucks executive Schultz to step aside, mulling 'range of options'
Description: Starbucks Corp Executive Chairman Howard Schultz is stepping away from the coffee chain he built into a global powerhouse, putting management firmly into the hands of Chief Executive Kevin Johnson, who had an office connected to the co-founder's and regularly turned to Schultz in times of crisis.

Headlines: Exclusive: ConocoPhillips prepares to sell stake in Canada's Cenovus - sources
Description: ConocoPhillips  is preparing to offload its stake in Cenovus Energy Inc , which it acquired as part of an asset sale to the Canadian oil and gas producer last year, people familiar with the matter told Reuters.

Headlines: Apple issues new App Store rules aimed at streaming PC-based games
Description: Apple Inc  on Monday issued new review guidelines for its lucrative App Store platform, after it moved to block plans by Steam, the biggest distributor of PC-based video games, to extend its reach into iPhones and iPads.

Headlines: Apple focuses on speed, parental controls in software upgrades
Description: Apple Inc  on Monday unveiled software upgrades that would let older iPhones run faster, help parents limit their children's screen time and make its Siri voice assistant work more like a rival feature from Amazon.com .

Headlines: SocGen to pay $1.3 billion to settle Libya, Libor probes
Description: French bank Societe Generale  will pay $1.3 billion to resolve criminal and civil charges in the United States and France for bribing Gaddafi-era Libyan officials and manipulating the Libor interest rate benchmark, U.S. authorities said on Monday.

Headlines: Ex-Goldman Sachs programer seeks to overturn code theft conviction
Description: Former Goldman Sachs Group Inc programer Sergey Aleynikov on Monday filed a new challenge to his criminal conviction of stealing computer code from the investment bank when he left for another job.

Headlines: Total virtual currency sales jump in 2018 but monthly trend slows: report
Description: Virtual currency sales ballooned to $9.1 billion so far this year, exceeding the $6.6 billion total for all of 2017, a financial technology data provider reported on Monday, but it said the monthly trend actually showed a slowdown if the two biggest offerings are excluded.

Headlines: Dollar falls, U.S. yields rise, political fears ebb in Europe
Description: The dollar fell to a two-week low and Treasury yields climbed on Monday as political tensions in Europe eased, while Wall Street stocks gained with technology shares as investors bet on continued strong economic growth.

Headlines: Tech rally helps Wall Street push higher, Nasdaq has record close
Description: Wall Street's three major indexes rose on Monday, led by a rally in tech stocks, pushing the Nasdaq to a record closing high as investors bet on a continuation of strong economic growth, while falling oil prices weighed on the energy sector.

Headlines: Most Americans oppose businesses refusing to serve gay people: Reuters/Ipsos poll
Description: Nearly three quarters of U.S. adults believe that businesses should not have the right on religious grounds to deny services to customers based on their sexual orientation, a Reuters/Ipsos opinion poll released on Monday showed.

Headlines: Twitter Inc to join the S&P 500, replacing Monsanto
Description: Twitter Inc. will replace Monsanto in the S&P 500, S&P Dow Jones Indices said on Monday.

Headlines: Canada faces significant risks from U.S. tax, trade policy: IMF
Description: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) said on Monday that while Canada's economy has performed well, it faces significant risks including trade tensions and a potential hit to competitiveness from lower U.S. corporate taxes.

Headlines: Former State Street executive faces U.S. fraud trial
Description: A former executive at State Street Corp  went on trial on Monday on U.S. charges that he participated in a scheme to defraud the bank's clients by charging them secret commissions on billions of dollars in trades.

Headlines: Legg Mason to pay $64 million to resolve U.S. allegations of Libya bribery scheme
Description: Asset management firm Legg Mason Inc  has entered into a settlement agreement with the U.S. Justice Department and agreed to pay $64.2 million to resolve allegations it violated anti-bribery laws through one of its subsidiaries in Libya, the department said on Monday.

Headlines: Oil falls 2 percent, U.S. crude hits lowest since early April
Description: Oil prices fell about 2 percent on Monday, with U.S. crude touching its lowest level in nearly two months, breaking below technical support levels as investors kept selling amid growing U.S. production, possible global supply growth and nagging trade tensions.

Headlines: Microsoft to take on Amazon with $7.5 billion GitHub deal
Description: Microsoft Corp  said on Monday it would buy privately held coding website GitHub Inc for $7.5 billion in an all-stock deal to beef up its cloud computing business and challenge market leader Amazon.com Inc .

Headlines: SEC fines New York firm deVere $8 million over UK pension advice conflicts
Description: The New York investment adviser deVere USA Inc agreed on Monday to pay an $8 million civil fine to settle U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission charges it failed to disclose conflicts of interest to hundreds of clients with UK pensions.

Headlines: With maple syrup tariff, Canada-U.S. trade dispute spills beyond metals
Description: Canada's retaliation against U.S. President Donald Trump's steel and aluminum tariffs includes proposed duties on maple syrup, a nod to a national symbol and a powerful industry in the French-speaking province of Quebec that could hurt producers in Maine.

Headlines: Daimler says electric cars on target after report of launch delays
Description: Daimler  said planned launches of battery-powered luxury cars were on schedule on Monday following a report in Germany's Handelsblatt that they were facing delays because of battery shortages and other technical problems.

Headlines: Qualcomm asks EU court to scrap $1.2 billion antitrust fine
Description: U.S. chipmaker Qualcomm  has asked Europe's second-highest court to throw out a 997 million euro ($1.2 billion) fine levied by European Union antitrust regulators, citing numerous errors in the EU decision.

Headlines: SocGen says to pay $1.3 billion to settle U.S., French probes
Description: Societe Generale  said on Monday it had agreed to pay around $1.3 billion in penalties to authorities in the United States and in France to resolve investigations into its transactions in Libya and its handling of money market rates.

Headlines: CFTC orders French bank Societe Generale to pay $475 million penalty
Description: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission on Monday ordered French bank Société Générale SA  to pay a $475 million penalty to resolve charges it manipulated the London Interbank Offered Rate, or LIBOR, and the Euro Interbank Offered Rate, or Euribor.

Headlines: With deal to close this week, Bayer to retire Monsanto name
Description: Germany's Bayer  will wrap up the $63 billion takeover of Monsanto  on Thursday and also retire the U.S. seeds maker's 117 year-old name.

Headlines: Walmart sells majority of Brazil unit, takes $4.5 billion charge
Description: Walmart Inc  said on Monday that it has sold an 80 percent stake in its Brazilian operations to private equity firm Advent International, exiting an underperforming business in its third major international deal since April.

Headlines: France's PSA suspends joint ventures in Iran to avoid U.S. sanctions
Description: French carmaker PSA Group  has begun to suspend its joint venture activities in Iran to avoid U.S. sanctions after Washington's withdrawal from the international nuclear deal.

Headlines: U.S. CFTC proposes rule to keep higher threshold for swap dealers
Description: The U.S. derivatives regulator on Monday proposed maintaining the existing cutoff for U.S. firms to register as swaps dealers, backing off an earlier plan that would have subjected more firms to stricter oversight under the 2010 Dodd-Frank financial reform law.

Headlines: Southwest Airlines bookings drop after fatal engine blowout
Description: Southwest Airlines  on Monday said it now expects its second-quarter unit revenue to decrease by about 3 percent from the year prior, primarily driven by lower bookings in the wake of a fatal engine blowout in April.

Headlines: LVMH boss Arnault taps son for top communications job
Description: Antoine Arnault, one of LVMH  Chairman and CEO Bernard Arnault's five children and an executive in charge of several brands at the luxury group, will oversee communications and image issues at the company, according to an internal memo.

Headlines: Societe Generale to pay over $860 million to resolve bribery, Libor manipulation cases

Description: Canada will buy Kinder Morgan Canada Ltd's  Trans Mountain pipeline for C$4.5 billion ($3.5 billion), the government said on Tuesday, hoping to save a project that faces formidable political and environmental opposition.

Headlines: Civil rights advisers hope Starbucks' anti-bias training sets example
Description: Black leaders who are advising Starbucks Corp  on its anti-bias training program, which begins Tuesday, hope it will reinvigorate decades-old efforts to ensure minorities get equal treatment in restaurants and stores, setting an example for other corporations.
